I enjoyed the lower fat content because lemon/lime squares can be extremely high in fat.  
  The only thing I didn't like was the streusel topping.  It just crumbled off and made a mess all over the counter and floor.  Even though, I will make this again making sure to try with the fresh juice and zest.
  Thank you for a tasty recipe.  My daughter (6) and I had a wonderful time making this together.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thanksgiving cranberry peach cobbler

i received this recipe from a friend. i love easy cobbler recipes like this.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. combine cake mix , cinnamon , nutmeg in a bowl
3. cut in butter with a pastry blender until crumbly
4. stir in nuts and set aside
5. combine peach pie filling and cranberry sauce in an ungreased 13 x 9 inch pan
6. sprinkle crumb mixture over fruit
7. bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown
8. serve with ice cream
demonstrations.review: We really like this cobbler (especially my husband).  I had a 20oz can of peach pie filling so I used it all with the usual amount of cranberry.  It turned out wonderful.  It didn't get 5 stars from me because it is so fattening.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
maple oatmeal muffins

these made a lovely breakfast this morning!  fairly heavily modified from a recipe in a cute little "all muffins" cookbook i got years ago.  the original recipe says this makes 12 but i have old/small muffin tins and i got 24.  if you have large muffin tins you'll probably only get 12.

1. preheat your oven to 400 degrees
2. spray your muffin tins with nonstick spray
3. in a large bowl beat together the sucanat and eggs until well mixed
4. add the soymilk and maple syrup and mix well
5. on top of the liquid add the whole wheat flour , the 1 1 / 2 cups oatmeal , baking powder and baking soda
6. when all has been added , mix well being careful not to overbeat
7. spoon your batter into your muffin cups
8. once they are full , sprinkle a little bit of the oatmeal on top of each muffin
9. the original recipe calls for a teaspoon on each but we don't like that much oatmeal on top
10. bake for 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: These are really good.  I love that they are made with soymilk and I don't have to change the recipe.  Most people have these ingredients on hand and this was a breeze to make.  Just the right amount of sweetness.  I did have some trouble getting them out of the muffin tin, even with using a non-stick pan and cooking spray.  I suggest using silicon liners.  The batter was very thin even after adding 3 heaping TBSPs of flour.  Thanks so much, we all enjoyed eating these muffins.

target.recipe_text:
mama s supper club tilapia parmesan

you asked for it. here it is. thanks so much to mama's supper club. wish we could all go there.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in buttered 13-by-9-inch baking dish or jellyroll pan , lay fillets in single layer
3. do not stack fillets
4. brush top with juice
5. in bowl combine cheese , butter , mayonnaise , onions and seasonings
6. mix well with fork
7. bake fish in preheated oven 10 to 20 minutes or until fish just starts to flake
8. spread with cheese mixture and bake until golden brown , about 5 minutes
9. baking time will depend on the thickness of the fish you use
10. watch fish closely so that it does not overcook
11. makes 4 servings
12. broil 3 to 4 minutes or until almost done
13. add cheese and broil another 2 to 3 minutes or until browned
14. thank you mama's supper club in wisconsin
target.review: I concur with everyone else- this is wonderful! My DH will eat fish, just isn't crazy about it. After the first bite his response was "Man, this is GOODDD"! So this recipe is headed for the favorites file. Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mini egg casserole

this is a hearty breakfast treat for one. this savory casserole can be prepared the day before and popped into the oven in the morning. simply delicious! i got this from taste of home magazine.

1. place the hash brown patty in a greased 3-cup baking dish
2. arrange the stir-fry blend around patty
3. sprinkle with ham , mushrooms and cheese
4. in a small bowl , whisk the eggs , cream , salt , pepper and mustard
5. pour over cheese
6. top with tomato slices
7. bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: I'm allergic to eggs, but my husband loves them. Making a regular breakfast casserole means that I end up throwing out a lot. This was perfect! I did break up the patty, making it more like traditional casseroles. I had first read this recipe in Taste of Home, but had lost it. Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
montalcino chicken with figs   rachael ray

fom rachael ray's 30 minutes meals.  i watched this episode & the dish looked wonderful.  montalcino is a small town in italy famous for its vineyards.  rachael suggests using brunello wine in this recipe.

1. heat a deep skillet over medium high heat
2. add olive oil and pancetta
3. brown the pancetta 3 to 4 minutes then remove and reserve
4. season the chicken chunks with salt and pepper , dredge in flour then add to the hot pan
5. brown the pieces a few minutes on each side over high heat
6. move the meat to the edges of the pan and add the onions , garlic and chopped figs
7. saute 5 minutes
8. combine chicken with onions and figs then add the wine and cook it down 5 minutes or until only about 1 / 3 cup remains
9. add chicken stock , parsley , lemon zest and thyme to the chicken and stir to combine
10. reduce heat to simmer cook another 10 minutes
11. if you would like a more sauce , pour another half cup of stock into the pan
12. remove from pan & garnish with crisp pancetta sticks
demonstrations.review: I've made this twice from RR's magazine. In the magazine recipe she suggests topping with brown butter gnocchi. It's wonderful that way.The last time I made this, I used regular bacon (no pancetta in the house), and it gave it a smokier flavor. It is MUCH better the second day after the flavors have had a chance to marry. DH in fact has told me that this is one of the best recipes I make, and he enjoys pretty much anything I throw at him! I do agree however, that it takes longer than 30 minutes. Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick   easy chicken tagine

inspired by rachael ray's 30 minute replica of this wonderful traditional dish. i serve it with brown rice, but also wonderful with cous-cous or other grains.  grilled plantains also introduce a wonderful sweetness to the mix.

1. in a large nonstick skillet , add the olive oil and smashed garlic
2. saut onions for 1-2 minutes and add the chicken
3. sprinkle on the spice mixture
4. cook for 2 minutes on each side
5. add the prunes , raisins , and chicken stock
6. stir to combine , reduce to moderate heat , and cook covered for 8 minutes
7. let simmer until near meal time
8. remove cover and cook 2-3 minutes to help remove some of the moisture
9. add more salt , pepper , or cayenne to taste
10. top with cilantro
demonstrations.review: I made this for supper last night and boy was it good! I didn't have prunes so substituted chopped dates.Served it over couscous with pine nuts. It was even better left over for lunch today.Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stove top lasagna

i started making lasagna this way to save time (and dishes) during the busy work week. super easy, cheap to make, taste wonderful!!

1. cook and drain pasta
2. brown meat , seasoned to taste , drain any fat
3. add sauce , heat through
4. in large pot mix together meat sauce , pasta , and cottage cheese , over low heat
5. cover with shredded cheese , cover with lid until melted
6. serve w / salad & garlic bread
demonstrations.review: This was so quick and so good! I used Italian seasoning in the ground beef and then a 32 oz. jar of sauce (we like extra). I also added about 1/3 cup of red wine and let it simmer before adding the other ingredients. Can't wait to have leftovers for lunch tomorrow. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey cornmeal biscuits

from national honey board exchanges: 1 starch/bread; 1/2 fat

1. preheat oven to 450f
2. in large bowl , combine all ingredients until dough forms
3. beat 30 seconds
4. turn dough onto surace dusted with baking mix
5. gently roll in baking mix to coat
6. shape into a ball
7. knead 10 times
8. roll or pat out 1 / 2-inch thick
9. cut with 2-inch cutter dipped in baking mix
10. bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown
11. serve with additional honey
demonstrations.review: I was looking for something different to fix for supper last night. These fit the bill nicely. I used 2% milk because that's what I had. These were wonderful! Nice texture and taste, just a hint of sweetness, not overly sweet. Brushed with melted butter when they came out of the oven-delicious! A keeper in our house. Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
allspice cream cheese frosting

a cream cheese frosting with a little extra something, this frosting is paticularly good on carrot cake. recipe originally posted on allrecipes.com

1. in a medium bowl , beat cream cheese , butter and allspice until blended
2. gradually add confectioner's sugar and mix until well combined
3. stir in vanilla
4. gradually add milk , beating until frosting is of spreading consistency
target.review: Love this frosting! However, I did tweak it a bit.  I like my frosting a bit more tangy, so I used an entire 8 oz package of cream cheese.  I cut the sugar to 2 cups and skipped the milk.  Extremely creamy and smooth, and the allspice gives it that something extra.  I am licking the bowl as I type!  I had plenty for a 9x13 carrot cake....with enough extra to eat contently with a spoon.  Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy tuna or chicken noodle casserole

this is a delicious casserole that can be made using either tuna or 1-1/2 cups or more of cooked cubed chicken or even cooked turkey
 --- for a thinner sauce use 1 cup of milk or half and half instead of 3/4 cup, prep time includes boiling the egg noodles, if you are not a garlic-lover then you may omit the garlic powder and to zing the flavor up even more add in 1-1/2 tablespoons of lemon juice

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. grease a 2-quart casserole dish
3. cook the egg noodles in boiling salted water
4. drain then toss with 2 tablespoons butter
5. in a large saucepan , mix the undiluted mushroom soup , garlic powder , parmesan cheese milk or half and half , sour cream , salt , pepper , chopped onion , pimiento , bell pepper and celery
6. cook over low heat , stirring frequently for 15 minutes
7. add in the tuna or chicken
8. mix to combine
9. combine the mixture with the cooked egg noodles
10. transfer to prepared greased baking dish
11. sprinkle top with the broken ritz crackers
12. bake for about 25 minutes
demonstrations.review: yummmmm.....another winner!  This is comfort food at its best, creamy warm and delicious.  Changed a few things:  I started the sauce by browning the onions in a tbsp or 2 or butter then added the remaining sauce ingredients.  Also, I subbed celery for peas as it was what I had on hand.  This recipe was so good that I had to double the recipe the second time around so I had enough leftovers (and p.s. there's only two of us!!!!!).  Thank you so much for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet chicken bacon wraps  paula deen

hey you paula deen fans, she has a new magazine, "cooking with paula deen"--this recipe is from the premier issue.  it was so yummy looking, i couldn't wait to try it.  i added another 15 minutes to the cooking time suggested (30-35 minutes) and it was just right, but oven temperatures vary, so check on it during the last few minutes of cooking time.  i'm also going to add a few dashes of cayenne pepper next time for something hot and sweet!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes
3. cut each bacon slice into thirds
4. wrap each chicken cube with bacon and secure with a wooden pick inserted on the diagonal starting where bacon seam overlaps
5. stir together brown sugar and chili powder
6. dredge wrapped chicken in mixture
7. coat a rack and broiler pan with non-stick cooking spray
8. place chicken on rack in broiler pan
9. bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes , or until bacon is crisp
demonstrations.review: Yummy yummy yummy!!!  Excellent recipe and very filling appetizer.  At the suggestion of other reviewers I flipped about half-way through cooking and added about 5 minutes to the cooktime.  A little cayenne also added a bit of spice to mine...very good.  Definitely would make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amish sugar cookies

everyone i've ever made these cookies for describes them as very similar to tea cakes; they are very fluffy with a unique flavor. the recipe was given to me by a close friend of my great-aunt jackie. they are yum yum good!!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. in a very large mixing bowl , cream together
3. eggs , sugar , and oil
4. add buttermilk , baking soda , salt , baking powder
5. gradually beat in flour , and beat until mixture is smooth
6. pour by 1 / 4 cupfulls onto a greased cookie sheet
7. sprinkle tops of cookies with cinnamon sugar
8. bake at 400 for 7-8 minutes
9. watch carefully and do not overbake
10. if the cookie springs back when touched , it's done
demonstrations.review: Very tasty.  Like another reviewer I turned this into a cake (I was feeling lazy).  I cut the recipe in half, and poured it into a 9x13 pan.  I sprinkled with sugar and let it bake for 35 minutes.  Very moist and perfectly sweet.  Can't wait to try this out in cookie form.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious chicken pot pie

this chicken pot pie recipe takes a little time, but it is well worth it!! this is an all-time favorite in our family. great on a cold winter day.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. saute onion , celery , carrots and potatoes in margarine for 10 minutes
3. add flour to sauteed mixture , stirring well , cook one minute stirring constantly
4. combine broth and half and half
5. gradually stir into vegetable mixture
6. cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly
7. stir in salt and pepper
8. add chicken and stir well
9. pour into shallow 2 quart casserole dish and top with pie shells
10. cut slits to allow steam to escape
11. bake for 40-50 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and filling is bubbly and cooked through
demonstrations.review: I have already made this several times and love it more every time!  I'm not a big fan of cooked celery, so I omit it and replace it with frozen peas.  I just add them towards the end of the 10 minutes of initial cooktime so they don't get mushy.  I use store-bought pie crust and it works just fine.  I usually end up cutting down the oven time to about 20 or 30 minutes, otherwise the crust tends to get too brown for my liking.  Wonderful meal and definitely worth the effort.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buffalo chicken and blue cheese dip

great, easy dip for tailgates and parties. tastes like buffalo chicken wings with blue cheese dressing. serve with thick chips and/or celery. a little different than the other buffalo chicken dips.

1. boil in a large sauce pan enough water to cook the chicken breasts
2. then , boil the chicken until its cooked through , about 15 minutes
3. remove the chicken , pat dry , and shred with a fork
4. then place the shredded chicken in a large baking dish
5. for a tailgate , i usually use 2 of those disposable 8 by 8 aluminum pans , or one large lasagna-size one
6. pour your desired amount of hot sauce over the chicken , and season with salt and pepper if desired
7. set this dish in the refrigerator to let the chicken absorb the flavor
8. preheat your oven to 350
9. next , over medium heat in a large pan , melt the cream cheese
10. pour in the blue cheese dressing and stir until they are completely combined
11. pour this mixture over the chicken
12. bake for 10 minutes
13. remove , but don't turn the oven off
14. sprinkle the cheddar cheese evenly over the top and return to the oven for another 10-15 minutes , until the cheese is melted and starting to brown just a little
15. serve hot or cold with chips !
demonstrations.review: Excellent Dip!  However I did use a LOT more hot sauce (1 bottle of Frank's hot sauce).  I think without that extra kick, the cream cheese would have neutralized the spice.  Definitely loved it with both celery and Frito's scoops.  The extras will be my dinner tonite!  Thanks for the great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
eggnog cookies

"what a delectable treat for eggnog lovers everywhere! these cookies have a wonderful spicy aroma and are great tasting. the fragrance of nutmeg and cinnamon will infuse your home with holiday spirit as you bake these cookies. they make delicious gifts and are a welcome addition to cookie exchanges. "

1. preheat oven to 300f
2. combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon and nutmeg
3. cream sugar and butter until light
4. add eggnog , vanilla , and egg yolks
5. beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth
6. add flour mixture and beat at low speed until just combined
7. do not overmix
8. drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet 1 inch apart
9. sprinkle lightly with nutmeg
10. bake 20 to 23 minutes until bottoms turn light brown
target.review: These cookies were delicious! I got a most creative award for these cookies at a cookie exchange party. Everyone raved about these. My only issue was that the recipe made only like 3 dozen cookies (and these were pretty small).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy pumpkin pasta

a delicious recipe for pumpkin that's not a dessert! i usually make my own pumpkin puree in the blender with a little water. this dish is mild and warming; my kids like it because it looks like mac and cheese!

1. in a large skillet , saute the onion and garlic in butter , over medium heat , until soft , not brown
2. whisk in the pumpkin , broth , creams and seasonings to taste
3. simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. meanwhile , boil the pasta in salted water until al dente
5. drain pasta and stir into pumpkin , simmering 2-3 minutes more until thick
6. stir in parsley and garnish with romano , more parsley and pumpkin seeds if desired
demonstrations.review: This was amazing! I was kind of expecting something like pumpkin pie but it definitely had it's own unique flavor. I followed the recipe exactly and we still thought it tasted great! We will be making this one again and again! Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s strawberry shortcake

you won't find this anywhere else this is my own recipe that i developed, the delicious yellow sponge-like cake that is just dense enough to hold the strawberries and whipped cream after making this you won't go back to any other recipe! -- plan ahead the strawberries must sit in the sugar for minimum of 6 hours to release their juices, the more sugar the better! really you can use as much whipped cream and strawberries as desired, the amounts listed are only a guideline! if desired you can make two separate cakes topped with berries and whipped cream in place of the layered. due to the small amount of liquid in the cake it is important to have the eggs and butter at room temperature and the milk lukewarm or all the ingredients will not incorporate together while mixing.

1. wash and remove the stems from each berry then slice
2. place the sliced berries into a glass bowl , add in 3 / 4 - 1 cup cup sugar toss with a spoon until well coated
3. cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or up to 6 hours
4. generously grease two 8-inch round cake pans
5. in a large bowl using an electric mixer at medium speed cream together the butter and sugar until well blended
6. add in eggs and extracts beat on medium speed for 4-5 minutes or until no sugar granules remain in the mixture
7. add in milk
8. mix until combined
9. in a small bowl mix the flour with baking powder and add to the creamed mixture
10. beat until combined
11. divide and spread the batter between the two prepared baking pans
12. set oven to 350f
13. bake for about 22 minutes or until cakes test done
14. cool the cakes slightly in pan then invert each cake onto a plate to cool completely
15. place half of the strawberries with a little juice over the top of one cake , then dollop half of the whipped cream
16. top with the other cake , then strawberries and top with remaining whipped cream
demonstrations.review: The cake was great - nice and spongy. I cooked it for the total 22 minutes and may cook it a little less next time to make it slightly more moist. I used my own strawberry cake filling. I also weighed out my flour (250 g for 2 cups) so people that had a dryer cake should watch out for over adding on the flour.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
poverty meal

when i was a child, my family used to eat this at least once a week due to the fact that it is inexpensive and a little goes a long way. we also added fresh herbs or sometimes whole kernel corn. its even better the next day and it freezes well.

1. saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent
2. brown ground beef and drain
3. add ground beef , tomatoes , water , raw macaroni , salt and pepper to the onion and garlic mixture
4. cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. if desired , top with parmesan cheese
6. serve with crusty bread and a salad
demonstrations.review: This is a great base recipe. Without adjusting the recipe at all, it was very bland and not very good. I added a can of corn, basil, oregano, cumin, cayenne, and two jalapenos. This made for a pretty spicy Mexican variety which had great flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mocha brownies with coffee frosting

i love this recipe because it is easy to mix up, i usually have everything on hand and they taste woooonderful. the frosting is optional.

1. preheat oven to 350f grease a 13x9 inch pan
2. melt shortening and butter over low heat or in the microwave
3. remove from heat and add cocoa , blend well
4. add sugar and mix well
5. dissolve instant coffee in hot water and mix into creamed mixture
6. add eggs one at a time , beat well , by hand , after each addition
7. stir in vanilla , flour , and salt
8. do not over beat !
9. bake 25-30 minutes
10. cool completely before frosting
11. for frosting , cream butter and vanilla
12. add powdered sugar and mix in well on medium speed
13. dissolve instant coffee in milk and add to mixture
14. beat on high until light and fluffy
demonstrations.review:
These were amazing. My fiancee loves coffee and suggested these. 
They are so moist. He doesn't really like frosting so we omitted this and they were still delicious. I'll probably try the frosting next time to see how it tastes. I'd also like to try instant cappuccino mix to see how that turns out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tiramisu cupcakes  uses cake mix

these are delicious tiramisu cupcakes.  they are relatively easy to make as they use a boxed cake mix.  read recipe in entirety first - it sounds more complex then it actually is.  you can decorate these to be quite elegant & fancy in presentation for brunches, bridal showers, or whatever suits your needs.  these sell at gourmet bakeries, coffee shops & cafe's for a pretty penny.  note:  i do use mascarpone to make these as that is more traditional, but you could substitute with plain cream cheese if needed.
also, i do use cupcake liners because i think they present better.
lastly, it's best to prepare mascarpone filling & chill about 4-6 hours in advance or night before.
fyi:  you can fill the cupcakes by using a icing decorating (piping) bag filled with the mascarpone filling or use an old fashioned ketchup or mustard plastic bottle with nozzle point tip << yes, those ugly yellow & red things :-)
*** update:  some of you contacted me about skipping the pastry bag step, that's completely fine, what you need to do is leave room when filling cupcake wrappers by not filling all the way, after cupcakes are baked, you poke the holes & do the liquid coffee over top of poked cakes, then just top with the mascarpone layer (make sure it's chilled well as it thickens) then just use the cream cheese frosting on top of that & top with chocolate shavings.

1. make mascarpone filling mix first & allow to chill 4-6 hours or overnight
2. mascarpone filling: beat mascarpone , kahlua and condensed milk until well blended
3. fold in cool whip
4. chill 4-6 hours
5. prepare cupcakes as directed on box of white cake mix & bake accordingly
6. while these are baking prepare the liquid coffee as below
7. liquid coffee: boil 2 / 3 cup water in microwave and stir in instant coffee then powdered sugar & allow to cool to tepid
8. once cooled , use a fork to poke holes into cupcakes so that they will absorb the liquid cofee & then brush liquid coffee onto each cupcake using silicone baking brush
9. i usually make 3 fork piercings across top
10. fill pastry / icing bag with mascarpone filling & inject about 1 spoonful via bag directly into top-center of each cupcake
11. prepare cream cheese buttercream frosting: beat butter and cream cheese until creamy with hand mixer on low
12. slowly add powdered sugar , scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary
13. add vanilla and increase mixer to medium
14. blend until frosting is fluffy
15. frost each cupcake with frosting & garnish with chocolate shavings
demonstrations.review: These were amazing! I made them for an engagement party because the pairs favorite dessert is tiramisu. They loved them. I had a guy friend say he would propose to me right at that moment if I wasn't already married. My husband said these were the best cupcakes he'd ever had. I will be making these again!

target.recipe_text:
basic machine french bread

this is my winner with tammiev and our friends. this recipe is for a 2 pound loaf and has never failed me. i think it is the lack of oil and sugar that they like in this one.

1. add to the bread pan in the order yours needs
2. for mine it is water first
3. then i add half the flour and the salt followed by the rest of the flour and the yeast on top
4. this will run well on the normal , rapid , and delay start cycles
target.review: This bread is amazing!!  It's very light and fluffy with a crispy crust.  DH thinks it's the best bread machine recipe we've made so far.  I made some to serve for dinner with my beef stew and after dinner had to put more in the machine so we would have some for tomorrow.  Thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flourless brownies  sugar free  low carb

source is unknown, but probably a low carb venue

1. preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. melt the chocolate and butter together on stovetop or in microwave
3. add the splenda , eggs , egg yolks , vanilla and cocoa , stirring until well blended
4. pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan
5. bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is great.  I made it for someone on Atkins.  The whole pan was gone shortly after it was baked.  It had a slight eggy taste but I don't know if using less eggs would work.  I haven't tried it yet. This would work really well for Passover.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooked bbq ribs  for crock pot

this is the most perfect recipe for ribs. you can't get them in a restaurant better than this! the meat falls off the bone as you take them out of the crock!

1. do not pre-heat the slow cooker
2. dice up the onion , add to crock pot
3. rub the ribs with salt and pepper , add to crock pot
4. dump bbq sauce on top
5. cook on low setting for 8-10 hours
6. try not to lift the lid too much
7. the meat will fall off the bone !
demonstrations.review: I used Beef instead of pork and 2 portions of Mille's sauce recipe (http://www.recipezaar.com/Smoky-Sauce-for-Ribs-18917).  I left the extra sauce instead of draining it as some suggested because I was serving it with noodles. I also used ribs off the bone so they cooked for less time in the crock pot.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
smoky sauce for ribs

this recipe is dedicated to chef bethany, whose 

1. whisk all of the ingredients together until smooth
2. boil the sauce very briefly and then simmer for half to three quarters of an hour until it has thickened
3. use on pork spareribs or in any of your barbecued meat recipes
4. store refrigerated will last for a few weeks
demonstrations.review: This is great!  I didn't have liquid smoke so I left it out.  I actually made this twice.  Both times I added more garlic powder then called for (we are garlic fans).  The second time I had less than a cup of red wine vinegar so I added a little white wine vinegar with garlic.  I thought it actually came out better that way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oatmeal lacies

these cookies are tasty, thin, and crispy. this recipe is the easiest i have tried. almost fool proof (unless you over bake them).

1. in a blender or food processor , blend 1 cup quick oats to a flour like consistancy
2. in a mixer , combine:oat flour" and brown sugar
3. in a separate bowl combine egg , vanilla , butter , and salt , mix well
4. slowly pour"wet" mixture into"dry" mixture , mix to a thick batter consistancy
5. stir in remaining 1 / 2 cup oats , mix well
6. drop by level teaspoonfulls onto greased cookie sheet about 2-3" apart
7. bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes , or untill edges start turning golden brown
8. remove from cookie sheet while still warm and transfer to a wire cooling rack
9. re-grease pan each time
demonstrations.review: I couldn't get the consistency right with these.  I had to add flour because it was too watery and even then they spread too much.  I couldn't serve them to my guests beacuse they covered the whole cookie sheet, however they sure tasted good when DH and I ate them alone.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lime and ginger grilled salmon

simple and very good salmon!! marinating time 15 minutes. from heart healthy cooking by becel

1. whisk together lime rind , lime juice , oil , ginger and jalapeno
2. set aside a teaspoon of the mixture
3. place salmon steaks in a dish just large enough to hold them
4. pour remaining lime juice mixture over salmon and turn to coat
5. marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes , turnig once
6. preheat bbq to medium high and grease grill
7. bbq salmon turning once , until cooked through , about 3 to 4 minutes on each side
8. remove to platter and spoon reserved lime juice mixture over salmon
9. serve immediately
10. if you wish to broil salmon , place on a rack set over a pan
11. broil about 4 inches from heat , turning once , until salmon is cooked through , about 3 to 4 minutes per side
demonstrations.review: We were looking for something a bit different for our salmon and we really enjoyed this. I used frozen lime juice (fresh squeezed and then froze it) and frozen crushed ginger (store bought) and left out the rind since limes are not in season now. It was still very, very good. I'd love to try this again when I can get the ingredients fresh.

target.recipe_text:
hershey s chocolate cake with frosting

one night i was craving chocolate cake, but we didn't have a mix and i didn't feel like going to the store. i looked on the back of a box of hershey's cocoa and found this recipe. it is just a basic chocolate cake with chocolate frosting, but it is divine. my husband and i both love it and think it is the best cake ever. i will never make chocolate cake from a box again.

1. cake directions: heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. combine dry ingredients in large bowl
3. add eggs , milk , oil and vanilla
4. beat on medium speed 2 minutes
5. stir in boiling water
6. pour into 2 greased and floured 9" round pans
7. bake 30-35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. cool 10 minutes , then remove to wire racks and cool completely
9. frost with "perfectly chocolate" chocolate frosting
10. this also makes about 30 cupcakes
11. frosting directions: melt butter
12. stir in cocoa
13. alternately add powdered sugar and milk , beating on medium speed to spreading consistency
14. add more milk , if needed
target.review: Really good chocolate cake! I used another brand of Cocoa and sprinkled hazelnuts over the top and tasted amazing. I used skim milk for both cake and frosting, and butter for the frosting. I took the cake to the Swiss Club Family Day (my boyfriend's family are Swiss, and you all know Switzerland makes the best chocolates on Earth) and everybody liked it (the cake was gone in seconds). My boyfriend fell in love with the frosting. Definitely a keeper!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheating scalloped potatoes

i know puritans will scream "you can't do this, it's not right etc. etc." but if you are in a hurry and want delicious scalloped potatoes take this shortcut. if you wish you can put some cheddar cheese on top for the last 15 minutes and add a few extra mushrooms.

1. in a bowl mix the cream of mushroom soup , milk , salt and pepper
2. set aside
3. grease a 13"x9"x2" oven proof dish
4. put 1 / 3 of the potatoes , 1 / 3 of the onions , 1 / 3 melted butter , 1 / 3 flour and a 1 / 3 of the soup mixture in the greased dish
5. repeat with two more layers , ending with the soup mixture
6. bake uncovered at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 and 1 / 2 hours or until potatoes are done and golden
demonstrations.review: Delicious!!! I followed the recipe exactly as directed  (added cheese on top too) and it tasted so good even two days later (even better). I ate them with Dijon Breaded Chicken Breasts and it was really good. Next time I will try with pork chops. Thanks for posting!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white wine and garlic mushroom cream sauce

i got this delicious recipe from a chef at a restaurant where it was served with chicken. it also goes great with pasta or as a risotto sauce. it's easy to make but tastes very expensive!

1. fry the onion , garlic and mushrooms in a little olive oil
2. do not fry them long enough to change their colour
3. add the wine and simmer for about 5 minutes until the wine has largely soaked in
4. crumble in the stock cube
5. add the cream
6. reduce the heat to slowly bring to the boil and leave to simmer and thicken- this should take 5-10 minutes
7. if it does not thicken enough , add a little more chicken stock cube and simmer a bit longer
demonstrations.review: Absolutely amazing!! I used half-and-half because that's what I had, and canned mushrooms. It still turned out great. I served over spaghetti and chicken breast with some parmesan cheese sprinkled on top. One of my favorite recipes now. Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sticky sesame chicken tenders

quick alternative to sesame chicken cooked in the oven!  from relish!relish!

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. line a large shallow baking pan with foil and spray with cooking spray
3. in a medium bowl , add the garlic , salt , soy sauce , hoisin , honey , oil and a pinch of cayenne
4. add the chicken tenders to the sauce and turn to coat
5. arrange the tenders in a single layer on the baking pan , turning over once , until cooked through , about 20 minutes
6. sprinkle the chicken with the toasted sesame seeds and onions and serve
demonstrations.review: It was not sticky at all but the taste was really good. I will definitely do it again. Maybe the next time I will cut the chicken tenders and cook them in a skillet. However, I love the taste of the sauce (it was just like the Asian restaurants here). Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple cinnamon buttermilk pancakes

cooking time will vary depending on the size of the pancake.

1. in a large bowl , mix together the baking soda , flour , baking powder , brown sugar , salt and cinnamon
2. in another bowl , whisk together the eggs , buttermilk , sour cream and melted butter
3. add to the flour mixture and stir just until the flour is moistened
4. stir in the grated apple
5. drop a scant 1 / 4 cup of batter onto a hot lightly greased griddle
6. cook , turning once until golden brown
demonstrations.review: I hade only half of the recipe but used 1 cup of homemade buttermilk instead of the half (3/4 cup). The pancakes were very fluffy and thick. I am waiting for my boyfriend to see if he likes :) Also made a cinnamon syrup and it was perfect. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oatmeal peanut butter cookies

here is the best of both worlds, when you can't decide which is better. i feel like, at least we are eating something sort of healthy. ( do ya think?)

1. cream butter
2. gradually add sugar , beating well
3. add eggs and peanut butter , and beat well
4. combine oats , flour , soda , salt , and cinnamon
5. add in creamed mixture , beating well
6. stir in raisins
7. drop dough by heaping teaspoonsfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets
8. bake at 350f for 10-11 minutes
9. cool slightly on cookie sheets
10. remove to wire racks
demonstrations.review: I really liked these cookies. I made the recipe exactly as directed. Althought my roommate and I enjoyed them, I am disappointed with the fact that my bf did not, because of the peanut butter (he likes everything I cook and oatmeal cookies are his favorite cookies).

target.recipe_text:
our favourite lemon loaf

this is soooo nummmmy!! for lemon lovers. very good warm or cold. (have been making this for years and cannot remember where it came from, probably from my mom.)

1. in a large bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. add eggs , one at a time , beating until creamy
3. blend in milk
4. in another bowl , mix together flour , baking powder , salt and lemon rind
5. pour into batter
6. stir to moisten
7. scrape into greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
8. bake in 350f degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes
9. cool in pan for 5 minutes
10. remove to rack and while still hot , with a toothpick poke holes all over the top of the loaf , and spoon glaze evenly over
11. cool
12. glaze: combine lemon juice and sugar in saucepan
13. stir and heat till sugar is dissolved
14. spoon evenly over top of hot loaf
target.review: I wanted a buttery loaf cake that only required 2 eggs. So glad I found this one. I didn't add the lemon rind because I was too tired to do that extra step ��. Next time I will because I love citrus cakes. I really loved this cake and the texture was great. Thanks for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
scones to die for

this recipe came from my joy of cooking. they are absolutely spectacular.i think i added a bit more sugar. taste like excellent shortbread.

1. heat oven to 425
2. mix flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
3. cut in butter with pastry blender
4. cut until size of peas
5. stir in currants or cranberries and rind
6. stir together egg , and cream and dump into dry mix
7. stir til a ball then gently knead five times
8. pat into a round 8" wide , about 3 / 4" thick
9. cut into 8 or 12 wedges and place on ungreased cookie sheet
10. brush tops with cream and sugar and cinnamon if desired
11. bake 12- 15 minutes
12. oh my , then enjoy
demonstrations.review: I enjoyed the texture. Mine came out good. I added cinnamon and vanilla glaze on top. The only problem, I added too much cinnamon. Will make these again when I'm in the mood for another scone, but I'll put blueberries in them with lemon glaze on top.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple sweet scones

this is a simple perfectly delicious recipe my mom used to make for our family. it origioually came from a biscuits and scones recipe book, this one was always my favorite of all the recipes.

1. heat oven to 425f
2. put flour , baking powder and salt into a large bowl
3. stir mix well add butter and cut in with a pastry blender or rub in with your fingers , until the mixture looks like fine crumbs
4. add sugar
5. toss to mix
6. add milk and stir with a wooden spoon until dough forms ,
7. place dough on floured counter and knead gently until the dough comes together in a ball
8. pat or roll into a circle about 1 1 / 2 inches thick
9. cut each circle into 6 or 8 wedges
10. place wedges on a greased cookie sheet- slightly apart for crisp sides , touching for soft
11. bake about 12 minutes , or until medium brown on top
demonstrations.review: I added fresh blueberries so they wouldn't taste plain. But after baking I tried them and they were too doughy tasting. The texture was doughy also. I then put lemon glaze on top which gave it a great flavor, but still too doughy. Without it had no flavor. However, after sitting for several hours on my countertop the taste and texture was a lot better. I actually ate most of them yesterday. This morning I slightly reheated a couple, which I'm having with my coffee. I don't know why mine came out doughy. But I'm glad the end results were good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: I made several modifications for taste and because certain things I didn't have at home. For taste instead of salt I used 1 1/2 seasoned salt. I used 1 pound ground beef and 1/2 pound Italian breakfast sausage (because I wanted to try this combo for meatballs). I used 1 1/2 garlic powder, 1/4 teaspoon basil because I didn't have any oregano. I also added about 2 tablespoons of chopped onions. I then used 2 teaspoons of dried parsley because I had no fresh. I baked them for 20 minutes at 350. Then I put them in the sauce. Before putting them in the sauce, I tried a small one. It was delicious. It was the best meatball I ever had. You may say I changed the whole recipe. What was changed was the flavor, but the moist comes from the right amount of meat, milk, cheese, breadcrumbs and eggs; Which is what I was looking for. Now I have a meatball recipe that's edible and moist. I was tempted to not put them in the sauce. The are not dry at all. Thanks...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ghirardelli  s ultimate chocolate chip cookies

this is from the ghirardelli website. i've made these and they are great!

1. preheat oven to 375
2. stir flour with baking soda and salt , set aside
3. in large mixing bowl , cream butter with sugar , brown sugar , eggs and vanilla
4. gradually blend dry mixture into creamed mixture
5. stir in nuts and chocolate chips
6. drop tablespoon of dough per cookie onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. bake at 375 for 9-11 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: Great recipe. I've made the cookies on the back of Ghiradelli's package and knew they tasted better than regular tollhouse cookies. That was several years ago. I had a taste for chocolate chip cookies several weeks ago and made the recipe which is the same as tollhouse. The taste I was going for was Ghiradelli's so I didn't car for the cookies. These cookies I like better than the regular tollhouse cookies. Just a tad bit sweeter. But I can live with that - lol.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crispy baked chicken leg quarters  very easy  one dish

this is one that i adapted from recipe #199636 after i scored 4 huge chicken leg quarters on sale. ($0.39 a pound!). i added a few things and adjusted the cooking time and temp to to what worked for me. the skin got so crispy and the chicken was moist and retained the flavors. it also fell off the bone. i hope you enjoy! update 11/13/15: thank you for all of the great reviews! i am so glad it's such a hit! make sure you check out the reviews for some other ideas on how to switch it up a little (but the original is still my personal favorite).

1. preheat oven to 375
2. line a large glass baking dish with foil
3. you can also add a baking rack to the pan to keep the chicken out of the grease and to help air circulate and make it crispier
4. remove excess fat from chicken quarters
5. separate the skin from the chicken , taking care that the skin stays attached at most points on the chicken
6. brush the chicken with soy sauce
7. sprinkle some garlic powder , seasoned salt and dill weed on the chicken under the skin and rub into the chicken
8. arrange the leg quarters in the pan , skin side up , taking care not to crowd
9. they need space to cook properly
10. brush both sides of the leg quarters with soy sauce
11. sprinkle the skin with garlic powder , seasoned salt and dill weed
12. place on middle rack in over and bake uncovered for an hour
13. after an hour , increase oven temp to 400 and bake 15 minutes
14. chicken is done when internal temp reaches 165
15. let stand for 5 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: I didn't use the recipe but I did us the cooking method. I have to say they came out great. My husband (who barely comments on my meal) sad they were good. I'm making this again today, but I'm going to try the actually recipe with the soy sauce and dill. My husband don't like dill, but I do. Will post update on the flavor. UPDATE: I just tried this recipe with the actual ingredients and the flavor is excellent. I was skeptical of trying soy sauce with the dill, but that makes this good. I've tried this recipe with my own seasoning and thought it was good. But seasoning with dill and soy sauce is "the bomb" (lol). Next time I make it I'll make it like this so my husband can try. I think even he will like it. This is truly a great recipe. Thanks for posting :). UPDATE AGAIN: My husband eats it. Didn't comment about the dill. Making it again today.

target.recipe_text:
grilled tuna steak

this is a yummy and quick dish. don't over cook. i like my tuna still pink inside. left overs are great cold on a green salad!

1. put all marinade ingredients into a zip-lock bag shake and add tuna
2. zip and chill for 2 hours
3. place steaks on a clean , hot , oiled , grill
4. and marinade in pot and reduce to half
5. and turn after 3 minutes and cook for three more minutes
6. place on serving dish and pour reduced marinade over steaks
target.review: I found this recipe last-minute and decided to make it even though it says to marinate/chill for 2 hours. My steaks only marinated about 10 minutes but it was still oh so good!  I used a cast iron grill pan (since it's freezing outside right now) and it turned out excellent.  The fish was tender and had a wonderful flavor, and the extra sauce was good drizzled over the steaks and veggies. My fiance asked that I make this again soon, with double sauce so we can use it as a salad dressing as well.  Next time I'll marinate and it will probably be even better! Thanks Rita L! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
skillet steak with mushroom sauce

this is delicious and quite easy to prepare, i have even made this recipe using pork tenderloin, the sauce recipe can be doubled if desired, make sure to brown the meat on both sides this will contribute to the flavour of the dish and make certain to leave the steak sit out to almost room temperature so plan well ahead --- this is very good!

1. season the steak with pepper , then let the steak sit out to almost room temperature , this will help relax the meat fibers and make for a more tender and flavorful steak
2. in a large skillet , melt half the butter over high heat
3. brown steak on both sides
4. transfer to a plate
5. reduce heat to med-high
6. add remaining butter to skillet
7. cook onions , mushrooms and thyme , stirring for 10 minutes , or until liquid is released , and the mushrooms are starting to brown
8. add in the garlic and cook for 2 minutes
9. add flour and cook stirring for 1 minute
10. gradually stir in beef stock , cream and horseradish
11. reduce heat , and simmer , stirring for 5 minutes , or until sauce is thickened
12. return steak , and any accumulated juices to pan
13. simmer for 5 minutes , or until steak is desired doneness
14. let steak rest for 5 minutes
15. season sauce with more salt and pepper to taste
16. slice steak thinly across the grain , and serve with the sauce
demonstrations.review: Your title and comments say it all... it is easy and delicious!  I used 16 oz portabella mushrooms and 8 oz white mushrooms.  I had to use an extra Tbsp of flour to make the sauce thick (probably because the portabellas had a lot of juice) but it was excellent.  I was happy with how tender the steak was and we had no leftovers.  (Between my fiance and I, we were stuffed!)  I served this over rice and next time I will try mashed potatoes.  There was a lot of gravy so I might put in an extra 1/2 lb of steak as well and some more horseradish as my fiance can't get enough of it.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked cherry tomatoes with parmesan topping

another winner from bon appetit. a wonderful side dish or appetizer course.

1. pour oil into 13x9x2-inch broilerproof ceramic baking dish
2. add tomatoes , turn to coat with oil
3. sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. top with parsley and cheese
5. preheat oven to 400
6. bake tomatoes just until plump and shiny but not split , about 10 minutes
7. preheat broiler
8. broil until tomatoes begin to split and cheese begins to color , about 2 minutes
9. serve hot or warm
demonstrations.review: Very nice way to dress up grilled chicken! I added 1/4 cup of fresh chopped basil and mixed it in with the tomatoes, oil, parsley, and spices. (Didn't want the herbs to burn). Then I topped it with the fresh parmesan and, since I already had the grater out, I added some fresh grated mozarella (a few swipes, 1/4 cup or less).  Served over grilled chicken with a salad and french bread. Magnifique!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ellie s catfish

low calarie fish recipe that tastes fried.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. spray pam over the baking sheet
3. combine garlic and milk in a bowl set aside
4. combine cornmeal , thyme , basil , lemon pepper , and cajun seasoning in a bowl , set aside dip catfish filets in milk then in cormeal mixture
5. place on prepared baking sheet and sprinkle fish with paprika
6. spray catfish with cooking spray
7. bake for 20- 30 minutes , until the crust is golden and fish flakes easily
demonstrations.review: This was an excellent alternative to fried catfish.  I followed the instructions and sprayed the fish with cooking spray before baking but the thyme and basil both burned and the flavor was a little off.  Next time I will either eliminiate those spices completely or give it a spray every 5-10 mins while baking. I'm sure it would be still be great without those 2 spices as the cajun and lemon pepper tasted good.  Despite the burned spices it still came out very pretty with the paprika on top.  Thanks Ellie!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
emeril s creamed spinach

i saw this recipe on food tv's web site and had to try it. i love his recipes and this one is no exception. i make it several times a year.

1. preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. lightly grease a 6 cup casserole
3. in a large saute pan , melt the remaining butter
4. add the onions and season with salt and pepper
5. saute for about 2 minutes , or until the onions are soft
6. add the spinach
7. season with salt and pepper
8. saute for 3 to 4 minutes
9. add the garlic and cream
10. mix well
11. season the mixture with salt and pepper
12. bring the liquid to a boil and reduce to a simmer
13. simmer the mixture for 6 minutes
14. remove the pan from the heat and turn into the prepared pan
15. add 1 / 2 of cheese to casserole and stir
16. sprinkle the top with the remainder of the grated cheese and place in the oven
17. bake for about 4 to 6 minutes or until the cheese is slightly brown and bubbly
demonstrations.review: MMM! This is so addicting. I made this for Thanksgiving and it was my favorite dish our of the whole meal.  I cooked my first Thanksgiving dinner (for 2, fiance and myself) so we had a lot of leftovers.  This was the first one we went for the next day!  We used the sharp cheddar leftover from the recipe and put slices on crackers with a spoonful of hot creamed spinach and a drop of Tabasco.  YUM!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chili s fajitas by todd wilbur

update: this recipe was created by todd wilbur for his cookbook "top secret restaurant recipes" (penguin random house 1997). www.topsecretrecipes.com. 

serve on flour tortillas with cheese, guacamole, sour cream, tomatoes, and lettuce.

1. combine the lime juice , water , oil , garlic , soy sauce , salt , liquid smoke , cayenne pepper , black pepper and either the sirloin or the chicken in a tupperware container , cover , and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight
2. discard leftover marinade
3. grill meat over medium flame 4-5 minutes on each side
4. cut meat into thin strips
5. set aside and keep warm
6. combine the 2 tbls
7. water , soy sauce , lime juice , salt , pepper and olive oil
8. set aside
9. cook onion and peppers in oil until brown
10. remove from heat
11. pour reserved mixture over onions and peppers
12. combine meat , onions , and peppers
demonstrations.review: WOW! I followed this recipe exactly using chicken and it was the best Mexican meal I have made by far!  The meat was super tender and moist and the flavor was great! I will be making this again soon with sirloin.  Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
stuffed turban squash

very savory and makes for a very hearty side dish.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. cut the top off the turban squash , as you would for a jack-o-lantern type pumpkin
3. scoop out seeds and pulp and discard
4. place turban squash , cut sides down , on an oiled or foil covered baking sheet , and cover with more foil
5. roast for 50-60 minutes or until tender
6. scoop out tender pulp from cavity of squash
7. in a saucepan , saute onions , celery , sausage and diced carrot in butter until vegetables are tender
8. drain any fat
9. mix in brown sugar , bread crumbs , salt , pepper , and cooked squash
10. stir until well-mixed
11. spoon filling lightly into the cavity of the turban squash , and cover with the top
12. place extra filling into a separate dish
13. bake squash and any extra filling for 20-25 minutes or until heated through
14. serve hot
target.review: Thanks Sue. I have been looking for something to do with winter squash. This was fantastic! I didn't have the turban so I used a buttercup squash and I used maple flavored sausage. The turban must have a thicker rind because it fell apart and I just mixed it in a bowl and put it in a small cassarole. I did everything else the same.  Thank you again I definetly will make this again. Bonnie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken pesto

this was my daughter's favorite dish (along with some of her friends). she enjoyed it so much that we had to make it a weekly recipe.

1. prepare pesto sauce according to package direction
2. heat oven to 350 degrees
3. spray rectangular dish with no-stick spray
4. moisten chicken with water , shake off excess , and coat complete with bread crumbs
5. place chicken in baking dish
6. spread pesto sauce evenly over chicken breasts
7. cover each breast with slice of provolone cheese
8. spread mushrooms over cheese
9. bake in oven for 45- 50 minutes
10. serve with pasta
demonstrations.review: I made this recipe today using a Basil pesto recipe I got on the Recipezaar site. This made a great dinner and I definatly will be making it often.  This would make a wonderful "company" dish and it's so easy. Thanks again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
basil pesto

this is a wonderful lemon-flavored pesto. this was my first taste of pesto and i've never gone back!

update as of 2/13/04
i'm glad that you all like this.  i freeze this now and keep it on hand for my spaghetti sauce or others sauces.  it freezes great!

1. mix everything together in food processor except the oil and lemon
2. once everything is mixed well , drizzle with lemon and oil
3. mix until well blended
4. serve on pasta or just about anything that needs a pick me up
5. will keep in refrigerator for 2-3 days
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
Excelllent recipe!! I did use walnuts instead of the pine nuts but it was still great. 
I made the Chicken pesto recipe from Recipezaar today and used this instead of the packaged pesto. Thanks Bonnie.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
batter fried squash blossoms

these squash blossoms are so good and easy to make.

1. blend milk , egg , flour , parmesan cheese , salt and pepper with a fork
2. beat the batter until smooth
3. place flattened squash blossoms in batter , stir gently
4. allow 10 minute soaking time
5. heat oil in a cast iron skillet until hot
6. fry batter coated blossoms until golden
7. turn once , drain on paper towels , place on plate and garnish
demonstrations.review: Thanks Barb I have always wanted to try the fried squash blossoms but this is the first year I have had the plants. I really wasn't sure what to expect but they were great. I think I would make the batter a little thicker next time but the flavor deserves 5 stars. Bonnie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
libbie s creamed asparagus over toast

this is how they make asparagus around my dh's house. it is enough to  make a meatless  meal. it's very satisfying.

1. cut asparagus into 1 inch pieces
2. cover with water and boil until tender
3. add flour to milk
4. stir so there are no lumps
5. drain asparagus , keeping 1 cup liquid
6. add the milk mixture , salt and pepper
7. cook until thick
8. meanwhile , toast the bread , cut into points
9. pour creamed asparagus over toast
demonstrations.review: This is my favorite way to make asparagus. My mother made it this way and her mother and so on. I am going to buy some this week because this is a sure sign that spring is here. This is comfort food at it's best.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gnocchi al gorgonzola

this is a creamy dish. it goes well with the gnocchi. use as a main course or side dish. you could use the sauce on other types of pasta too.

1. put crumbled gorgazola into bowl with melted butter and a pinch of pepper
2. blend with a wooden spoon until creamy
3. stir in parmesan and heated cream
4. keep sauce warm
5. bring a large pan of salted water to a boil
6. add gnocchi carefully to boiling water
7. stir and cook briskly
8. when they come to surface , remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to bowl with the sauce
9. stir well to coat gnocchi with sauce
10. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: I made this as a side dish Christmas Eve. Even my son and DIL liked it. Neither one likes any type of bleu cheese. I would cut down on the amount of butter but the taste was wonderful. Thank you for the wonderful recipe...Bonnie

target.recipe_text:
harvest pumpkin apple bread

all the flavors of autumn combined into one scrumptious bread. this tastes great with coffee or tea! i make this using egg beaters and unsweetened applesauce in place of half the oil to make it healthier. prep time includes cooling time.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans
3. combine flour , cinnamon , baking soda and salt in large bowl
4. combine sugar , pumpkin , eggs , vegetable oil and apple juice in large mixer bowl
5. beat until just blended
6. add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture
7. stir just until moistened
8. fold in apples
9. spoon batter into prepared loaf pans
10. bake for 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
12. remove to wire racks to cool completely
13. to make using three 8 x 4-inch loaf pans: prepare as above and bake for 60 to 65 minutes
14. to make using five or six 5 x 3-inch mini-loaf pans: prepare as above and bake for 55 to 60 minutes
target.review: I made this wonderful moist bread last night and am so glad I finally tried it.  I used half oil and half applesauce and used Splenda Baking Blend rather than sugar.  I made one 9x5 loaf and 3 mini loaves.  I figured to take the minis out after an hour and let the larger loaf keep baking, but happily all were done after just one hour.  I took the larger loaf to the office to share, and the 3 minis are in the freezer.  I know I'll make this again, with the only possible addition being some other spices (nutmeg, ginger, etc).  Mmmmm...thanks Kree!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apricot chicken thighs

nan

1. combine all but chicken and dried apricots
2. mix well , set aside
3. trim excess fat from chicken
4. rinse chicken with cold water , pat dry
5. place chicken in a 12 x 8 x 2" baking dish
6. pour reserved apricot nectar mixture over chicken
7. cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
8. uncover , and place aproicot halves in apricot nectar mixture
9. continue baking , uncovered , 15 minutes or until chicken is tender
10. remove chicken to a warmed serving platter , discarding apricot nectar mixture
11. garnish each thigh with 2 apricot halves
12. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: A simple-to-prepare recipe that yields tender and tasty chicken.  I cooked 7 b/s chicken thighs, and they stayed in the oven a bit longer than necessary waiting for DH to get home from work.  We all enjoyed our meal.  Served with your Rosemary Potatoes #116863.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta with peanut sauce

low fat and no cook- what could be better for a quick meal?

1. stir sauce ingredients in large bowl
2. add cole slaw mix and cooked drained pasta
3. stir to mix
demonstrations.review: 4 1/2 stars, actually!  I was very happy eating this nice peanutty sauce but I did reduce the soy sauce quite a bit since 3 tbs seemed like it would be way too much.  I just used a couple of tsp and that was plenty.  I'm not the world's biggest tomato sauce fan, so finding something different to put on pasta was a welcome change for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asian baked chicken in vinegar sauce

found this while using web search, while looking for something new to do with chicken. easy to make & family liked it very much.

1. place chicken breasts in grease 9x13 dish
2. mix all remaining ingredients& pour over chicken
3. cover tightly with foil
4. use toothpick to poke 6 holes in foil
5. bake at 350f 35-45 minutes
demonstrations.review: Great flavor and easy to make.  I did uncover the chicken after awhile so that it would brown somewhat.  It was a little less than tender, probably due to cooking too long.  I intend to try this in the crockpot next.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken marseilles

quick and easy chicken recipe.

1. melt butter in skillet
2. place chicken breasts in skillet and brown for about 15 minutes , turning occasionally
3. stir in 2 cups water , soup mix and dill into skillet and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer , stirring occasionallyl for 25-30 minutes until chicken is tender
5. remove chicken to a plate
6. add sour cream to skillet and stir until creamy
7. place chicken over hot brown rice and spoon sour cream sauce over chicken before serving
demonstrations.review: This is a very tasty and simple way to make a chicken dinner that seems a little fancier than most.  I have the same one on a Knorr pamphlet (mine calls it Country French Chicken Skillet) but the proportions are a bit different.  So I tried your recipe and I think I like it better.  I cooked just two chicken breasts, about 5 minutes per side, and used about 1 1/2 cups of the water.  And I don't bother taking the chicken from the pan before adding the sour cream at the end.  This one is a frequent dinner at our house.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hawaiian lemonade

a combination of lemonade, pineapple, apricot and ginger ale. great non-alcoholic drink for your next luau!

1. in a pitcher combine lemonade concentrate and water
2. add apricot nectar and pineapple juice
3. stir well
4. add ice cubes , ginger ale and lemon slices to garnish and give another quick stir
5. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: A nice blend of flavors.  I made this for lunch when an old high school friend came for a visit.  She said it reminded her of something her grandmother used to make for her, so she was quite pleased. I would have liked the apricot flavor to be more noticeable personally.  I had originally posted this same recipe, but had never tried it, so I'm glad I finally did.

target.recipe_text:
bbq chicken and chipotle salad

this has to be the most requested recipe in my way-too-vast collection. it comes from chiffonade chef on the fc site, and she submitted it to gourmet magazine some years ago. it was accepted and printed almost immediately. it's so easy, and so tasty, you will see why.

1. in a large bowl , whisk together bbq sauce and mayo
2. finely chop chipotle and whisk into dressing
3. discard bones from chicken and cut meat into 1 / 2 inch pieces
4. finely chop enough onion to measure 1 / 3 cup
5. finely chop bell pepper and cilantro and add to dressing with chicken and onion
6. combine well
7. season salad with salt& pepper
8. serve in lettuce cups with a nice crusty baguette
target.review: Yum Yum! I love barbecue sauce and cilantro together and this salad really is delicious. My favorite little pizza place that served barbecued chicken pizza with cilantro and red onion on it closed down, but now I can whip up this salad and satisfy my cravings. Thanks LLBunny!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
special green bean casserole

great for holiday dinners.

1. saute onion in butter
2. add flour , salt , sugar and pepper
3. mix in sour cream , beans and cheese
4. pour into 9x13 baking dish
5. top with cornflakes
6. bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review:
Yummy! The only change I made is I used fresh green beans and blanched them first and omitted the sugar. These are wonderful and tasty and a great way to get my fussy DH to eat his veggies!
Great recipe Laura.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
appetizing zucchini puffs

something quick and low carb. pretty yummy!

1. preheat the broiler part of your oven
2. halve the zucchini and scoop out a little of the center
3. combine the cheese , mayonaise and hot pepper sauce
4. spread on top of zucchini
5. broil until puffed
6. cut into small serving pieces
demonstrations.review:
This is a new regular at my house. I broiled them for about 5 minutes about 6-7 inches away from the broiler and they turned out great. Just the right amount of crunch and delicious too! I can't wait to serve them to guests.
Thanks Mirj!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy zucchini and ground beef pizza casserole

this is a fast and really tasty dish!  you can use your own favorite pizza sauce for this, i use my own recipe #65641.

1. set oven to 400f
2. grease a 13x9 pan
3. place zucchini in strainer
4. sprinkle with salt
5. let drain for 10 minutes
6. squeeze out moisture
7. combine zucchini with eggs , parmesan cheese , and half of the cheddar and mozzarella cheese
8. press into greased 13x9 baking pan
9. bake at 400f for 20 minutes
10. meanwhile , brown ground beef with garlic and onions , season with salt and pepper
11. drain any fat , and add / mix the tomato sauce
12. spoon over baked zucchini mixture
13. top with remaining cheeses , and sprinkle with green pepper
14. return to oven and bake for another 20 minutes more
demonstrations.review: This is a great way to get a pizza fix without the carbs. I used ground turkey breast and Don Pepino brand pizza sauce (I think this brand tastes as close to pizzeria sauce as you can get). Really filling - served with a nice salad and it was a great meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach mushroom   artichoke casserole

delicious! emeril's recipe adapted, from food tv

1. preheat oven to 350
2. grease 13x 9 x 2 pan
3. in skillet heat butter , onions , garlic , saute , add mushrooms , cook til soft , remove from heat put in bowl , add spinach , artichokes , cheeses , mushrooms , mix
4. mix eggs w / nutmeg in small bowl , add to mix
5. place in casserole dish , sprinkle w / breadcrumbs
6. sprinkle w / parm cheese , bake 45-50 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is definitely a hearty meal all by itself. The only thing I omitted was the bread crumbs and added a little extra parmesan cheese on top and it was heavenly. A great recipe for all you carb counters out there! Thanks Chia.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon rice w  peas   green onions

nan

1. combine 1 3 / 4 cups water , rice , and salt in large saucepan
2. cook until just cooked-- do not overcook
3. fluff with fork
4. cool
5. cook peas in medium saucepan of boiling salted water 1 minute
6. drain
7. rinse under cold water
8. drain
9. heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
10. add all but 2 tablespoons green onions
11. saut 30 seconds
12. add rice and saut until heated through , stirring to break pieces , about 4 minutes
13. add peas , lemon juice , parsley , and lemon peel
14. saut 2 minutes to blend flavors
15. garnish with remaining green onions and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Delicious! I used Basmati rice - really great flavors with the lemon zest and parsley and onion. Served it with roasted garlic shrimp and a salad and DH said it was like eating in a fancy restaurant. Thanks for posting Sue.

target.recipe_text:
mystic moon pistachio date nut loaf

a nice and easy to put together quick bread delicious as a morning coffee cake. no overly sweet yet rich with dates pistachios and chunks of chocolate.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. in a small bowl combine flour , baking soda , salt , and cinnamon
3. in a large electric mixer bowl cream together the tahini and brown sugar
4. add the egg and beat until smooth
5. now add the flour mixture and yoghurt alternately , beating well after each addition , ending with youghurt
6. add the vanilla and beat until smooth
7. add the pistachios , dates , and bittersweet chocolate chunks and mix until well blended
8. turn ito a greased and floured loaf pan and bake for about an hour at 350f or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. cool in pan 10 minutes and then turn out onto wire rack to cool completely
target.review: I thought this loaf was quite nice. It was very easy to make, smelled absolutely divine when it was cooking, but was lacking something I thought. Next time I'd definitely add more nuts, because I couldn't taste them. Maybe some cardamom too?? Thanks for posting

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beth s pizza crust

this is an excellent crust that requires no time to rise. why order out when you can just throw this pizza together?

1. combine yeast and warm water
2. stir until dissolved
3. add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. let rest 5 minutes
5. roll out to size and shape you need
6. bake at 450 for 15 minutes or until golden
7. a couple
8. instead , i add several good shakes of italian seasoning mix
9. use your imagination , this is hard to mess up
demonstrations.review: This was my first attempt at making a pizza base, and it was so easy and tasted great. I used a combination of white and wholemeal flour which added a bit extra flavour, next time I will definately put the herbs in. I can't believe how effective this base is, thanks so much for posting xxx

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheeseburger mashed potato pie

my father made this recipe up when we really didn't have any other food in the house, its cheap, and easy to make. the kids will love it.

1. fry the beef in a nonstick pan , and when finished , drain off the fat and set it aside place the potatoes in a medium sized mixing bowl , mash them , or if using the instant , follow the directions on the box
2. add the milk and whip them until creamy
3. in a medium sized baking dish , place a layer of the whipped potatoes about an inch thick
4. add all of the ground beef for the second layer
5. add half of the cheese for the third layer
6. use the rest of the potatoes for the fourth layer
7. add the rest of the cheese on top
8. place in oven and bake at 350f until the cheese is melted and you see part of the potatoes golden brown
9. let it set for five minutes and then serve
demonstrations.review: This was great! I added some frozen veggies into the ground beef mix and used the instant mash potato. Everyone was looking for seconds! A great, easy, cheap and tasty recipe that will be reappearing at our dining table very soon. Thanks for posting xxx

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot leg of lamb

i love the flavour combination of lemon, garlic and herbs with lamb and this recipe fulfills my taste buds' expectations! this is not meant to be a roast, but is meant to be fall apart soft - almost like a mediterranean flavoured "pulled lamb".

1. using the crock pot's ceramic dish , mix together oil , lemon juice , garlic , oregano and nutmeg
2. immerse leg of lamb into the mixture and cook on high for 6- 8 hours until falling apart
3. just before removing meat from crock pot , mix together mint , sugar and vinegar in dish and microwave for 30 seconds until vinegar is hot enough to melt sugar
4. remove meat to serving platter and pull apart with forks until you have chunky shreds of meat
5. drizzle over mint vinegar and serve piping hot
demonstrations.review: This was simply delicious! The first day we had it served with veggies and it was so moist and tender. The second day we had it with salsa and salad wrap in a tortilla, this recipe is a real keeper. Thanks for posting xx

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot apple and brown sugar corned beef

an all-in-one meal that's easy to make and a huge pleaser. i got this recipe from a friend's mother.

1. place all ingredients in a large crock pot
2. stir to mix
3. cook on high for 4 to 5 hours or on low for 8 to 10 hours
4. remove meat and vegetables and some of the cooking liquid
5. slice meat thinly across the grain
6. serve with vegetables and some of the liquid
demonstrations.review: This was absolutely delicious. I followed the recipe exactly. The meat was tender and sweetly flavoured, and it was easy to get my fussy eaters to eat their veggies! Thank you so much for posting what will quickly become a family favourite xxx

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate  chocolate  chocolate  bundt cake with chocolate glaze

need i say more...chocolate! decadently rich and moist. add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and you're in heaven.

1. cake: preheat oven to 350
2. grease and flour bundt pan , set aside
3. in large mixing bowl , combine cake mix , pudding mix and chocolate chips
4. in another bowl , combine water , eggs , and vanilla mixing well
5. add egg mixture to dry mixture and mix with spoon until just blended
6. pour into prepared pan
7. bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done when wooden pick in center comes out clean
8. cool 15 to 20 minutes before removing cake from pan
9. when completely cool , drizzle cake with chocolate glaze
10. chocolate glaze: combine all ingredients in bowl
11. mix with spoon until smooth
demonstrations.review: I made this cake very cheaply with quite inferior ingredients. I used 2 homebrand choc cake mixes, 1 cottees pudding mix and a bag of homebrand milk choc chips. The cake is full of flavour and tastes just like a classic mud cake, the only thing I wasn't keen on was the glaze. Next time I'll make a choc icing, thanks so much for posting xx

target.recipe_text:
cuban meat stew  ropa vieja

this meat stew is delicious and easy. a nice change of pace, and it makes the house smell so good. serve with rice and a salad, or crusty bread. from a goya cookbook--best of the americas-carribean.

1. season steak with adobo
2. in large skillet , heat oil on medium high , brown meat on both sides , remove and keep warm
3. lower heat to medium , add garlic , onion and green pepper , cook-stirring often for about 10 minutes
4. stir in black pepper and tomato sauce and cook , stirring often for about 5 minutes
5. stir in the sofrito , water , sazon and bouillon and bring to a boil
6. return the meat to the pan , cover , lower the heat , and simmer for 45 minutes , stirring it occasionally
7. add in the capers and olives , continue to simmer covered , until the meat is tender and shreds easily
8. this should take about 1-1 / 2 hours
9. you can add more water 1 / 4 cup at a time if the sauce gets too dry
10. to serve , shred the meat with 2 forks and mix back into sauce
target.review: Being Puerto Rican descent, I found the flavors in this stew on point That particular Goya sazon packet is a must - the culantro y achiote. I used our elk stew meat in this and it was great. serve over rice. Unfortunately, where I live it is hard to find the sofrito and that particular sazon packet- requires special trips - so I did with out the sofrito but have lots of the sazon on hand and I found it still to be delicious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot hungarian goulash

this is absolutely delicious and a real favorite in our house.

1. place meat in crockpot and cover with sliced onion
2. combine garlic , ketchup , worcestershire sauce , sugar , salt , paprika and mustard stir in water , mix well , and pour over meat
3. cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours
4. turn control to high
5. dissolve flour in a small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture
6. cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened
7. serve over noodles or rice
demonstrations.review: 3 stars - I liked it.  I used elk meat. For me, after I tossed everything in it was still too ketchupy for my taste so I added approx 1/2 c of tomato sauce.  I would have probably reduced the worstechire to 1T too and increased the water.  I added potatoes too.  After a long day of skiing, (this is where I discovered the need for extra water) I added the recommended 2 T or so of sour cream which added nice body to it too.  It was nice to come home to & served it over buttered noodles and butter glazed carrots.  The husband and his friends that were already home raved. My children -- well, one ate it two left it.  I thought it was okay/good -- probably just not to my taste but would say it's a good representation of a goulash though.  thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashioned banana cream pie

before cool whip and instant pudding, this was how a cream pie was made. if you leave out the bananas, you have vanilla cream pie. if you add 1 cup shredded coconut to milk as it's being heated, you have coconut cream pie.

1. have baked 9-inch pie shell ready
2. in a large saucepan , scald the milk
3. in another saucepan , combine the sugar , flour and salt
4. gradually stir in the scalded milk
5. over medium heat , stirring constantly , cook until thickened
6. cover and , stirring occasionally , cook for two minutes longer
7. in a small bowl , have the 3 egg yolks , slightly beaten , ready
8. stir a small amount of the hot mixture into beaten yolks
9. when thoroughly combined , stir yolks into hot mixture
10. cook for one minute longer , stirring constantly
11. remove from heat and blend in the butter and vanilla
12. let sit until lukewarm
13. when ready to pour , slice bananas and scatter in pie shell
14. pour warm mixture over bananas
15. if desired , make a meringue to top the pie , or just let the pie cool until serving
demonstrations.review: Outstanding pie.  Easy to make, not too sweet.
