no bake rice krispies peanut butter granola bars  lower fat

this is a delicious lower fat bar if using reduced-fat peanut butter, these are perfect for kid's lunch boxes, feel free to add in some chopped nuts or sunflower seeds or coconut in place of the raisins,

1. lightly grease 11 x 7-inch , can use a 13 x 9-inch baking dish but you will have a thinner bar
2. in a large bowl combine rice krispies cereal , oats and raisins
3. in a saucepan stir the corn syrup or honey and brown sugar until just at a boil
4. immediately remove from heat and stir in the peanut butter and vanilla until well combined
5. pour over the dry ingredients in the bowl
6. mix to combine
7. mix in mini chocolate chips work fast the mixture hardens quickly
8. transfer the mixture into prepared baking dish , then using slightly wet hands push evenly down into the pan
9. while the mixture is still soft , for easier slicing take a sharp knife and slice into desired size bars
10. chill until firm
demonstrations.review:
I ran across this while looking thru your other recipes. So glad I did. These are **10**. I have 4 children who love to snack. Make them with your favorite add-ins. They are great.
Thank you for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled bratwurst supper

this is my version of toh's grilled bratwurst supper.  we really enjoyed the wonderful taste of the veggies in this.  very easy to make and easy to clean up.

1. cut bratwurst links into thirds
2. place the bratwurst , potatoes , carrots , onion , garlic and mushrooms in a heavy-duty foil bag or use heavy-duty foil , doubled
3. dot with butter
4. sprinkle with the soup mix , soy sauce and pepper
5. seal tightly and turn to coat
6. grill , covered , over medium heat for 40-45 minutes or until vegetables are tender and sausage is no longer pink , turning once
7. served over rice
demonstrations.review:
This is a must try dish. I would give it 10 stars. So easy to make, no pans to wash, just throw the foil away. The flavors are perfect.
I'm sure you could use other sausage in this dish. The dish maked enough to feed my family of 6. Thank you for sharing a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave english muffin bread

my neighbor makes this all the time and i love it. a neat way to have bread without heating up the oven (too much). cook time includes rise time.

1. combine 3 cups flour , yeast , sugar , salt and soda in large bowl
2. heat milk and water until warm but do not boil
3. add to flour mixture and mix well
4. stir in rest of flour
5. grease 2 glass , 8-inch loaf pans , sprinkle each with cornmeal
6. divide batter into two equal parts and carefully place in pans
7. place pans in large rectangle with water
8. place in oven one warm
9. let rise 35-45 minutes or until dough rises to top of pan
10. place in microwave and bake on high for 6 1 / 2 minutes
11. remove and cool 5 minutes
12. remove from pan and slice
13. wrap in foil and store in freezer
demonstrations.review:
This is so good. I did not have 2 microwave baking dishes so I used a silicone bunt pan.
My microwave is very powerful, so I only had to cook the whole thing for about 7 min. The flavor is great. I am going to slice and freeze it so I can have it for a quick breakfast. 
Thanks for sharing this great recipe. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
passed down fredericksburg  fresh peach cobbler

this is an old texas favorite. so yummy and easy.

1. melt butter until slightly brown pour into an 8-by-12-inch baking dish
2. mix sugar , flour , baking powder , salt , and milk
3. pour into melted butter
4. do not stir
5. cover top of batter with peaches
6. do not mix
7. cover top of peaches with brown sugar
8. bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review:
This is the one. So easy and taste great. I used peaches that I had frozen. I thawed them out (not all the way).
The sweetness was perfect. I topped it with a little white sugar after I took it out of the oven.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ultimate brownies

from the 1990 collection 

1. preheat oven to 325f degrees
2. melt chocolate and butter together in large bowl
3. add sugars
4. mix well
5. add eggs and vanilla , mix well
6. add flour and salt
7. stir until blended
8. add walnuts
9. pour into greased 13x9 pan
10. bake 25 minutes
11. let cool
12. make frosting-------------
13. melt chocolate and butter together
14. stir in milk
15. add powdered sugar
16. beat for 3 minutes or until smooth
demonstrations.review:
These are the best. A keeper. I have been searching for a good brownie recipe and this may be it. I skipped the frosting and added heath chips before baking. 
I want to try adding 1/2 teaspoon of baking powder next time. Lighten them up and still leave them chewy.

target.recipe_text:
simply sour cream chicken enchiladas

easy to assemble, deliciously creamy and a great choice for once-a-month cooking. and there is no canned cream soup in my enchiladas -- hope you give them a try!

1. in a frying pan , cook chicken and onion together in oil over medium-high heat until chicken is just done
2. divide cooked chicken evenly between 8 tortillas
3. add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese to each tortilla
4. roll enchiladas and place seam-side down in a 9x13" baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with no-stick cooking spray
5. melt butter in a medium saucepan
6. stir in flour to make a roux , stir and cook until bubbly , and gradually whisk in chicken broth then bring to boiling , stirring frequently
7. remove from heat
8. stir in sour cream and green chilies
9. pour sauce evenly over enchiladas
10. top with remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese and bake at 400 f for 20 minutes until cheese is melted and sauce near edges of baking dish is bubbly
target.review: My Hubby was crazy about this!!!  I used 3 left over Lemon & Garlic Grilled Chicken Breasts,  (Recipe #222713) sliced into strips and about 2/3 cup of  Sauted Spinach (Recipe #7231) for the filling.  Increased the cheese to 2 cups and added 1tsp. of Hot Sauce to the roux.  Made 8 large enchiladas.  It was incredible.  You'd never guess we were having leftovers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple ranch house meatloaf

easy and tasty served either hot or cold, wonderful sliced cold for a picnic or sandwiches. we have enjoyed this basic meatloaf for many years.try a change, instead of the usual topping, try your favourite salsa brushed on top, a nice chipotle medium or hot salsa is wonderful on it.

1. mix all the meat loaf ingredients together
2. pack into a 5 x 9 loaf pan
3. bake at 325f degrees for 1 1 / 4 hours
4. remove from oven , turn out of pan and place on an ovenproof serving dish
5. topping: mix the topping ingredients
6. brush over the meat loaf and return to the oven for 30 minutes or longer
7. defrost and reheat or use sliced cold
8. alternate topping
9. 4 tablespoons chilli sauce
10. 3 tablespoons splenda
11. 4 tablespoons spreadable soft cream cheese - light
12. 1 tablespoon hot horseradish
13. 1 teaspoon dry mustard
14. combine all and brush on top of meatloaf instead of above topping
demonstrations.review: What a great tasting and easy to prepare meatloaf!  I normally use oatmeal instead of bread crumbs but this loaf wasn't the least bit dry.  I used dried Italian flavored crumbs, dried onion flakes, fresh sage and topped it with Bennett's Chili Sauce.  Made 6 dinner portions and 3 large sandwiches the next day.  ABSOLUTELY DE-LISH!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
classic bistro style gratin dauphinois   french gratin potatoes

this classic french potato gratin dish is world famous, and rightly so! i am quite happy to have this as a main meal, with just some crusty bread and a large mixed salad on the side. i have heard that this famous dish was created as a way of encouraging the "dauphin" (the young prince destined to become king henri ii), to eat up his vegetables, hence the name! maybe - it is certainly just as popular with children, as it is with adults. try to slice the potatoes as thinly as possible for the best results. a wonderful accompaniment for all sorts of roast meats, stews, casseroles and poultry.
this recipe is not strictly french, using as it does a swiss cheese.

1. preheat the oven to 300f / 150c / gas mark 2
2. take a heavy-bottomed dish or an ovenproof gratin dish , and grease it will with some of the butter
3. layer the potato slices in the dish , slightly overlapping each other , seasoning lightly with the salt and pepper , and sprinkling a liberal amount of cheese on each layer
4. sprinkle cheese on the top of the last layer
5. put the double cream , garlic and sprigs of thyme in a pan and bring to them gently to the boil , then remove the thyme and pour hot cream over the potatoes
6. dot the top of the gratin with the remaining butter and some extra cheese if you wish , and bake for about 1 hr to 1 1 / 2 hrs , or until the potatoes are soft , and the top is crispy and golden brown
7. serve bubbling hot as a main meal or as an accompaniment
demonstrations.review:
WOW!!!  This is a great classic potato dish.  A creamy, smooth and rich sauce and an elegant presentation. Easy to assemble if you use a mandoline for slicing. 
I made two thick layers and put about 1/3 of the cheese between them.  Delish!  (2 lbs. of potatoes easily fed 6 adults as a side dish)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy cabbage and noodles

i came up with this one because it's fast---no chopping cabbage.  and it's colorful because of the carrots in the cole slaw mix.  cook time is for noodle boiling.

1. cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. drain
3. in a large skillet , melt butter and saute cole slaw mix , onion and garlic until tender
4. mix in salt and pepper
5. gently stir in cooked and drained noodles
6. toss together
demonstrations.review: I love ethnic food and this recipe couldn't be easier, or better tasting.  I subsituted sauted cheese/potato perogi for the noodles. Served with grilled turkey kielbalsa.  Half recipe easily served 4 adults.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
walt s teriyaki marinade and dipping sauce

this is an old way of making a teriyaki sauce with honey instead of sugar, giving it a more pleasing sweetness.  it's great for marinading and dipping with any kind of meat dish.

1. blend ginger , soy sauce , honey , garlic , and onion in a bowl
2. add meat to marinade for at least one hour or refrigerate meat in marinade overnight
3. after marinating meat , drain the marinade and add it to a 1 / 2 cup of water
4. bring it to a boil for 3-5 minutes and use it for a meat dipping sauce during the meal
5. excellent for pork , beef or chicken
demonstrations.review: I agree with Acerast, I'll never by Teriyaki Marinade again -- this is way better and so easy that my hubby, who doesn't cook, actually put it together.  We maranated 2 pork tenderloins for 12 hours -- grilled them on the BBQ;  and served them thinly sliced with a mustard dipping sauce as a passed appetizer.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon and garlic broiled or grilled chicken breasts

these are so delicious and very easy to prepare.  i like to marinate the chicken one night and grill it the next night.  it's great with grilled vegetables or a salad.  this is from nathalie dupree (a great southern cook from atlanta).  prep time is marinating time.

1. place the chicken breasts skin side up in a glass dish or plastic bag
2. season with salt and pepper
3. combine the oil , lemon juice , garlic and rosemary
4. pour the juice mixture over the chicken and cover the dish with plastic wrap or seal the bag
5. marinate , refrigerated , at least 1 day and up to 2 days for best flavor
6. when ready to serve , place the chicken , skin side turned to the heat , under the broiler or on the grill and cook for 15 minutes
7. turn
8. continue cooking until done , about 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: Used 6 boneless, skinless breasts which I marinated overnight and grilled.  My lemons were very tart so I added one packet of Splenda and one additonal Tablespoon of EVOO for a slightly less acidic marinade.  I served the chicken with Spinach Saute (Recipe #7231)  Even our fussy eaters chowed down!

target.recipe_text:
molasses whoopie pies

these always go well at bake sales. great for brownbag lunches.

1. preheat oven to 375 f degrees
2. cookie: cream butter , sugar and eggs until fluffy
3. add molasses and milk
4. blend well
5. mix in sifted dry ingredients
6. chill for 2 hours in fridge
7. drop by tbls
8. unto greased cookie sheet
9. bake 10 minutes
10. remove and cool on racks
11. filling: whip butter and sugar until fluffy
12. slowly add milk / molasses and incorporate
13. add spice and beat well
14. use as filling between two cookies
target.review: I thought these woopie pies were great! I had these in Maine this summer and was so happy to find the recipe here. I love the ginger cream filling. these will be great to make for the fall season. Thank you

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cracked chocolate chipper cookies

i have had this recipe for so many years, and it is one of my favorite cookie recipes, whenever i bring these over to someone's house, i always end up by having to give out the recipe, as these cookies have such a wonderful appearance and texture.... everyone just goes wild over these yummy cookies...you will too!

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. grease a cookie sheet
3. in a bowl , cream together the shortening , water and brown sugar
4. add eggs and vanilla , beat until well combined
5. in another bowl , sift together flour , baking cocoa , salt and baking soda
6. add the dry mixture to the creamed
7. beat at low speed or with a wooden spoon , until thoroughly combined
8. add in chocolate chips
9. refrigerate for 1 hour
10. remove from fridge
11. shape into 1-1 / 2-inch balls
12. roll balls into icing sugar until very well coated
13. space ball 1-1 / 2- 2 inches apart on the cookie sheet , to allow for spreading
14. bake for 7-9 minutes
15. keep an eye on these , as they bake very quickly
16. cool
17. remove to wire rack
demonstrations.review: I threw these together yesterday to bring to a friends and all I can say is YUM. Everyone loved these and asked for the recipe. They are just so simple and easy to make and taste awsome. Kitten you have done it again. Thank you

demonstrations.recipe_text:
0 fat chunky watermelon salsa

this is fantastic served with grilled seafood or chicken! plan ahead this needs to chill for 30 minutes before serving, this can be made up to 2 hours in advance, but does not keep well overnight.

1. using a small sharp knife cut peel and white pith from the lime
2. then cut the lime into 1 / 4-inch pieces , place the chopped lime in a medium glass bowl
3. add in all remaining ingredients to the same bowl
4. toss to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste
5. cover and chill for 30 minutes before serving
6. serve cold
demonstrations.review: Awsome salas Kitten. Can I give this 10 stars! I used this salsa along side some poached salmon. I will make this again for sure. Next time I may add some garlic and avocado. Thanks for another winner.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chip peanut butter cheesecake

i received this cheesecake recipe from a friend after trying it at her party, it's a very simple cheesecake to make, and is delicious, so creamy and good!  this cheesecake is better if made a day ahead and refigerated to serve the following day. prep time includes chilling time.

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. prepare a springform pan
3. to make the crust: combine crumbs with melted butter
4. press into bottom of the prepared pan
5. for the filling: with an electric mixer , combine all ingrediemts
6. beat for about 5-6 minutes until smooth and creamy
7. add in chocolate chips
8. mix to combine
9. pour into crust
10. bake until set , about 55-60 minutes
11. let stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes
12. meanwhile prepare the topping: blend all topping ingredients together , and spread over cheesecake
13. bake for another 10 minutes more
14. let cake cool at room temperature , then refrigerate for 5 or more hours
demonstrations.review: What can I say but.. EXCELLENT. I made this to take to a friends and everone LOVED it. It has great flavor and is very rich so a little goes a long way.Thank you Kitten for making me so popular at this potluck.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet and spicy sweet potato bake

this is a must at your holiday dinner table, it has just the right balance of sweet and spicy --- cooking time will vary depending on the size you cut the sweet potatoes you will love these!

1. in a resealable plastic bag toss the cubed sweet potatoes with melted butter or oil
2. add the rest of ingredients
3. toss well to coat
4. transfer to a greased baking dish
5. bake uncovered at 400 degrees for about 22-25 minutes , or until sweet potatoes are tender but not too soft
6. delicious !
demonstrations.review: I wanted to try this before Thanksgiving. Needless to say it was fantastic. I don't know if it added anything to this but I added about 3 tbsp. honey too. I love the flavor of honey and chili powder together. Thanks Kitten for another winner.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian tomato onion salad

i made up this recipe as a copy cat to the tomato onion salad served at my favorite italian place.  it's not exactly the same but it's as close as i could get.  this is a great veggie dish to have with pizza, lasagne or any italian dish.  updated to adjust the amounts: i rarely use measuring utensils, especially when i'm making up a recipe and don't have time or the inclination to write everything down as i'm doing it.  after reading your reviews i did notice some problems with the recipe...hopefully i've fixed them!

1. cut tomatoes into wedges scraping all juice , seeds and pulp into a mixing bowl
2. slice the onion into thin strips
3. in the mixing bowl combine the onion , tomatoes , lemon juice , cider vinegar and sea salt , stir
4. let sit for at least an hour to let the salt tenderize the tomato and onion
5. stir often
6. add basil , oregano , garlic , olive oil and red pepper to taste
7. let marinate 30 minutes
8. serve with crusty italian bread or sour dough flute slices
demonstrations.review: This was loved by all. I did cut back on the garlic salt to 2tsp.  to suit our tastes. ( I knew just by looking at the amount that the 2-3 would be too salty for us. ) And it was just perfect for us. I will be making this again. Thank you

target.recipe_text:
creamy grape salad

absolutely fabulous!!  i first tasted this wonderful dish at a potluck dinner after our homecoming service at church.  i was fortunate to find the person who had brought this salad.  i never knew grapes could be so delicious with cream cheese!  i hope you enjoy it as much as our family does.

1. remove any stems from grapes and wash
2. set aside
3. in a medium size bowl , mix cream cheese , sour cream , sugar and vanilla
4. fold in grapes and pour into a large serving dish
5. spread mixture evenly in serving dish
6. mix brown sugar with cinnamon and pecans
7. sprinkle over top of grape mixture
8. place in refrigerator to chill
9. serve and enjoy !
target.review: What a happy ending to our BBQ!  Everyone commented how good it was and we all went back for seconds!  That just about sums up how good it was!  Thanks so much for this addicting new dessert.  We will cherish the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
joni s summer squash casserole

this recipe is so tasty, and one that my sister introduced me to... goes great with just about any meal, and especially with baked pork chops, chicken, or turkey.  our family loves this, and we have been making it for years... great for thanksgiving or christmas too, in place of stuffing!

1. preheat oven to 325
2. put stuffing mix into a lg
3. zip-lock bag , and roll with a rolling pin , to make stuffing into fine crumbs
4. melt margarine , and mix with the crumbs , in a lg
5. bowl
6. put 1 / 2 crumbs on bottom of a 9x13" pan
7. mix the rest of the ingredients well
8. pour squash mixture on top of crumbs
9. top with remaining crumb mixture
10. bake for 1 hours
11. you can spoon these into little oblong aluminum pans , and freeze until ready to use
demonstrations.review: This is about the best squash casserole we have ever had and the family insists we have it for the holidays along with our dinner.  I can't wait to have it again!  I am going to double the batch and freeze some in aluminum pans so we can have it whenever we feel like pulling it out of the freezer!  Awesome side dish that will go well with just about anything your cooking.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s famous coleslaw

this is the most delicious coleslaw that you will ever have! i make this for weddings, large socials and in the summer for bbq's and parties, and there is never anything left it all goes and everyone wants the recipe --- plan ahead the coleslaw needs to be refrigerated for the stated time to blend the flavors, this coleslaw will intensify in flavor with chilling time --- this is not a thick heavy dressing like some other coleslaw recipes it's the perfect texture and flavor and what makes this coleslaw stand out from all others is the fresh lemon juice so please use only fresh i have used bottled in the past and it is just not the same --- the dressing amount will yield enough for two 16-ounce packages prepared coleslaw mix or 1 head of green cabbage --- for one 16-ounce package prepared coleslaw mix use the dressing amounts posted on bottom of recipe and add in 3 or more large of chopped green onions.   for more kittencal's recipes, visit my recipe site www.recipezazz.com

1. in a food processor chop the cabbage into small pieces or shred the cabbage
2. transfer to a large mixing bowl
3. with a fine shredder , shred the peeled carrots
4. add to the cabbage in the bowl
5. chop the green onion finely
6. add to the cabbage / carrot mixture along with the celery seed
7. mix the three veggies all together with a wooden spoon
8. to make the dressing: in a medium glass bowl whisk together all the dressing ingredients starting with the lower amounts then adding in and adjusting to suit taste but using 1 / 3 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar
9. pour over the veggies in the bowl , and mix well to combine
10. store covered in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours or overnight to blend flavors
11. for one 16-ounce package coleslaw mix use the following amounts
12. 1 / 2 cup mayonnaise / 2-1 / 2 tablespoons milk / 2-1 / 2 tablespoons buttermilk / 1-1 / 2 tablespoons vinegar / 1-1 / 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice / 3-1 / 2 tablespoons sugar / 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder / 1 / 2 teaspoon seasoned salt , or to taste
demonstrations.review: How could I resist with all the great reviews and Kitten's pledge that it's the best I will ever have!  She was right of course!  It is the best I have ever had.  I let set in the fridge for several hours and I think this is the key to any good coleslaw!  Went well with Recipe #238069, gravy, carrot casserole and garlic mashed potatoes!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
classic chocolate mousse

there are a lot of mousse recipes out there. this is the one i prefer. easy to make and so good. it makes me happy!

1. for mousse: heat whipping cream gently in double-boiler or small saucepan until it comes to a simmer
2. remove from heat and add chocolate
3. stir until the chocolate has completely melted
4. whisk in the egg yolks and brandy
5. set aside to cool completely
6. beat 1 / 3 cup cream , sugar and vanilla in medium bowl to stiff peaks
7. fold into cooled chocolate mixture
8. spoon into wineglasses
9. cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , about 3 hours
10. for cream: beat cream , sugar and brandy in medium bowl to soft peaks
11. top mousse with dollops of cream
demonstrations.review: This was a happy ending to a delicious meal carefully planned out with recipes I chose from Zaar for the whole meal, and I tell you it was one meal to remember!  My kids said I can make this meal for them anytime, but they especially liked dessert (of course, what kid doesn't) and I had to promise them to make this again REAL soon, so looks like I will be indulging in another chocolate fix before I know it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pineapple upside down biscuits

this is a 

1. preheat the oven to temperature as stated on biscuits
2. using a cupcake or muffin tin grease 10 cups
3. drain the can of crushed pineapple , saving the juice
4. stir together the pineapple , sugar and butter until well mixed
5. divide the pineapple mixture amongst the muffin cups
6. place a cherry in the center of each tin , pressing to make sure cherry touches the bottom of the cup
7. place 1 biscuit in each cup on top of the pineapple mixture
8. spoon 1 teaspoon of the reserved pineapple juice over each biscuit
9. bake for 12 to 15 minutes , or until golden brown
10. cool for 2 minutes
11. invert the pan onto a plate to relase the biscuits
12. serve warm sprinkled with powdered sugar or plain
demonstrations.review: These are a great treat for breakfast, or when you feel like indulging in a sweet snack!  Everyone here loved them and asked that they be made again, so I am putting the recipe in with my new favorites!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wild maine blueberry crisp

courtesy of  the lighthouse keeper's cookbook of maine.

1. preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. filling: in a small bowl , combine the wild blueberries , sugar , lemon rind , and apples
3. mix well and place in a well buttered 8 x 8 x 2 inch pan
4. crisp: in a medium bowl , combine brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , flour , pecans , oats , salt , and rub in the butter with your fingers until it resembles coarse crumbs
5. spread evenly over the wild blueberry filling
6. bake 45 minutes or until the crust is brown
demonstrations.review: I didn't have Maine blueberries but I did have some good looking bigger berries that I wanted to use up.  This was a GREAT dessert for us!  It was just sweet enough without being sicky sweet, which was a big plus in my book, especially because the ice cream we had it with was sweet.  We each had a dish with a big scoop of our favorite ice cream on it, and we were happy people!  Thanks Julie!

target.recipe_text:
nan s chili

this chili is great with or without beans. i prefer without, but my family prefers with. it's an adaptation of wic fowlers chili mix. i measured the ingredients one time and added my own touches to change the recipe to our taste. you can speed up cooking time using the pressure cooker for 15 minutes.

1. brown ground beef
2. add tomato sauce , tomatoes and water
3. stir in the onion , garlic and seasonings
4. add beans and simmer 30- 45 minutes
5. serve with saltine crackers to crush into the chili
target.review: I made one small change, adding fresh onion in lieu of dried.  This came together easily and is very tasty.  This may be my fall-back go-to recipe from now on.  Thanks PanNan - this isn't the first of your recipes that I've thoroughly enjoyed.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic taco casserole

i originally found this taco casserole recipe in a taste of home magazine.  since then, i have made this recipe at least 50 times.  i love it because the ingredients list isn't complicated and, based on the layers, i can readily remember all ingredients when i am at the store without my recipe card.  i have served this for myself and had wonderful leftovers or many times i have made it for company with a nice green salad to accompany it.  i hope you enjoy it as much as i do.

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add taco seasoning and cook according to package directions , adding proper amount of water
3. put corn chips on bottom of 8x8" dish
4. cook refried beans on stove until hot
5. add 1 cup cheese and 1 cup salsa
6. stir until combined
7. pour beans over corn chips in dish
8. add beef to top of beans
9. sprinkle remaining cheese over top
10. sprinkle green onions and black olives over cheese
11. bake in a 375 degree oven until the cheese is sufficiently melted
12. take out of oven and sprinkle chopped tomatoes on top
13. wait 1-2 minutes and then serve
demonstrations.review: This was tasty and agree with another reviewer about leaving out the chips and serving it as an appetizer.  I was hurrying and got the order of ingredients mixed up but it worked out fine. DH said this was a stepped up version of frito pie.  Quick and Simple

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: I have found a simple and tasty recipe, YES!  I used ground buffalo and pork this time.  Recipe makes enough little meatballs for two meals, so I froze 1/2 mixture for another day.  1/2 recipe fed 3-4 servings.  Use Paul Newman's roasted garlic red sauce if I don't make my own.  THANKS!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
denny s style french toast

i do not remember where i got this recipe, but my husband says it tastes just as good as what he had at denny's. i am just amazed at all of the great reviews on this recipe!! my family loves it, so i thought i would share it here and i'm so glad i did because it seems you all love it just as much!!! thanks to all of you who have tried it!

1. mix together the eggs , milk , flour , sugar , vanilla , salt& cinnamon
2. heat a large skillet , or griddle
3. when the skillet is hot , add 1 tablespoon butter
4. if the butter smokes , your pan is too hot
5. turn down the heat
6. dip each slice of bread into the batter for 30 seconds on each side
7. let some of the batter drip off , then put in skillet
8. cook each slice 1 1 / 2-2 minutes per side until each side is golden brown
9. add more butter , if necessary , to cook all of the slices
10. to serve , put on plate , dust with powdered sugar
11. serve with butter & hot syrup
demonstrations.review: This is truly delicious!  Next time I will mix my cinnamon in the vanilla because mine floated to the top. I also used regular bread and the recipe was expanded with more slices of toast. Picky eaters ate it, too, and loved it. RECOMMEND! Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot stifado

a tasty greek stew, made easy with a crock pot.

1. heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown beef-- in batches if necessary , adding more oil if needed
2. transfer beef to crock pot with a slotted spoon
3. reduce heat to medium and add onions to skillet , cooking until soft
4. add garlic , cinnamon and allspice and cook for 1 minute
5. add vinegar , tomato sauce , sugar and bay leaf and stir well to combine
6. pour mixture over meat
7. cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours , until beef is tender
8. add feta cheese , cover again , and cook on high for 10 minutes
9. discard bay leaf and serve over hot buttered pasta or mashed potatoes
demonstrations.review: I've never eaten regular Stiffado before and can't imagine being any better than this recipe for the crockpot.  I used pork chops and substituted 3-1/2 T Tom.Paste and water for the 12 ozs. Tom. Sauce.  Served over garlic buttered egg noodles. So Flavorful! Try it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gail s rosemary chicken

this is a recipe my sil showed me how to prepare. i've modified it a little for my tastes.

1. cut a clove of garlic in half and rub chicken all over , inside and out with both halves
2. rub chicken with butter , then rosemary , salt , and pepper
3. place the remaining 2 cloves of garlic and the onion in the cavity of the chicken
4. bake , covered , at 350f for 1 hour
5. remove foil for the last 10 mins of baking to brown skin
demonstrations.review: The taste was delicious and light.  Only thing I did that wasn't mentioned, was I rubbed all herbs/spices under the skin as well.  Served with mashed potatoes and Kentucky Wonder green beans for a lovely Sunday evening meal. Thanks Annie H!

target.recipe_text:
taqueria victoria s banana cake

this is a recipe i got from my roping the tastes of texas cookbook. the recipe originated in a restaurant in 1985 in victoria texas. this one is so good it will actually melt in your mouth! times do not include cooling time.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. grease and flour a 10-inch bundt pan
3. set aside
4. place sugar in a large mixing bowl , in the order listed , stir in eggs , butter , baking soda , sour cream and bananas
5. add and stir in flour 1 cup at a time until just mixed
6. spoon batter into the prepared pan and bake 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
7. cool cake in pan for 30 minutes on a wire rack
8. remove from pan and cool completely
9. sprinkle cake with powdered sugar , if desired
target.review: This is a nice change from banana bread. I added chopped pecans and peanut butter chips. But I found it made more than a bundt cake. I also used a round cake pan, it didn't take a long to cook so I just watch it. I didn't ice the cake at all but it was just as good without it. Thanks for the great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
savory sweet crock pot chicken

you won't believe how flavorful this chicken is --and the ingredients are things you probably have on hand.

1. put all ingredients except for chicken in crock pot and stir
2. add chicken and spoon sauce over chicken
3. cook on low for 6 1 / 2 hours
demonstrations.review: This was very easy. I started late and cooked it on high for 1 hour and then on med. for 1 hour. My whole family liked it. I served it with spaghetti, you could use any pasta, rice or egg noodles, and could be equally good made with pork. You could also add carrots for a veggie if desired. MandyJ

demonstrations.recipe_text:
erna s apple pie muffins

when our first daughter was born, a friend brought us a pail of these delicious muffins. it was such a thoughful gesture and perfect to snack on during that first couple days at home. whenever i make these now i can still 

1. topping-mix all together , until mixture forms crumbs
2. batter- whisk together egg , buttermilk , butter , and vanilla
3. stir in sugar
4. without mixing , add flour , baking soda , salt and apples
5. stir just until combined
6. do not over mix
7. spoon into muffin cups
8. sprinkle with the topping
9. bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until firm to the touch
demonstrations.review: Well let me tell you I am having my roof redone as I am writing and they took a coffee break and so they had the muffins. They said they were the best they had. I sent out 7 muffins first and then I had to send out 10. They are almost gone too. I have to waite until more are done to have some because they aren't any left to try. They smelled out standing when they were baking. So when the next pot of coffee is done I will be having one for myself. Thanks for the great hit Mandy

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy sweet ribs

yummy and very messy! enjoy!

1. to make sauce: mix brown sugar , maple syrup , and flour to pot
2. stir well
3. add water and stir well
4. add all ingredients except ribs
5. heat and stir until boiling and thickened
6. place a layer of ribs in slow cooker , spooning sauce over layer and repeat till all ribs and sauce is used
7. cover
8. cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 5 hours
demonstrations.review: This is a great recipeallthough a little warm for me. The day after with the spice soaking in made the leftovers very warm spice wise. I would recomend anyone who doesn't like food screaming hot to onlyuse 1 tsp. of the cayanne pepper. Other than that this recipe was fabulous!awesome flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate no bake macaroons

great for a chocolate fix!

1. in a medium saucepan , combine sugar , shortening and milk
2. bring to a boil
3. remove from heat
4. add cocoa , salt , vanilla , coconut and oats , mix well together
5. drop by tablespoonful onto wax paper lined cookie sheets
6. chill and enjoy
demonstrations.review: My daughter really liked these cookies. They were very easy to make. They reminded me of the ones my Mom used to make. If you boil the sugar ect. for longer they will harden faster and not be to soft. I make these almost every week for school lunch treats. I like to use a cookie scoop to make them all the same size. Thanks for the easy recipe that I can make on a moments notice. Mandyj

demonstrations.recipe_text:
celebration waffles

a family tradition in our home. we like to serve a special breakfast in our home to honour a birthday or some other special occasion. we always have these on christmas morning too! strawberries or cherry pie filling and whip cream are some of our favourite toppings.

1. heat waffle iron beat eggs in large bowl
2. beat in remaining ingredients until smooth
3. pour 2 / 3 cup of batter into center of hot waffle iron and close lid
4. bake 5 minutes or until steaming stops
5. carefully remove waffle
6. repeat with remaining batter
7. serve with your favourite toppings such as maple syrup , cool whip , fruit etc
demonstrations.review: Thankyou for this easy recipe.I also added a little vanilla , I am lucky to get real vanilla from Mexico. I had on similar to this one but lost it. I like this one so much more. My Mom liked this so much she made it for my niece and nephew. It is very crispy and light, I keep them warm in the oven at 200 deg. I put them right on the rack so they won't get soggy. bye for now Mandy

target.recipe_text:
creamy vegetarian lentil mushroom soup

creamy lentil soup cooked in a crockpot. serve with crusty bread or rolls for a comfort food fix! feel free to double this recipe.

1. in a saucepan , saute onions , mushrooms , garlic , and celery till just slightly browned , about 10 minutes
2. in a 3 1 / 2 or 4 quart crockpot , combine the lentils , carrots , onion , garlic , mushrooms , celery& parsley
3. stir in water , mushroom soup , and bouillon
4. cover
5. cook on low 10 to 12 hours or high 5 to 6 hours
6. top each serving with a dollop of sour cream
7. 4 servings
target.review: I made this for a potluck lunch today.  Everyone LOVED it!  I made a double recipe hoping I could bring some home, but I was all gone.  I will definitely make it again.  Fast, easy and so yummy.  I used red lentils, but you couldn't really tell that there were lentils in there at all b/c they were all mushy.  I didn't mind that at all though.  It acted as a thickener.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
healthy oatmeal raisin cookies

my husband loves oatmeal cookies, so i have created a low fat, low sugar recipe. the addition of raisins adds more sweetness.

1. mix brown sugar thru vanilla together
2. add flour , soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg
3. stir in oatmeal , raisins& walnuts
4. drop on cookie sheets which have been sprayed or i use parchment paper
5. bake in 350 oven for about 10 minutes
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: These are a great snack I don't mind feeding my kids after school.  Thay aren't traditional at all, but a really good, healthy alternative to high fat, high sugar cookies, etc.  I added some ground flax, craisens and dark chocolate.  I can see these cookies being a staple in our house.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade buns

i attend a mom's group at my church and one tuesday morning our "craft" was making buns. the experienced bun makers of the previous generation taught all of us young moms the craft of bun making. now i am proud of my bun making and i am glad that i had a chance to acquire this new skill. (thank you mavis!) prep time does not include rising time. sometimes i will make a big batch of this recipe and then make breadsticks, hoagie rolls, small buns for kid's lunches, and even a batch of cinnamon rolls but adding cinnamon and sugar and rolling up the dough. all of these can be tucked into the freezer until you need them.

1. mix yeast items and let stand in a large bowl
2. knead out until dough is soft and does not stick to your hands
3. cover and let rise 45 minutes
4. punch down and let rise 30 minutes
5. shape into buns and let rise for 2 hours
6. bake at 375 for 15-17 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: These were fun to make.  So easy!  And they turned out light, and crispy.  I used 3/4 ww flour and 1/4 white flour.  I let step one sit for 10 min.  Then did the rest of the steps.  No wheat germ.  The way I shape my buns is by pushing/pinching them between my thumb and curved pointer finger (it's kind of hard to explain).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate angel food cake

someone sent me this in an email once. nice change of pace from the usual vanilla angel food.

1. heat oven to 375 degrees
2. sift flour , cocoa and 3 / 4 cup granulated sugar together 3 times
3. set aside
4. beat egg whites at low speed in a large mixer bowl until foamy , about 5 minutes
5. add vanilla , cream of tartar and salt
6. gradually increase speed to medium while beating in remaining 3 / 4 cup granulated sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , 5 minutes
7. when sugar is incorporated , continue beating to stiff peaks , 2 minutes more
8. sift one third of dry ingredients over whites
9. gently fold in with rubber spatula
10. repeat process 2 more times
11. pour batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan
12. cut through batter to remove air pockets
13. bake 40 to 45 minutes , until top springs back when gently pressed
14. invert and hang pan on neck of bottle to cool
15. to unmold , run a thin knife around side of pan and tube
16. invert pan
17. turn cake upright onto serving plate
18. garnish with confectioners' sugar , if desired
demonstrations.review: It took me two tries to get this right, but it was worth it.  The first time I greased the pan and 5 minutes after I set in on the bottle it toppled out of the pan, onto the floor and left me with a huge mess to clean up.  So don't grease the pan.  :)  The second time I read instructions better.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marshmallow caramel rice krispies treats

this recipe came from my mom, and we always had these at home. mom always brought them to church events and they were the most popular treat and most requested recipe! both kids and adults love them! i'm not really sure how many this serves - how ever many marshmallows are in the bag!

1. put caramels , margarine , and sweetened condensed milk into a saucepan and cook on low heat , stirring constantly until melted together
2. remove from heat
3. dip frozen marshmallows into the mixture , then immediately roll in rice krispies
4. let them cool on wax paper
5. store them in the refrigerator
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I love, love, love these things.  Yes, they're messy to make, but totally worth it.  We poked the frozen marshmallows with skewers and then dipped them in the caramel and then the rice krispies.  You could try spraying Pam on your hands to help with the mess.  I didn't mind the mess, though.  They are SO good!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
broccoli  ham and cheese manicotti

what an interesting change from tradtional manicotti! you'll love the creamy texture of the cheese sauce! note: if you slightly undercook the manicotti they will be easier to stuff.

1. saute onions until tender
2. add ham , broccoli , cheddar cheese , and mayo , when cheese is melted , remove from heat and cool slightly
3. stuff manicotti with ham mixture , dividing between shells evenly , and place in a greased 9x13 inch pan
4. melt butter in saucepan
5. add flour and cook 1 minute
6. add milk and cook , stirring constantly until thickened
7. remove from heat and add swiss cheese , stirring until smooth
8. pour sauce over manicotti
9. bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until sauce bubbles
10. perfect supper with a crisp salad and garlic bread !
demonstrations.review: Delicious!  My kids loved this meal so much.  I'm not a huge ham person, which is why I gave this 4 stars instead of five.  If you love ham, this would be a five star recipe!  I guess I could probably substitute any other meat . . .  I also used canelloni shells instead.

target.recipe_text:
spanish rice   great alone or for stuffing

my wife made this today and for me who doesn't like rice, it was great.  it lends itself perfectly to stuffing into baked peppers or baked onions or even cabbage rolls.  it's great on it's own as well.

1. heat butter in frying pan and fry onion , green pepper , celery and mushrooms until tender
2. add tomatoes , salt and pepper
3. simmer slowly for 10 minutes
4. stir in 2 cups cooked rice
5. turn into buttered 2 quart casserole
6. bake in 375 degree oven for 25 minutes , or until bubbling
7. more tomatoes or tomato juice may be added if desired
target.review: My husband loved this; he had brought home some fresh local shrimp and wanted a red rice & shrimp bake~well I used your recipe for the rice and added the raw, cleaned shrimp and layered an 8oz package of swiss cheese to the mixture.  I covered it with foil for the same amount of time and he could not believe how delicious it was!  Thank you, for such a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken wellington  puff pastry wrapped chicken

this is not at all hard to put together, it's an amazing dish to serve to dinner guests and i have done so many times over the years and have always receive rave reviews from everyone at my table and you will too! --- to save time saute the onion, garlic and mushrooms up to a day ahead,  the cream cheese and dijon mustard mixture may be increased slightly -- i always serve this with recipe#149547 drizzled over or on the side of the plate, you will *love* this!

1. season the chicken breast with seasoning salt and pepper on all sides
2. heat butter and oil in a skillet
3. brown the breasts on all sides until almost completely cooked through
4. transfer to a plate
5. to the same skillet add in onions , garlic and sliced mushrooms
6. saute until the mushrooms lose their moisture and the onions are tender
7. stir in parsley
8. on a floured surface , roll out each puff pastry sheet to a 14-inch square
9. cut into four even 7-inch squares
10. place each breast over each puff pastry square
11. set oven to 375 degrees
12. in a small bowl combine the softened cream cheese with mustard , then spread over each breast
13. then top with about 2-3 tablespoons mushroom / onion mixture
14. brush the edges of each pastry square with water
15. wrap pastry around the chicken breast , pressing edges to seal tightly
16. place seam-side down on greased baking sheets
17. brush the tops with egg wash
18. bake for about 20 minutes , or until puffed and golden brown
19. serve with mushroom sauce over the wellington or on the side of the plate
20. delicious !
demonstrations.review:
I had made your recipe a few months back & my husband couldn't believe that I had made something so delicious-I served it again tonight for guests-with so many compliments!  I have a large kitchen area so my guests watched me prepare and cook everything . After this dinner,  they think I'm an expert!  Serve the strawberries and cream bars for dessert!  Recipe #281443
Thank you, Kitten
Anne

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chesapeake bay crab cakes

southern living; loved by my family

1. saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender
2. remove from heat
3. stir in crabmeat and next 9 ingredients
4. mix well , and shape into 8 patties
5. coat with additional breadcrumbs
6. pour oil to a depth of 1 / 4-inch into a heavy skillet
7. fry cakes in hot oil for 4-5 minutes on each side
demonstrations.review: Thank you for a delicious recipe.  I tried it tonight using fresh backfin crabmeat.  I used finely ground  Pepperidge Farm Herb stuffing for breadcrumbs  and used  Smart Balance for the butter/margarine.  I followed Debonweb's advice to chill them before frying ...I used Tauter sauce #239662  and served with cole slaw.  Everything tasted so fresh and NOT greasy.  I gave my Mom half and will use the rest for a delicious sandwich with shredded lettuce for tomorrow's lunch.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberries and cream dessert squares   cookie mix

looking for that new dessert to wow a crowd? it's the one that you'll make over and over, and everyone asks for the recipe? try this one, made easier with a cookie mix.

1. heat oven to 350f
2. spray bottom only of 15x10x1 or 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray
3. in large bowl , stir cookie mix , butter and egg until soft dough forms
4. press evenly in bottom of pan
5. bake 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown
6. cool completely , about 30 minutes
7. in small microwavable bowl , microwave baking chips uncovered on high 45 to 60 seconds or until chips are melted and can be stirred smooth
8. in medium bowl , beat cream cheese with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth
9. stir in melted chips until blended
10. spread mixture over crust
11. refrigerate while making topping
12. in small bowl , crush 1 cup of the strawberries
13. in 2-quart saucepan , mix sugar and cornstarch
14. stir in crushed strawberries and 1 / 3 cup water
15. cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture boils and thickens
16. stir in food color
17. cool 10 minutes
18. gently stir in remaining 3 cups strawberries
19. spoon topping over filling
20. refrigerate 1 hour or until set
21. serve within 4 hours
22. store covered in refrigerator
demonstrations.review:
This WAS exactly how wonderful you described, M2R, and my husband went back for seconds-something he doesn't do! I thought a dollop of whipped topping would add something extra but he said absolutely not-the dessert stands delicious by itself.  I'm forwarding this recipe to my sister-her husband is a hs coach & this would be perfect for their gatherings!
Thank you Mom2Rose for sharing!
Anne

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon and potato chowder

very filling, tasty, and easy to make. for best results, buy a good, very smokey bacon from a butcher shop.

1. fry bacon until crisp , and chop
2. drain and use paper towel to soak up excess fat
3. in a large pot , sautee onion and garlic with 2 tbsp bacon drippings
4. add potatoes , water , bouillon cubes to pot
5. heat to boiling , then cover and simmer until potatoes are cooked , then add bacon
6. mix flour with a small amount of evaporated milk , making a paste
7. gradually stir in remaining milk
8. add to potato mixture
9. cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens
10. stir often to ensure the soup doesn't burn on the bottom of the pot
demonstrations.review:
Ms. Kat, Thank you for posting this awesome chowder.  I doubled it to take to my 84 yr. mother next door and everyone said it was  "DamGood!! ".  My grocery had buy one get one free diced potatoes in the refridge. section, so I used those and did use the turkey bacon.  
Thank you, great comfort food!
Eliza

demonstrations.recipe_text:
special green bean casserole

great for holiday dinners.

1. saute onion in butter
2. add flour , salt , sugar and pepper
3. mix in sour cream , beans and cheese
4. pour into 9x13 baking dish
5. top with cornflakes
6. bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: I am so glad I found this recipe! We were having company over for a nice pre-Christmas dinner with sliced heavenly ham as the main entree.  My husband wanted the same old green bean casserole to serve with it but I was so burned out on it (cream of mushroom soup version).  This variation was delicious and this will be MY version from now on. Thank you for such a great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
new mexico style chili chicken casserole

this is an easy to make tasty dish that i clipped from my local newspaper. i especially like that it can be prepared a day ahead.

1. heat oven to 350f
2. coat a 9x13 dish with cooking spray
3. in a large pan , combine broth , chilies , onion , sour cream , salt , cumin , pepper , soup and garlic
4. mix well
5. bring to a boil , stirring constantly
6. remove from heat
7. spread 1 cup mixture in the dish
8. arrange 6 tortillas over soup mixture and top with 1 cup chicken and 1 / 2 cup cheese
9. repeat layers , ending with cheese
10. spread remaining soup mixture over cheese
11. bake 30 minutes or until bubbly
12. when ready to serve , bake 1 hour
13. uncover and bake 30 minutes more or until bubbly
target.review: This was for sure yummy.  But, it wasn't the best mexican casserole I've had.  I think that the cream of chicken soup flavor was really strong.  I'm wondering if 1 can of soup and more sour cream might balance that out.  I made this for company and it didn't plate as well as I'd expected.  It was a little soupy.  But, that of course doesn't affect the taste.  It was good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
split pea and smoked turkey soup

the smoked turkey makes all the difference.

1. rinse split peas , drain
2. combine everything in slow cooker , except tomatoes
3. cook on low for 7 hours
4. last ten minutes , stir in tomatoes and let stand for 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was so yummy. I did change a few things. I added about 1/2 cup of diced onions, 1/2 tsp of salt. I only had dried chives. I put 3 tsp of dried chives in. I used green split peas (couldn't find yellow). I used homemade chicken stock. That always makes such a difference for me with soups. Also, I'm assuming that the dried tomatoes are sun dried tomatoes. I bought the jared kind and chopped a little bit to make smaller pieces. The key to this is the smoked turkey. I used leftovers from my husbands last hunting trip. The turkey was a Wal-mart purchase... not a result from hunting. Ha! This soup needed to go longer than 7 hours on my crock pot. But, that will vary from crock pot to crock pot. Yum, I'm sitting here eating a tiny bowl waiting for my husband to come home from work so that we can eat it together.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast casserole

we make this the night before and breakfast for christmas is ready in a snap. served with hash browns, juice and coffee and your not spending all morning in the kitchen.

1. trim crusts from bread , cut into cubes , cover bottom of a 12x7" casserole and sprinkle with cheese
2. beat eggs , add milk and mix well
3. stir salt , pepper and dry mustard into the egg mixture , add bacon and sausage , stirring until well blended
4. pour over cheese , cover with foil and refrigerate overnight
5. in the morning put in a 350f oven and bake for 50-55 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a super easy recipe.  My stepmom said that she has an almost idential recipe.  But, she subs the bread for garlic croutons.   I used 2 1/2 cups of skim milk and the last cup was 1/2 cup of whole milk (becasue I ran out).  My stepmom said just that little bit of whole milk made the entire dish creamier.  I agree.  It was delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
egg salad sandwich

use this as a guide to make as many sandwiches as you like. i know many people know how to make this easy sandwich but this is a lot how my great grandmother made them and oddly enough the lettuce seems to really make it taste better, especially not just putting it on top of your sandwich. anyways a new cook may not know this easy meal yet and i didn't see one exactly like this in the database.

1. finely chop hard boiled eggs with a pastry blender or knife and fork
2. add onion , celery seed , dijon , mayo , and lettuce and mix well
3. butter each slice of bread , top with egg mixture , sprinkle with salt and pepper , seal sandwich and eat
demonstrations.review: Sorry, this didn't do it for me.  I had to add sweet relish and lots more salt and pepper before it tasted like the egg salad sandwiches that I remember.  But, the lettuce is a great addition.  It does make all the difference.  Thanks for pointing that out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
king s hawaiian bread  copycat

we absolutely love this bread.  my sister won't buy anything but.  it's kinda expensive so when i came across this, i had to add it here so we (mom, chris, and i) could always have it and everyone else could enjoy it too.  the first time i ever had it, it was with the spinach veggie dip...omgosh it was deeevine!  so...next time you don't wanna spend the money, whip it up yourself!  it does take a while...but so worth it!

1. beat the eggs
2. add the pineapple juice , sugar , ginger , vanilla , and butter
3. place 3 cups of flour in a large bowl
4. stir in the egg mixture until well-combined
5. sprinkle in the yeast , one packet at a time , and mix
6. add the remaining 3 cups of flour and mix in
7. blending with a spoon will be hard , so you may have to use your hands
8. make sure it is thoroughly combined
9. cover the bowl with a cloth and set in a warm place to rise for 1 hour
10. remove from the bowl and knead in 1 / 2 cup flour
11. knead about 10 times
12. divide into three equal parts
13. place in greased and floured loaf pans or shape into rolls
14. cover and place in a warm place to rise for 1 hour
15. bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or golden brown
demonstrations.review: This was very yummy!  I ate my first slice while it was still warm... yum... I reccommend that. I did make mine in the bread machine on the light crust setting and used the converted amount of rapid bread machine yeast.  The texture was light, but it was't exactly like the King's Hawaiian bread as I remember it.  I can tell that the flavor is very similar.  I think that King's might taste a little sweeter.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian chopped salad in shells

i just found this on recipegoldmine.com. haven't made this yet, but they sound like an incredible appetizer for a cookout or picnic. prep time includes 2 hour chilling time.

1. cook pasta shells as directed on the package
2. drain and cool
3. place remaining ingredients except vinaigrette in a medium bowl
4. pour vinaigrette over the salad , toss to coat
5. stuff the shells with the salad
6. cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: This is such a great idea!   It makes something not fancy look fancy!  My rating is for the concept.  I made it with a BLT chopped salad with blue cheese chunks and blue cheese dressing and then sprinkles with cracked pepper.  My husband (the non salad eater even ate it!  This has opened my eyes to new uses for pasta shells.   I can envision lots of fillers now!

target.recipe_text:
spanakopita crescents

these are so yummy and so amazingly easy to prepare. they are very similar to those delicious greek spinach and feta pies. they are always a hit at my parties!

1. dice onion into small pieces
2. place onion and chicken stock in a saute pan and cook on medium until onions become translucent
3. add dill and spinach , continue to cook until all liquid is evaporated
4. remove spinach and onion mixture from heat and allow to cool
5. once cooled , stir in feta cheese into filling mixture
6. open packages of crescent rolls and unroll onto cutting board
7. using a pizza cutter or a knife , cut each crescent into 2
8. place 1 tsp of the filling at the widest end of the crescent and roll up dough "jelly roll style" around filling
9. place cresents 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. bake at 425 for 12 - 14 minutes until golden brown
11. filling may be prepared and refrigerated up to 2 days in advance
12. cresents may be baked earlier in the day and then reheated before serving
target.review: Loved these!! If I could give it more stars I would. I made it for a girl's night out at my house and they went so fast that I could not get a picture of the platter. The crescents made this dish so easy. Thanks Canadian Cookie!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
traditional deviled eggs

these are so good and easy. i am always requested to make these for the holidays and for barbeques. i have to make a double batch because dh sneaks them when i'm not looking! :)

1. scoop egg yolks into bowl
2. set aside egg whites
3. add mayonnaise , mustard , vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper to yolks
4. mash together with fork until smooth
5. spoon mixture into egg white halves
6. sprinkle tops with paprika ,
demonstrations.review: I have never had a really good recipe for deviled eggs.  My husband wanted them like his mother's but deep down I knew there was something better.  Thanks for proving my theory!!  They were great! A definite keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
favorite chicken and wild rice casserole

i found this in southern living several years ago and make it often, especially when bringing a meal to someone. it freezes well which is good since the recipe is much more than my family can eat. i usually make it either in 2 2qt baking dishes or 3 9x9 pans for freezing and add a little extra cheese on top. light sour cream, lowfat milk and healthy request soup work well for a lower fat version.

1. prepare rice according to package directions
2. set aside
3. saute onion , celery and water chestnuts in butter until tender
4. in a very large bowl , combine rice , onion mixture , 3 cups cheese , chicken , soup , sour cream , milk , salt and pepper
5. pour into a lightly greased 15x10 inch baking dish or 4 qt casserole
6. bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese and bake 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: Love this recipe! I have made it for a couple of new moms (or moms with new babies) and it is always a hit!  It is nice to make one batch and have a couple of night's dinners done.  Thanks Longhorn Mama!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
meghan s cookies

here is a fruity, oatmeal cookie i made up in honor of my beautiful daughter-in-law, meghan.

1. cream sugars and shortening together
2. add eggs and vanilla , beating well
3. add dry ingredients , mixing well
4. stir in fruit
5. drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 11-12 minutes
demonstrations.review: I really liked these cookies!! I made them with butter instead of crisco but turned out just fine. I would also suggest adding either white choc chips or maybe some macadamian (is that right?) nuts just for a variation. I also added more dried fruit than called for. I figured more is better right? Thanks for such a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken scaloppine with lemon glaze   low fat and delicious

this is a wonderful lower-fat restaurant-quality dish that is easy to make, i also like to add in a few tablespoons of capers and cook with the lemon glaze if you are a lover of capers then add them in as it really adds to the flavour of this dish ---  this lemon sauce is not a heavy creamy sauce which is what makes this dish lower in fat, it is more like a glaze that soaks into the chicken, and i would strongly suggest to double or even triple the glaze i most always do, and please be certain to use only dry breadcrumbs as fresh will not stick to the chicken as well --- this is *very* good!

1. in a small bowl or shallow dish whisk together mustard and eggs
2. set aside
3. combine the dry bread crumbs with poultry seasoning , garlic powder and seasoning salt
4. spread on a piece of waxed paper
5. dip the breasts firstly in egg / mustard mixture then coat well with the crumb mixture , pressing downs with hands to adhear the crumbs to the breast
6. heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
7. add in the chicken and cook for about 5 minutes on each side , or until it is no longer pink inside
8. remove and transfer to a plate to keep warm
9. for the glaze
10. in the same skillet add in the broth , lemon juice and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt bring to a boil scraping any brown bits from the pan
11. add in lemon slices and parsley
12. mix to combine for about 1 minute
13. spoon the glaze / sauce over chicken
14. delicious !
demonstrations.review: This was soooo good!! I did take the advice to quadruple the sauce and I am very glad that I did.  The sauce definitely completes this dish nicely. I omitted the salt in the sauce, personal preference. I was glad I did. I did not use low sodium chicken broth and it would have been too salty. This recipe will definitely be entering the rounds of meals in my home. Thanks Kittencal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
4th of july grilled salmon  or chicken

a friend of mine made this at last year's 4th of july celebration, and after much begging and groveling, shared this super-easy, fun, and very yummy recipe, which you can easily double or triple for a big crowd!   the cold left-overs (if any) the next day are fabulous!  try this with chicken!!  grill 4 chx breasts 4-5 min ea side, then finish in 350 degree oven in covered pan with butter & olive oil for +/-20 min.  oh!  magnificent (great sandwiches w/tomato, cream cheese, and avocado).

1. into a large zip-lock bag , make marinade out of peanut oil , soy sauce , vinegar , onions , brown sugar , garlic , ginger , red pepper flakes , sesame oil and salt
2. combine well , and insert fish or chicken
3. seal and marinate in refrigerator 4-24 hours
4. oil and preheat grill on medium-high heat
5. grill fish ~5 minutes per side , until fish just flakes with a fork
demonstrations.review: This is really good!!  My husband doesn't like salmon very much but he really enjoyed this.  I only marinated for a short time and I think it would be more flavorful if it were longer.  VERY delicious!!!

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s muffin shop jumbo blueberry or strawberry muffins

these are bakery-quality muffins,  the directions slightly differ from the regular method which is what sets these apart and the method that many bakeries use to make their muffins, the butter is mixed with the flour firstly to create a lighter-textured baked muffin, you may omit the berries and add in whatever you desire, chocolate chips, dried fruit etc, if using strawberries choose red very firm berries using soft berries will create a soft sticky dough --- these may be made up to 2 days ahead and stored in an airtight container at room temperature, rewarm in a 275°f oven for about 8 minutes --- see my recipe#78579 for greasing pans :)

1. set oven to 375 degrees f
2. set oven rack to second-bottom position
3. generously grease 12 jumbo muffin tins , then cut out circles of parchment paper to fit into the bottom of each muffin tin
4. in a large mixing bowl using an electric mixer blend the flour with sugar , butter and salt until mixture resembles a fine meal
5. in a small bowl mix together baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and lemon zest to the remaining flour mixture
6. mix until combined
7. in a bowl whisk together buttermilk with eggs and vanilla to blend
8. add to the creamed mixture
9. gently mix just until combined
10. carefully fold in the blueberries or chopped strawberries
11. divide the mixture between the muffin tins
12. sprinkle the reserved streusel over tops of muffins
13. bake for about 25-30 minutes , or until muffins test done
14. cool for about 5 minutes in tins then carefully lift out to a rack
target.review:
Yum! These are good!
  The method did produce a lovely textured muffin. I ended up making regular-sized muffins -- about 16. The cinnamon adds a lovely dimension that I normally wouldn't have thought of to be paired with a blueberry muffin. The lemon -- delicious, of course.
   They also look so beauty-full! Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white fish provencal

this recipe comes together easily and is tasty.  i've used orange roughy and mahi mahi fillets with success. this is a revised recipe for health from the saturday evening post: the mediterranean diet.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. place fish fillets in a oven safe baking dish
3. drizzle 1-1 / 2 t olive oil over fish
4. rub oil on both sides and salt & pepper
5. sprinkle fish with onion and garlic powders , basil and thyme herbs
6. top with a 1-1 / 2 heaping t of stewed tomatoes per fillet
7. pit and slice olives into halves or quarters and sprinkle on top of tomatoes
8. splash the tops of tomatoes & olives with white wine and drizzle the remaining olive oil
9. bake with a foil tent for 15 minutes or until fish is white and flakey
demonstrations.review:
A wonderful healthy recipe for white fish. We used basa fillets, green olives, and omitted the basil due to personal preference. We also did not do the oil step -- still tasted fabulous.
  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blueberry pudding loaf

like a slice of pudding. very very moist and dense--in loaf form. make a tasty dessert or mid-morning snack with a hot cup of tea.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in very large mixing bowl , cream butter and cream cheese with mixer on medium speed until creamy and blended
3. add sugar , sour cream and vanilla
4. mix until fluffy
5. add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each
6. in large mixing bowl , combine flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt
7. add gradually to butter / cream cheese mixture
8. and blend well
9. add blueberries
10. stir only to distribute
11. batter will be very thick
12. put batter into two greased and floured loaf pans
13. bake for 50-60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
14. cool in loaf pans for 10 minutes before removing to wire rack to cool
demonstrations.review:
Absolutely delicious! So moist.  The only problem I had was slight coagulation in resulting loaf, probably due to cold ingredients.  Next time I will leave the sour cream to sit out at room temperature.
  Thank you~~

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crispy salmon cakes with lemon  caper mayonnaise

this recipe was published in cooking light. i make it a bit different than it originally appeared, though (i don't use fat-free mayonnaise, saltines, etc. and also add some additional ingredients to suit my taste). if you would like to make the original version, just stick with the fat-free items and omit the last 4 items in the ingredient list (mayo through tabasco) and you will have the original recipe. prep time includes 20 minutes chilling time for the salmon cakes.

1. mayonnaise:
2. combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl
3. cover and chill
4. salmon cakes:
5. heat 1 teaspoon oil in medium nonstick skillet over medium heat
6. add onion and celery and saute' 4 minutes , or until tender
7. combine onion mixture with 1 / 2 cup crackers , mustard , 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper , salmon , egg , mayonnaise , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce and tabasco in a medium bowl
8. divide into 4 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2-inch thick patty
9. coat each patty with 1 tablespoon crackers
10. cover and chill 20 minutes
11. heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot
12. add patties and cook 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned
13. serve salmon cakes with flavored mayonnaise
demonstrations.review: Ohhh we loved these!  These are fabulous because we almost always have all of the ingredients on hand and they are easy, quick, and oh so delicious!  The only thing I did differently was add a little extra lemon juice, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Perfect and definitely a keeper. Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
highland chicken

this is our favorite chicken dish! there is something about the cream sherry marinade that makes this chicken absolutely fabulous. the chicken develops a very complex flavor and the sauce is wonderfully tasty. the sauce is lovely made with either the cream or the low fat milk/water option. since we don't usually have heavy cream onhand, the lowfat option was born and i am very happy with the result. hope you enjoy this dish as much as we do.

1. in a shallow pan combine the following ingredients to make the marinade: sherry , garlic , oil , salt , pepper and thyme
2. add the chicken to the marinade , cover and refridgerate for 30 minutes or more
3. when chicken has marinated for at least 30 minutes , melt butter in a frying pan over medium high heat
4. quickly brown the chicken breasts , then lower the heat , cover and cook for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle
5. transfer chicken to plates
6. add water to pan to deglaze it
7. add remaining marinade to pan , bring to a boil and simmer until reduced by half
8. add cream or low-fat milk and water alternative and heat through
9. pour sauce over chicken
10. serve with noodles or rice and roasted seasonal vegetables for a wonderful meal
demonstrations.review: This truly is absolutely delicious!  Everyone loved the sauce (so true about the flavour being "complex"!)  We used a half cream sherry/half cooking sherry combination, and used milk instead of the cream. It was still very good, and this recipe is definitely a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
extra creamy fluffy white frosting

this is a really great fluffy white frosting --- for the best results use only whipping cream for this --- this may easily be doubled and also freezes well.

1. in a bowl using an electric mixer , beat together the shortening , salt , vanilla and half of the icing sugar
2. beat until very smooth
3. add in whipping cream
4. beat well
5. add in remaining icing sugar to desired texture
6. beat until fluffy and creamy
demonstrations.review: A beautiful, easy to work with, fluffy white frosting! The taste is very good...usually I avoid using shortening because I find it has an "oily" taste, but this turned out so nicely! Iced my cake beautifully. Thank you!

target.recipe_text:
gourmet portabella mushroom burger

if you are a mushroom lover you have to try this sandwich! this is so good! i think my daughter and i could live off this sandwich! the mushroom stem was cut even with the cap and it cooked up fine. so you don't have to remove the whole stem.

1. heat oil 1 minute in a skillet
2. lay mushroom in pan and sprinkle with garlic salt , worcestershire sauce , and parsley
3. cook 2 minutes on each side , or until lightly browned
4. cover pan , lower heat to medium , and cook 5 minutes
5. place cheese over mushroom
6. cover and cook until melted
7. if you'd like , clean out the gills of the mushroom , but this is not necessary
target.review: Hey Charlotte! Hope you're well.  I loved this sandwich.  I wanted a simple portabello sandwich and this was it.  I used basil instead of parsley, and added a tomato.  After cooking the mushroom I put cheese, basil and tomatoes on the whole wheat bread sandwich and stuck it in my panini press (slash waffle maker).  It was my first attempt using it and despite making a bit of a mess from lack of expience, it came out really tasty!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wild mushrooms with chestnuts and thyme

this elegantly rich side dish could easily stand on its own as a sumptuous meatless main course. from bon appetit.

1. melt 3 tablespoons butter in large deep nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. add shallots and saut until tender and golden , about 6 minutes
3. add garlic and stir 30 seconds
4. add remaining 3 tablespoons butter and stir until melted
5. add mushrooms
6. sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. saut until tender and brown , about 10 minutes
8. add thyme and stir 1 minute
9. add madeira and simmer until almost evaporated , about 1 minute
10. add chestnuts and whipping cream and simmer until cream thickens and coats mushroom mixture , about 1 minute
11. season generously with salt and pepper
12. transfer to bowl
13. sprinkle with chives
demonstrations.review: So I made a few changes to this.  I used olive oil instead of butter, cab. sauv. because it's what I had, and was out of cream so I used cream cheese.  Also subbed 1 onion for the shallots, and used crimini, shiitake, dried porcini and oyster mushrooms reconstituted in some warm water.  For me this would have been way too heavy on it's own, but we had it with wheat penne and it was amazing!  My husband swears he doesn't like chestnuts so I made a batch for him without them and he didn't like it.  When he tried mine he said it was so much better because of the bit of sweetness added by the chestnuts. For me it was a perfect dish.  I'll try it again for sure and pick up some madeira and make sure I have whipped cream and shallots.  Thyme is great with the mushrooms and chestnuts.  A friend that stopped by gave it a try and it reminded her of stroganoff.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted beet salad with horseradish cream dressing

this combination of sweet beets and hot horseradish is a mild, delicious taste treat and a great side dish with grilled meats.
a twist on the presentation of the eastern europen dish called tsvikly.
from food and drink magazine.
hope you enjoy!
*note, please use a very hot, prepared horseradish sauce to offset the mildness of the cream. if you do not have hot horseradish, then please be prepared for a very mild flavoured dressing!

1. preheat oven to 375
2. wash and trim beets , but do not peel
3. place on a large piece of foil and sprinkle with salt and pepper , then fold up in a loose package sealing seams tightly
4. place foil package on a baking sheet and roast for 1 hour or until beets are tender
5. let cool , then peel and thinly slice the beets
6. refrigerate until serving
7. whip cream until thick but not stiff , fold in sour cream and horseradish and season with salt and pepper
8. refrigerate until serving
9. to serve , slice onion into thin rings , divide lettuce among serving plates
10. top with beet slices and onion rings and drizzle with dressing
11. sprinkle dill on top
demonstrations.review: I added a little lemon to this because I didn't think there was quite enough seasoning for the lettuce, but it was really awesome before I added it as well.  I used shallots instead of onions, and though I doubled the recipe I forgot to double the horseradish.  Next time I'll definitely use the listed amount of horseradish.  That really made the beats super tasty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
limonada

this is a simple and tasty drink. i found the recipe at www.laylita.com/recipes.  posted for zwt 2008.

1. place the quartered limes or lemons in the blender with 4 cups of water and sugar
2. blend until the limes or lemon is completely pulverized , the mixture should be slightly foamy with a whitish color
3. strain the lemonade and add the remaining 4 cups of water
4. serve with or without ice based on individual preference
demonstrations.review: This was refreshing.  I used limes and lemons.  I also found this to be pretty bitter even with doubling the sugar.  I also halved the water and used lots of ice.  I think if I used cheese cloth it might take out more of the pith and be less bitter.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zucchini fritters  kolokithopitta

posted for zwt6 for greece region: these tasty fritters are very easy to prepare and can be served as a side dish or as a light snack on their own.  found on authentic greek recipes website.  not sure of the amount of servings but i'm guessing for an appetizer or light snack about 4 servings.  prep time includes time needed for zucchini to drain properly.

1. grate the zucchini and put it in a colander
2. sprinkle salt on top and leave it to drain for 1 hour
3. beat the eggs lightly and place in a mixing bowl then add the rest of the ingredients
