1. heat and mix all the sauce ingredients in a saucepan
2. stir until it boils and thickens slightly
3. cook peas according to instructions on the package
4. drain peas
5. add sauce to warm peas , mix and serve
6. peas may also be served as a cold vegetable
demonstrations.review: Tasty and super easy. I think I could have handled a bit more sauce given the amount of peas, but only just a bit. I took it to an extended family Christmas dinner, and most of it was gone by the time everyone was done eating, so I think it was a hit.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s sit sandwich  aka squishy sorta muffuletta

from my family recipe box, mom loves this sandwich! "this sandwich is a 'smashing success'... in more ways than one. it's a great traveler." you must admit, it is pretty amusing. :) from the family recipe box, dated 3/1/85.  the sandwich keeps well, chilled, and is good for taking along on picnics and camping trips.

1. cut loaf of bread in half horizontally and hollow out the soft bread from both halves , leaving a shell about 3 / 4-inch thick
2. reserve soft bread for another use
3. in small bowl , combine artichoke liquid with mayonnaise and spread onto bread shells
4. in bottom half , layer ingredients at least three times until mounded high , beginning and ending with tomatoes
5. place top half of bread over mound of ingredients
6. wrap entire loaf tightly with plastic wrap
7. this must be assembled at least 2 hours before serving , but can be assembled up to 8 hours before serving
8. refrigerate
9. before serving , place sandwich on a hard surface and sit on it ! this smashes the ingredients together and makes it easier to serve
10. do not omit this step , strange as it seems , as this step is what makes the sandwich delicious
11. slice the loaf into wedges or slices to serve
12. also , regarding the artichoke juice mixture: you can add only half of it to the mayo , if you like - how much of the spread you're going to need depends on the size of loaf you've gotten
13. yum !
demonstrations.review: So yummy and fun! The most recent time we made this was for lunch on our first day of a lake vacation. We had to drive all morning to get to the lake, and it was great to have such a delicious lunch on hand and ready to go. Plus my two-year-old thought it was so funny that mama was sitting on the sandwich!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tortellini with turkey sausage in creamy butternut  apple sage

a turkey dinner! yes! turkey sausage with butternut, apples, onions and cranberries. flavored with crisp sage and garlic. 
for a quick and easy method look here recipe #194908.
the sausage can be removed from the casing and crumbled and cooked.

1. spray a large hot frying pan with non stick spray
2. place links in and cook for 15 minutes till brown , remove from pan and set aside
3. in pan add olive oil and brown sage leaves till crisp and remove all set 6 aside fro garnish
4. crumble 2 leaves
5. add additional oil if needed to saute the onions for 3 minutes over medium heat , stirring to remove the brown bits of goodness from pan , add apple slices , the 2 crumbled sage leaves , garlic and seasoned salt , cinnamon and cook for 1 minute
6. add apple juice and cranberries to onion mixture , bring to a boil then lower to a simmer for 5 minutes over medium heat
7. meanwhile slice sausage
8. stir the butternut and cream into the onion mixture
9. add sausage stir and reduce heat to a low simmer
10. toss cooked tortellini in to sausage mixture add some pasta water if needed to thin sauce
11. season with salt and pepper
12. garnish with sage leaves
demonstrations.review: Yum! I made some changes, but I think the essence of the recipe remained intact. Here's what I did: I used kielbasa-type turkey sausage, so no links involved. I used dried sage instead of fresh as that was what I had on hand. I used fresh cranberries instead of dried, and I used chicken broth instead of apple juice. I don't like food as sweet as most people, so I think those last two changes were essential for my palette. Finally, I skipped the seasoned salt and used regular salt instead. Thanks for posting such a great recipe! I will certainly be making it again.

target.recipe_text:
4 minute spicy garlic shrimp

recipe is originally from the food network courtesy of rachael ray, but i tweaked it to fit our tastes. very quick & easy shrimp recipe that's done on the stovetop. if your tastes desire spicy & garlic, then this recipe is just for you.

1. heat a large skillet over medium high heat
2. add olive oil , garlic , red pepper flakes , and shrimp
3. season with grill seasoning or salt & pepper
4. cook shrimp 3 minutes or until just pink
5. toss with lemon zest , juice , & chopped parsley
6. remove shrimp to a serving platter , leaving the garlic cloves in the pan
target.review: Yum! I have made this a few times and love it. I don't always have parsley or always use the lemon zest and it still is delicious! I do use chopped garlic and serve the garlic with the shrimp. Delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
impossible peanut butter cookies

these are the quickest, simplest peanut butter cookies that you will ever make and they taste great!

1. mix peanut butter , sugar , and egg together until smooth
2. drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet two inches apart
3. if desired , roll in extra sugar before placing on cookie sheet
4. press with fork
5. press again in opposite direction
6. bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. do not brown
8. do not over bake
demonstrations.review:
I was a bit skeptical at first, but now I am a believer. These are delicious! Just what I needed to take away my craving for pb!
I added about a 1/4 cup of quick cooking oats, only used 1/2 cup of white sugar, and added 1 tsp of vanilla. 
I didn't pre heat the oven since it wasn't in the instructions and baked the cookies for 12 minuets.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stir fried pork in hoisin sauce

this simple and tasty stir-fry is from the wild ginger restaurant in seattle. we like to serve this over cooked soba noodles with some stir-fried vegetables on the side.

1. for sauce:
2. stir all ingredients in a medium bowl until well blended
3. for pork:
4. stir pork and next 6 ingredients in small bowl until blended
5. heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons peanut oil in heavy large skillet
6. add sauce
7. bring to simmer
8. add pork
9. stir-fry 3 minutes
10. add 2 tablespoons water and onions
11. stir-fry until pork is cooked through , adding more water by tablespoonfuls to thin sauce if desired , about 1 minute
demonstrations.review: I'm always looking for things to do with a pork tenderloin and this is great. So easy. I had to read TV directions a few times because it has you cook the pork in the sauce so you don't brown the meat first. I didn't have rice wine so I used sherry from trader joes. I will be making this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
barefoot contessa s turkey meatloaf

this is an ina garten recipe from the barefoot contessa cookbook. my husband is fussy about his meatloaf, but really likes the texture and flavor of this.

1. preheat oven to 325f
2. saute onions in olive oil until translucent , about 15 minutes
3. add salt , pepper , thyme , worcestershire sauce , chicken stock and tomato paste and mix well
4. allow to cool to room temperature
5. combine ground turkey , bread crumbs , egg and onion mixture in a large bowl
6. mix wll and shape into a rectangular loaf on an ungreased sheet pan
7. spread the ketchup evenly on top
8. bake for 1 1 / 2 hours until the internal temperature is 160f and the meatloaf is cooked through
demonstrations.review: I made this in my instant pot. 22 minuets, quick release. I had to scale the recipe for 1.25 lb of meat (3servings). After it was done I put the topping on and broiled it for a few minuets. I put it in a springform pan and made a hole in the middle so it looked like a donut, uncovered. Very good recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kelly s crock pot  smoked  beef roast or brisket

this is awesome!  if you love brisket or beef cooked in the smoker and just don't have time to, or maybe the weather won't permit- you have to try this.  i have used every cut of beef roast or brisket, it always comes out great!  enjoy!

1. trim beef of any large extra fat
2. a little is good for flavor
3. place the roast in the middle of a large piece of aluminum foil
4. rub beef all over with all of the spices
5. sprinkle liquid smoke over beef and rap tightly in foil
6. make sure it's completely wrapped
7. do not add any liquid to the crockpot !
8. place in crock pot and cook on low setting for 8-10 hrs
9. unwrap beef and serve with the "smoker" juices in the crock pot or with your favorite barbecue sauce
demonstrations.review: I followed the recipe and it came out delicious. After it was done, I sliced it up and slatherd it with bbq sauce that I thinned out with the juices the beef made and then broiled it for a few minuets. My husband could not stop moaning and groaning because it was sooo good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gyros   an authentic recipe for making them at home

yes, you can make authentic gyros at home --> the texture and flavor of this meat is as good as you get in a good greek restaurant, without the traditional rotating spit.. but this is just the recipe and technique for making the meat, for i'm assuming you know the drill on making the classic gyro sandwich - stuff the meat in a grilled pita with sliced tomatoes, onions and tzaziki sauce.. enjoy!

1. combine all ingredients in a bowl , and mix well
2. knead the mixture on the counter for 10 minutes - just like you're kneading bread
3. you may want to use a dough-scraper to help keep the counter clean
4. pick that meat up and slam it into the counter , continuing to do so for the 10 minutes
5. this is key to getting the correct texture
6. i'm no alton brown , but i think the thing we're doing here is melting the fat so that we get a nice smooth texture in the end
7. form into a flat loaf - i like to put the meat onto a piece of wax paper , and flattening it into a 3" high slab rectangle
8. i cover it with another piece of wax and use a rolling pin to flatten it out , just make sure you straighten out the edges to form a rectangle so that when it comes time to slice , they are nice and even
9. bake the loaf on a broiler pan at 350 for about an hour
10. alternatively , you can grill it over coals , that's my favorite way , just be sure to turn often so as to distribute the juices
11. allow to cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing thin
demonstrations.review: I made this using ground turkey and used my kitchenaid to mix it. Wow did this taste just like the Gyros you get and a pizza shop. I used flatbread from trader joes. After I baked and sliced the meat I pan seared it. I plan on making large batches and freezing it Pre sliced.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot beef stew

a delicious beef stew recipe. great for cold winter evenings!

1. place meat in crock pot
2. combine flour , salt , and pepper
3. pour flour mixture over meat and stir to coat well
4. add remaining ingredients and stir
5. cover and cook on low 10-12 hours or high 4-6 hours
6. stir before serving
target.review: This was a nice meal.  Very easy to make and the flavor was excellent.  I made this with a nice green salad and Beer Bread.  About the only change I will make next time is to cook the meat alone for a couple of hours before adding my veggies.  The potatoes pretty much disintegrated.  It was still really good though.  Very filling meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
helen s zucchini casserole

this recipe will tempt those anti-zucchini eaters! i could eat a whole pan myself! have had this recipe for 20 years. can be made ahead & baked before serving.

1. heat oil in large skillet
2. add zucchini , onion , tomato & garlic
3. cover & cook until desired tenderness , about 10 minutes
4. drain
5. stir in tomato sauce & seasonings
6. in a 13x9-inch baking dish , place a layer of the zucchini mixture , then top with shredded cheese
7. continue layers until pan is full , ending with the remaining cheese
8. bake uncovered , in a 350f oven , for 25 minutes
9. top with shredded parmesan or romano cheese , if desired
demonstrations.review: This was good to me, but my son nor husband cared much for it, so I probably won't get to make it again.  We had to salt it at the table as it seemed like it needed salt.  I am surprised the recipe doesn't call for any.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pie a la tamale

this is really really good--much better than sonic's chili pie (but i like and make that too!)

1. crush corn chips
2. sprinkle 1 / 2 package over the bottom of a 9x11-inch baking dish
3. unwrap tamales and arrange over top of crushed chips
4. combine 2 cans of chili and water
5. pour over tamales
6. sprinkle onions over chili
7. sprinkle cheese over onions
8. top with remaining crushed corn chips
9. bake in moderate oven 35 to 40 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was yummy.  Everyone liked it.  Mom and Dad, of course, loved the onions in it, but ds asked if next time I'd leave the off one end of the dish for him.  He'd prefer it without them.  He still ate it though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
linda s bean and mayonnaise sandwich  sandwiches

one day my friend at work brought this in for lunch. i turned my nose up at it, and laughed as she told me how delicious it was... the next day she made me one, and made me try it... i was hooked on the first bite...try it...i bet you will get hooked too!  i would not use black beans on this recipe.  i use friends or bush's baked beans.  try some of my other delicious sandwiches: recipe #52284 recipe #234542 recipe #218337

1. put a generous amount of mayonnaise on both slices of bread
2. add salt and pepper to taste , onto the mayonnaise
3. put a generous amount of beans onto one slice of bread
4. put top slice of bread onto sandwich , cut and eat
5. this is truly delicious
6. try it !
7. you just might like it
demonstrations.review: Well, I don't know if I didn't do something right, but I took 2 peices of white bread, mayonnaised both slices, added heated black beans, draining them the best I could.  It was a little soggy and I could eat it, but I just didn't care for it.  I ended up just eating a bowl of the beans by themselves.  I won't be making this again.  Could be a matter of taste perhaps or did I do something wrong?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best peanut butter oatmeal cookies

the oatmeal makes all the difference. these are the very best! they vanish quickly.

1. in large bowl mix the butter , shortning , sugars and peanut butter
2. add eggs one at a time
3. blend flour , soda and salt then add to sugar mixture
4. then add oats
5. form into 1 1 / 2 inch balls these come out perfectly round bake 350 degrees for 12 minutes
demonstrations.review: I made these cookies this morning for my family.  Everybody says this recipe is a keeper for sure.  They are a great looking cookie and the texture is great.  They are soft on the inside.  Yum!  Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and turkey stuffed shells

use fresh spinach if you wish. ground beef, veal or pork may be used instead of turkey. it is up to your personal taste!

1. cook spinach according to package directions
2. drain and squeeze out excess moisture
3. brown ground turkey in olive oil
4. preheat oven to 375f
5. grease 12x8-inch baking dish
6. combine spinach , parsley , crumbs , eggs , garlic , and cheese in a large bowl
7. mix well
8. add turkey and mix well
9. fill shells with this mixture
10. spread 1 cup sauce on bottom of baking dish
11. add shells and cover with remaining sauce
12. cover with foil
13. bake 35-40 minutes until warmed through and bubbly
demonstrations.review: Had this dish tonight for supper.  Very good!  We will have this again.  Even my spinach hating hubby and son liked it.  I used about 1/2 cup of parmesan cheese and a little salt & red pepper also.  Next time I will use more tomato sauce too as it did dry out a bit after baking.  Thanks for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
ginger me up chicken  low fat honey   ginger chicken breasts

this is a recipe i have been making for yonks now.....i first devised it about 18 years ago, when i was following rosemary connely's "hip & thigh diet"!! it's a very easy low fat chicken dish, which can be pan fried or baked in the oven - i prefer the latter method, it's much easier! serve it with a medley of gently steamed vegetables, rice or pasta. (nb: please note, one of the reviewers has stated that she cooked this in a crockpot!! i would never suggest cooking this recipe in a crockpot, that's why it is not mentioned as a cooking method anywhere in the recipe - only pan-fried or oven baked. thanks! )

1. preheat the oven to 180c or 350f
2. select a sturdy oven dish - preferably non-stick
3. place the chicken breasts into the baking dish
4. mix the honey , mustard , water , ginger & crushed garlic together in a measuring jug
5. pour over the chicken breasts , easing them up slightly so the mixture runs underneath them
6. season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste and bake in the oven for 45 to 60 minutes
7. serve one chicken breast per person with some of the cooking sauce drizzled over the top of the chicken
8. garnish with chopped parsley & serve with a medley of steamed vegetables & pasta
9. to pan fry , heat up a frying pan and add the chicken breasts - dry fry them briefly to give them a bit of colour and add the cooking sauce , mix well and cook for about 20- 30 minutes over a medium heat
10. serve as before
target.review: This is decent. The ginger was a bit overpowering and I only used 2 teaspoons but that could be my fault. I didn't use chicken breasts I just used some chicken tenders and they only took about 30 minutes to cook compared to the 45-60. I also didn't add the cayenne pepper with the sauce mix I add ground red pepper over the top after adding the sauce.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
southwest flat iron steak

this rub and be used on all cuts of beef, but is especially good on the flat iron cut.

1. combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. press rub evenly onto flat iron steaks
3. let set for 1- 2 hours
4. grill over hot fire , turning often to avoid burning , being careful not to overcook
5. cut across the grain
demonstrations.review: I love flat iron steak and have done so many different things with it. This sounded so good when I read the reviews and ingredients but I found the chili powder to be way to overpowering. I think I may cut back on the chili powder next time and try again. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork tenderloin with balsamic cranberry sauce

nan

1. preheat oven to 450f
2. melt 1 / 2 tablespoon butter in heavy large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
3. sprinkle pork with salt and pepper
4. sear pork on all sides , about 2 minutes
5. place skillet with pork in oven
6. roast pork until thermometer inserted into center registers 155f , about 10 minutes
7. meanwhile , melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter in heavy medium skillet over medium-high heat
8. add onion and rosemary
9. saut until onion softens , about 3 minutes
10. add broth , cranberry sauce and vinegar and whisk until cranberry sauce melts , about 2 minutes
11. transfer pork to work surface
12. scrape any juices from large skillet into cranberry mixture
13. boil until sauce has reduced enough to coat spoon thickly , about 6 minutes
14. season with salt and pepper
15. slice pork and serve with sauce
demonstrations.review: This was really good. The only problem I has was that it took longer than 10 minutes for the pork to cook and it took about 15 minutes for the sauce to get thick. I'm not sure what happened or what I did wrong. But.. all in all it was delicious and I will be using again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flat iron steak with dry rub

can use with any steak.  from silvia lehrer's cooking column in dan's papers, june 29, 2007. the meat is an innovative cut to the shoulder top blade steak which resulted in the nickname "flat-iron" with the rectangular shape at one end and the arrow-like at the other end.

1. combine first 4 ingredients and stir to mix
2. rub the mixtue into the steaks to season and drizzle with olive oil
3. heat a large iron skillet over medium heat for several minutes until hot
4. put in the steaks and cook 3-4 minutes on one side , turn and cook 2-3 minutes longer for medium rare
5. let meat rest for 5 minutes then serve
demonstrations.review: This was the first time I had used Flat Iron Steaks and I had no idea what to do with them. I loved it with this seasoning. I put the seasonings on the steak and then allowed it to to sit for about 2 hours. The meat was very flavorful!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flat iron steak

a popular "new" cut of steak (top blade steak) that is cheaper and surprisingly more flavorful than the expensive steaks that is gaining popularity in the us. posted for forum request. said to be replacing the last steak-cut-fad "the hanger"...from gourmet sleuth

1. mix all ingredients thoroughly and marinate steak for one hour
2. grill over hot coals 4 minutes per side
3. this steak is best cooked rare to medium rare
demonstrations.review: I had a hard time rating this one. I didn't really care for the flavor since it didn't seem to have much of one. But, I think it does deserve a decent rating because out of the two steaks I used (both with different seasonings) this one was very tender. I'm torn on how I feel about this recipe...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
edna s apple crumble  aka  apple crisp

a simple and easy to make but oh so yummy recipe. known as apple crumble in the uk and apple crisp in the us

1. put apples in an 8 or 9 inch square baking dish
2. combine the rest of the ingredients in a separate bowl and mix
3. spread crumble mixture over apples and bake for 35 minutes in a 375f degree oven
4. for an added treat top off with a little english custard
demonstrations.review: This was pretty good. I made a homemade caramel sauce to go over top with some vanilla ice cream. The only thing I didn't care for was the nutmeg. It was a tad overpowering in the topping. Thanks for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
pecan pie bars with shortbread crust

one of my favorite bars, this works well also with walnuts! the shortbread crust is light and buttery, make certain to make the crust only on a processor, mixing by hand will produce a harder textured crust, also make certain to pour the topping over the crust when it is hot out of the oven, so prepare the topping while the crust is baking, the filling takes only minutes to make! yield is only estimated depending on size of bars. cooking time is for both crust and topping.

1. set oven to 350 degrees , set oven rack to second-lowest position
2. butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. for the crust: in a processor blend all ingredients until mixture begins to form small clumps
4. sprinkle the mixture into prepared baking pan
5. lightly press the mixture down with a spatula
6. bake in the second-lowest oven rack for 20 minutes until golden
7. meanwhile prepare the filling / topping: in a heavy saucepan melt butter and stir in brown sugar , honey and whipping cream
8. simmer mixture for about 1 minute , stirring occasionally
9. stir in chopped pecans
10. pour the pecan mixture over hot shortbread crust and spread evenly in the pan
11. bake on the second-lowest oven rack for about 20-22 minutes
12. cool completely in the pan
target.review: I live in Germany and it is rare that I find pecans, however, the other day at the store I found the mother-load, so I stocked up.  I tried this recipe and I followed it to a T, but there was something just a bit odd.  It tasted wonderful, don't get me wrong, just something with the consistency.  As I said, I can't really put my finger on it.  I'll try these again to see how it goes though.  Thanks Kittencal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashioned corn and potato chowder

this really is old fashioned! it comes from 

1. combine , in a large pot , all ingredients except milk and flour / water
2. cook until potatoes are fork tender
3. add milk and flour / water , stirring well
4. bring to a boil and allow to cook for 10 minutes
5. serve with chopped green onion and shredded cheese as a garnish
demonstrations.review: I had to change up this recipe a bit.  I added more potato (about 2.5 cups) and a bit less corn (about 2 cups) and added a dash of garlic powder.  I also added a bit more salt.  Other than that, it was PERFECT!  My husband was not too much a fan, but he doesn't like corn and I"m pregnant and I love corn, so this is what I made.  I loved it...and there's still some on the stove, so I'm going back to have spoonfuls!  YUM!!!  Thanks for this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy one bowl milk chocolate fudge cupcakes

if you are looking for a dark chocolate cupcake then these are not for you, they rise simply beautiful and come out just perfect, they' re so easy to make everything is mixed in one bowl with a wooden spoon! --- top these with my recipe#89207

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. line 12 regular size muffin tin with paper liners
3. in a medium-size mixing bowl , mix together the flour , brown sugar , sifted baking cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
4. mix with a wooden spoon to combine
5. in a two-cup measuring cup or bowl whisk together the milk , egg , oil and vanilla
6. add the milk / egg mixture to the dry ingredients
7. mix very well with a wooden spoon to combine well
8. mix in the chocolate chips and nuts
9. divide the batter evenly between the lined muffin tins
10. bake for 22-25 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
11. cool , and frost with favorite chocolate frosting
demonstrations.review: YUM!  These were so good!  I was a bit worried they would be dry, but then I bit into one and there was that extra sweet little splash of chocolate from the chocolate chips...nope, not dry at all!  I did ice them with a cream cheese icing though.  They were so good!  Thanks for this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana oat bran muffins

a yummy, healthy muffin with no added fat.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. combine dry ingredients in large bowl
3. whisk milk , applesauce and vanilla in medium bowl
4. add milk mixture to dry ingredients , stirring just until combined
5. mix in bananas
6. divide batter among 12 muffin cups
7. bake until toothpick inserted in centre of muffins comes out clean , about 20 minutes
8. transfer to a rack to cool
9. serve warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: These were kind of ok.  They looked wonderful and they smelled lovely, however, just the taste and the consistency were just a bit off.  They were just too chewy, and kind of left a weird taste in my mouth as well as my DH's mouth.  I was really excited about this recipe since it was SO healthy, but it just didn't work for us.  Thanks for the recipe though!  I know other people enjoyed this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sugar and cinnamon spiced pecans

i love this recipe. it is such a hit, especially around the holidays. this is one of those recipes that can be made and given for an edible gift. hope you enjoy!

1. whip egg white until frothy
2. add water , sugar and cinnamon
3. in a 13x9" cake pan , melt the margarine or butter
4. pour pecans in egg mixture , stir well , then pour into pan
5. bake at 250 for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring every 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: Oh Man was this good!!!  They are still in the oven, but there's only 15 minutes left...I snuck one and it was SOOOOO good!  Pretty easy too.  The only thing that I did differently is that I soaked up some of the butter after an hour just because it was a lot of butter and the pecans weren't crisping up.  These are so good though!  I will definitely make them again!  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy italian chicken  crock pot recipe

easy to make, wonderful to eat!

1. place chicken breasts and mushrooms in crock pot
2. mix together the italian salad dressing mix and water
3. pour over chicken and cover crock pot
4. cook on low for 3 hours
5. meanwhile set out cream cheese-i like to cube it while it's cold
6. when 3 hours is up , remove chicken and mushrooms with a slotted spoon
7. whisk the cream cheese with the liquid in crock pot
8. when well incorporated , return chicken and mushrooms to crock pot and cover
9. cook for 1 1 / 2 hours on low
10. plate and shred fresh parmesan to taste
11. serve
demonstrations.review: This was the first recipe I have ever made in my new crock pot...I have to say it was amazing!  I will be making this over and over.  I do have to say that 4 hours was a bit much, but I believe it was my crock pot...it's new, so I'm still learning it's heat levels...Thanks for this recipe!

target.recipe_text:
pumpkin black bean turkey chili

haven't tried this one yet; posting for future use. looks interesting to me.

1. in a large dutch oven , heat oil over medium heat
2. add the onion , yellow bell pepper , and garlic
3. stir and cook for about 8 minutes or until soft
4. add in oregano , cumin , and chili powder
5. cook and stir 1 minute
6. add in black beans , turkey , pumpkin , tomatoes with liquid , broth , sherry , and salt / pepper to taste
7. bring mixture to a boil
8. stir occasionally
9. lower heat , cover and simmer for 45 minutes
10. serve hot
target.review: This soup is WONDERFUL, I would give it 10 stars if I could. Very easy and quick to make. The only turkey I had was frozen turkey burgers, I just chopped them up. I tasted it before I added the spices and it was bland, but after the spices it was perfect. I will be making this regularly. I do have to say this made about 8 servings for us.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker tangy italian beef sandwiches

this is a betty crocker recipe and we just love it!  so easy and the aroma is fabulous!

1. spray inside of 3- to 4-quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. if beef is tied , remove strings or netting
3. place beef in cooker
4. sprinkle with brown sugar
5. pour dressing over beef
6. cover and cook on low heat setting 10 to 12 hours
7. remove beef from cooker
8. place on cutting board
9. shred beef , using 2 forks
10. return beef to cooker
11. add italian seasoning and mix well
12. using slotted spoon to remove beef from cooker , fill each bun with about 1 / 3 cup beef
13. serve with remaining juices
demonstrations.review: I had high hopes for this recipe because of the other reviews but was very disappointed. I used an expensive cut of meat and followed the directions exactly and the meat was tough and way too sweet. I will never make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
no bake granola bars

snack bars.

1. in large bowl , combine cereal , rolled oats and raisins
2. set aside
3. in small saucepan , combine brown sugar and corn syrup
4. bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. stir in peanut butter and vanilla
6. blend until smooth
7. pour over cereal mixture
8. mix well
9. press into ungreased 13"x 9" pan
10. cool
11. cut into 24 bars
demonstrations.review: I followed the recipe except put in white chocolate chips instead of raisins. They did turn out a little dry, but still held together fairly well and were delicious. I will try and make these more moist next time but will make again. Husband and daughter liked them are they are hard to please.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white chili   football soup

this recipe comes from the blue owl restaurant and bakery in historic kimmswick, mo. my daughter named it "football soup" because we always make it when we have a crowd over watching the game after church! incredibly easy, freezes beautifully, and my bean hating husband even loves it. i add an extra can of green chilies for more flavor. you can make it without the chicken for a cheaper meatless meal, and you can make it without the monterey jack cheese for a low-fat, less thickened soup (but the cheese adds a lot of flavor!)

1. heat oil in large pot over medium high heat
2. add onions and saute until translucent , about 10 minutes
3. stir in garlic , then chilies , cumin , oregano , and cayenne and saute 2 minutes
4. add undrained beans and stock and bring to a boil
5. reduce heat and add chicken and cheese to chili and stir until cheese melts
6. season to taste with salt and pepper and ladle into bowls
7. for freezing: pour soup into a rigid container , label and freeze
8. to reheat , thaw in refridgerator overnight or simply put frozen soup into a large pot and gently heat , with lid on and stirring often , till heated through
demonstrations.review: To make it less spicy I didn't use green chilis and only added a handful of cheddar cheese to each soup bowl rather than monteray jack. It turned out delicious. Freezes well-I didn't eat any fresh, I made it and stuck it directly in the freezer. You would never guess it had been frozen. Even my picky husband liked it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
andes crme de menthe cookies   andes mint cookies

i found this recipe on the back of andes crème de menthe baking chips. i made a few small changes and am really pleased with the results! these cookies taste very similar to the girl scouts thin mint cookies!

1. preheat oven to 350f do not do this until after dough has been refrigerated
2. blend butter , brown sugar , white granulated sugar , baking soda , baking powder , vanilla and eggs until ingredients are mixed
3. add andes baking chips and mix
4. add flour and continue to mix until all ingredients are well blended together
5. cover and chill in the refrigerator for 45-60 minutes
6. spoon out approximately 1 oz of dough per cookie
7. form a ball and then slightly flatten
8. place on non-stick baking pans and bake for approximately 8-10 minutes
9. cool on pans for 2 minutes , then remove
demonstrations.review: These deserve more than 5 stars. I couldn't find the baking chips so I bought a 4 ounce package of Andes Mints and chopped them. They were the perfect amount. I took these to work and got RAVE reviews, thanks for making me look like a great baker! Although these didn't brown much, they still looked nice because of the uniform size, I used my kitchen scale to get them each to one ounce.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
authentic italian tomato sauce

this is a recipe i got from my father who got it from a little old lady he knew from italy. i always simmer this sauce with my meatballs (recipe posted). you can also add sausage if you like. this sauce is to die for!!!!

1. in a large pot , saut onion and garlic in olive oil
2. empty plum tomatoes into large bowl and squash with your hands
3. add all ingredients to pot and simmer for 3 hours
demonstrations.review: I would give this 50 stars, if I could. I could drink this tomato sauce with a straw, it is that delicious. I did not have any cloves, but other than that, I made it as directed. My hubby and 2 children, who are very picky and rarely compliment my cooking, all ate 2 servings of pasta with this sauce and said it was fantastic. I will never again buy tomato sauce. This is GREAT tomato sauce!

target.recipe_text:
granny s sugar cookies

soft all the way through. you can make big cookies with this dough!

1. cream together butter and sugar
2. blend in egg
3. sift together salt , baking powder , and flour
4. add to mixture
5. blend vanilla into mixture
6. chill dough
7. roll dough to thickness desired , and cut out shapes with a cookie cutter
8. bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in 400f preheated oven for 8-10 minutes
target.review:
These were SO yummy!  The only complaint I have is on the actual directions. It says to "chill" but for how long? I left them for a while unsure on how long to chill because I'm a novice cook, so putting the "chill time" would be helpful.

But the actual cookies...MORE than I expected! SO YUMMY!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pigs in a blanket  from scratch

for anyone who has ever been out of crescent dough during an emergency....

1. heat the oven to 400f
2. grease a large baking sheet
3. sift the dry ingredients into a mixing bowl
4. rub the butter pieces into the dry ingredients until mixture is crumbly
5. stir in cheese until evenly distributed
6. make a well in the dry ingredients and add the buttermilk
7. stir well with a wooden spoon
8. let the dough sit for 3 minutes
9. sprinkle the dough with flour and stir once or twice then turn out onto a well floured counter
10. with floured hands , pat the dough into a 15 by 7 inch rectangle , trimming the sides if necessary to get a true rectangle
11. using a pizza cutter , slice the rectangle into thirds horizontally then slice each third into thirds vertically , this will give you 9 small rectangles
12. slice each rectangle diagonally into two thin triangles
13. one at a time , roll up the sausages in the triangles
14. place pointy side down on greased cookie sheet
15. bake for 12 to 13 minutes , until golden brown
16. cool on the sheet for 3 minutes then tranfer to a wire rack
demonstrations.review: This was definitely a great starter recipe, but the only problem was I think it needed a bit more flour. My dough was very wet and difficult to manipulate so I had to add more flour then it worked fine.  They were still a hit though!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ham and rice skillet

very simple and fast to fix.all in a skillet.

1. saute peppers with butter in the skillet
2. stir in flour slowly add milk stir
3. bring to a boil
4. stir until thickened
5. reduce heat to low stir in sour cream until blended
6. stir in remaining ingredients
7. heat thoroughly
demonstrations.review: This was really good, but I think it was a little bit bland.  Now don't get me wrong, I will most definitely make it again, but next time, I would add some garlic, onions, and maybe some mushrooms and chicken.  It's definitely a great start to a sauce.  I served mine over rice because I wanted it to be more like a meal rather than a side dish.  Thanks for putting this up, like I said, I'd make it again in a heart beat.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana bars

my young'uns think this treat is even more special than 'nana bread. mos'ta the time, i jes' leave out the frostin', and nobody don't never complain (they ain't fools!)...al'tho if ya do have the time, the frostin' makes a mighty fine treat. this recipe come from a tore-up ol' copy of taste of home's quick cooking.

1. cream together shortening and the sugars
2. add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. mix in bananas and vanilla
4. combine flour , soda and salt , then add to the creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk
5. stir in nuts
6. pour into a pam-sprayed 13x9" pan
7. bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes , or till a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
8. cool before frosting: for frosting: combine brown sugar , butter and milk in a saucepan
9. bring to a boil for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
10. remove from heat
11. cool a bit
12. gradually beat in powdered sugar till frosting reaches a good spreading consistency
demonstrations.review: My husband, son, and friends LOVE this recipe!  I feel so good giving this to them since it's homemade and it's so easy because I have all of the ingredients already. I haven't made it with the icing, it's good on it's own! LOL

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tortillas de harina  flour tortillas

my late grandma's tortillas. delicious as a stand alone snack or mexican side

1. mix flour , shortening , baking powder , salt , and sugar
2. gradually stir in water until crumbly dough forms
3. work with hands until dough holds together
4. on a floured board , shape into a ball and knead until smooth
5. divide dough into 12 roughly equal parts
6. roll into sphere and let stand for 15 minutes
7. use a rolling pin to flatten into 8 inch circles
8. cook on ungreased griddle on medium heat , to cook , when it starts to bubble , flip it over , when it starts to bubble , pat it down with a clean towel or spatula , when the entire tortilla starts to inflate , take it off the grill
demonstrations.review: These are wonderful!  My mother has been making tortillas for over 40 years and I can never get a recipe from her because she just does it all by hand and no measurements.  Needless to say mine have never turned out even close to hers until I found this recipe!  They're delicious and I'm sure to always have these available.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick and easy spaghetti with meat sauce

magnifico! classic spaghetti with meat sauce ready in about 45 minutes! mmmmmmmm

1. heat olive oil in a shallow soup pot
2. saute garlic until golden , then add onions and peppers
3. saute until onions are starting to become translucent , then add beef , and season with salt and pepper
4. brown until cooked through
5. drain grease
6. add wine and allow to cook for a couple of minutes
7. add tomato sauce , tomatoes , boullion cube , parsley , oregano , thyme and basil , salt and pepper and sugar
8. stir to combine and bring to a boil
9. boil for about 1 minute then reduce heat to med-low and simmer 20 minutes
10. serve over spaghetti , top with parmesan cheese and serve with crusty french bread
demonstrations.review: This was really good and I cook this probably on a weekly basis.  One thing I do have to point out is I would definitely leave out the beef bouillon cube. The first time I made this, I put this in and it tasted way too salty.  Also, I cut down on the oregano, again, gave the flavor of being too salty.  Also, I cook the onions and garlic in about a tbsp of bacon fat and that gives it an awesome kick.  After I made these few adjustments, it was really good!

target.recipe_text:
low fat cinnamon scone

delicious low fat cinnamon scone.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f lightly grease two baking sheets
2. in a large bowl , combine flour , cream of tartar , baking soda , salt and sugar
3. add the applesauce , water and milk
4. mix well
5. drop large rounded spoonfuls of batter onto prepared baking sheets
6. bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes
7. let cool before serving
target.review: Delicious for a low fat recipe! My mother is a scone-lover, but she makes them the classic way, which I think is way too unhealthy. This is a good way for those who love sweets to eat in moderation. Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rich and chewy low fat brownies

amazingly rich and chewy, you would never know these are low fat.  i have people asking me for this recipe whenever i make it.  the applesauce is the secret ingredient in these delicious brownies!  one suggestion i have to make them fudgier is to use a very high quality cocoa.  i usually use watkins or epicure selections and found a big difference from that and the kind you can buy in the store.  it makes them a real dark chocolate in the middle and they are rich and chewy!  this recipe also doubles well and will fit into a 9x13 pan.

1. cream butter and sugar in a large bowl using a hand mixer
2. add egg whites , applesauce and vanilla
3. mix all other ingredients in a separate smaller bowl and add to the wet ingredients in the large bowl
4. do not overmix !
5. spray 8x8 dish with pam and bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Pretty good stuff! I wanted to experiment around, so I added some candied cherries into it and it tasted amazing! I know it sort of ruins the healthy theme going on here, but it's worth it in my point of view! Thanks for the great recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low fat banana oatmeal chocolate chip muffins

i am now actually "watching" my diet, and in the process am trying to make my favorites in a "low fat" manner. i took my favorite muffin recipes and combined them, made some adjustments and came up with this great recipe. hope you enjoy them!

1. add sugar to mashed bananas and mix
2. add beaten egg and mix
3. in a separate bowl mix all dry ingredients
4. add dry ingredients to the banana mixture and mix well
5. mix in applesauce
6. add chocolate chips and stir
7. spoon into medium size muffin tin and fill 3 / 4's full
8. bake for 20-25 minutes at 350
9. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I became ecstatic when i saw this recipe! My favorite baking ingredient in the world is banana, and the flavor of it goes so well with chocolate chips in this muffin. I used 1/2 cup all-purpose flour and 1/2 cup whole wheat to give it a little variation, but not to lose the goodness and texture of the white flour.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft coconut macaroons

these are soft yummie cookies. not like traditional macaroons, they are different in a delightful way.

1. preheat oven to 325f
2. combine flour , sugar , salt and coconut in mixing bowl
3. stir in egg whites and almond extract
4. stir in almonds , mix well
5. drop teaspoon fulls onto a greased cookie sheet
6. bake 20 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: Amazing! And it's a good alternative for one of the recipes that got passed down to me: that one called for sweetened condensed milk and I don't always have that on hand. Thanks for this recipe! It's really convenient!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pineapple upside down bundt cake

i love bundt cakes because they are so easy to serve. i found this recipe on a camping website and adapted it for use in the home kitchen instead of on the camp fire! it comes out great and it will be the easiest pineapple upside down cake you'll ever serve!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. melt butter in bundt pan in oven
3. spray cooking spray on the parts of the pan that aren't covered by the melted butter
4. sprinkle brown sugar over melted butter
5. place maraschino cherries on top of sugar
6. spread crushed pineapple over all
7. mix cake ingredients according to the package directions regarding time and mixer speeds
8. pour cake mix over topping ingredients in pan
9. bake for 40 minutes , until golden brown
10. test for doneness , knife or toothpick inserted should come out clean
11. immediately invert onto serving platter and remove pan carefully so none of the topping stays in the pan
12. cool completely before serving
demonstrations.review: Really simple recipe that everyone who uses cake mix should try! Maybe next time I will try using whole pineapple rings and then slicing them in half to create a sort of fan or flower shape around the bundt pan.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low fat low calorie cool  n easy pie

an incredibly delicious 3 ingredient pie! use any flavor jello (we like peach or strawberry kiwi). it's so easy and it really yummy! no guilt! just a creamy, lightly sweet dessert everyone will love! top with a little fresh fruit if you like!

1. boil 2 / 3 c water
2. in mixing bowl , mix boiling water and jello for about 2 minutes until dissolved
3. in a measuring cup , combine ice cubes and water to measure 1 cup
4. stir into jello mixture til ice is melted
5. add cool whip and whisk until smooth
6. put mixing bowl in the refrigerator for 20 minutes to allow mixture to thicken
7. spoon filling into crust
8. refrigerate overnight
demonstrations.review: This is one of my favorite 3-ingredient pies ever! I'm looking forward to making it in the upcoming spring and summer! It may sound weird, but I tried a watermelon-flavored jello and it tasted like candy! Thanks for the recipe!!

target.recipe_text:
spinach alfredo lasagna

nan

1. cook the noodles
2. in a skillet brown the sausage then drain
3. add the spinach , alfredo sauce , salt and pepper
4. in a bowl , combine the egg and cheddar , ricotta and parmesan cheeses
5. in an ungreased 13-in x 9-in x 2-in pan , layer a third of the sausage mixture , noodles and cheese mixture
6. repeat layers two times
7. sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
8. cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
9. let stand for 15 minutes before cuting
target.review: This is one of my favorite ways to make lasagna. My friend and I used to make this from a cookbook and we had lost the recipe. I am so glad to have found it here.I made homemade alfredo and it was awesome. I might add some mushrooms next time as I think they would go nicely in this dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate cherry cookies

a hidden cherry under the chocolate makes a sweet surprise when you bite into these wonderful chocolate cookies.

1. combine flour and cocoa
2. set aside
3. beat butter in a med bowl on med speed until softened
4. add sugar , baking soda , baking powder and salt
5. beat until well mixed
6. beat in egg and vanilla , scraping the side of the bowl
7. gradually beat in flour mixture
8. shape dough into 1-inch balls
9. place 2-inches apart on an ungreased cooking sheet
10. press down the centers with your thumb
11. drain cherries , reserving juice
12. place a cherry in the center of each cookie in the depression you made with your thumb
13. combine chocolate pieces and condensed milk in a small saucepan
14. cook and stir over low heat until the chocolate is melted
15. stir in 4 teaspoons of the reserved cherry juice
16. spoon about 1 teaspoon of the chocolate and milk mixture over each cherry , spreading to cover cherry
17. if the frosting is too thick , thin with additional cherry juice
18. bake in a 350f oven for about 10 minutes or until edges of cookie is firm
19. cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute
20. transfer to a wire rack to finish cooling
demonstrations.review: I made these with Splenda which I would never do again.  They were really good but Splenda has an aftertase that I just don't think went well with these cookies . I cannot wait to try these again but with real sugar, I am sure they will be amazing. I will be giving these as christmas cookies this year.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
coconut condensed milk cake

a very quick, easy and delicious cake to make that comes from a friend, mrs. betty mccall.

1. mix white cake and bake in 9" x 13" pan according to directions
2. when done , punch holes all over cake with wooden dowel
3. pour condensed milk and coconut cream over cake while still warm
4. allow to cool a little and spread with cool whip topping
5. sprinkle with coconut and pecans
6. ready to serve
7. refrigerate uneaten portion
demonstrations.review: This cake was awesome. Very rich. I made it for my friends birthday and I have to say that it is MUCH better the second day, so if you can make it a day ahead and then frost and serve it ,I think that is the best way to do it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zucchini chocolate cake

don't you just love it when you can get your daily vegetable requirements from the dessert you eat? and a chocolate dessert at that!

1. cream butter then add oil and sugar
2. mix
3. add next 8 ingredients
4. mix well
5. fold in the chips and nuts by hand
6. put in a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
7. bake at 325 for 1 hour or until done
demonstrations.review: DELICIOUS! I made this for a friend for her birthday and I put chocolate frosting on it. Those of us at the party decided that the cake is delicious without the frosting , so moist and yummy. The second time I made it I melted chocolate and drizzled it over the cake and I have to say , it was PERFECT. I will make this cake over an over again .

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious roasted beef ribs

i have always preferred my beef ribs grilled that is until i tried this slow long roasting method --- prep time includes marinating time.

1. in a medium bowl , combine all ingredients , except the beef , and adjust seasonings to taste
2. place the ribs in a large bowl , and coat with the sauce
3. cover , and refrigerate for 2 hours or as long as 48 hours , turning the ribs every so often
4. preheat the oven to 325f
5. drain the ribs , and place them in a large roasting pan , bone-side down
6. brush with sauce , and bake for 30 minutes
7. remove from oven , and turn the ribs over , brush with additional sauce , bake for another 30 minutes
8. turn one more time , brush with the remaining sauce , and bake for another 35-40 minutes , or until ribs are tender , basting every so often
demonstrations.review: Well we followed the directions exactly and we really disliked the sauce . I would omit the cinnamon if I were to make this recipe again , but I probably won't . I can't figure what we could have possibly done wrong since everyone liked it so much.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted vegetables and feta

nice healthy roasted vegetable side dish, recipe from health check website.

1. preheat oven to 375 f
2. combine mushrooms , peppers , zucchini , onion , and garlic in 9 x 13 inch baking dish
3. stir remaining ingredients except for feta in a small bowl
4. drizzle over vegetables and stir in to evenly coat
5. bake in oven for 20 minutes
6. sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese
7. serve
demonstrations.review: Wow is all I can say. this was amazing.I followed another reviewers suggestion and put it on a sandwich with Chicken and more cheese the next day and it was one of the best sandwiches I have ever had at home. I did use more veggies than the recipe called for and next time I will double the sauce for that but I think it was still amazing with my error. Who knew veggies could taste so yummy?

target.recipe_text:
spinach twice baked potatoes

i developed this recipe to lure my kids into eating spinach. it worked! spinach in almost any form is one of their favorite veggies. big "kids" enjoy these rich, filling potatoes as well, and i often make them for dinner parties. i haven't tried freezing them, but i imagine you could make a batch and stick them in the freezer to keep for another day.

1. cut a small slit on top of each potato , and place in a 400f oven for 1 hour or until completely done
2. cut each potato in half , lengthwise , and scoop out into large bowl
3. place the potato shells on a baking sheet
4. squeeze the spinach to get all the water out of it , and until it is fairly dry
5. set aside
6. mash the potatoes in the bowl with the butter , sour cream and milk , salt , pepper and cayenne
7. fold in the spinach and 1 / 2 the cheddar cheese
8. fill potato shells with this mixture
9. top with remaining cheddar cheese
10. these potatoes can be made in advance and kept in the refrigerator for a day prior to baking
11. bake at 350f for about 30 minutes or until heated through and the cheese on top has melted and browned a little
target.review: I work 12 hour shifts, three days in a row, so I am always trying to find something that will keep well in the fridge and reheat easily later.  These are one of the best things to prepare ahead of time.  I would just wrap one or two in foil and go to work!  My husband also loves taking these to work in his lunches.  I sometimes add chopped bacon or onions (both pre-cooked).  Check out this chef's walnut pie - it is to die for.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheddar chicken   vegetable skillet

i got this recipe from kraft canada and thought it looked good enough to post on here. i hope everyone enjoys!

1. spray large frying pan with cooking spray
2. add chicken
3. cover
4. cook on medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until browned
5. remove from pan
6. add vegetables and water
7. bring to boil
8. stir in stuffing mix just until moistened
9. top with chicken and cheese
10. cover
11. cook on low heat for 5 minutes or until cheese melts
12. variation for a flavour twist , try this recipe with different frozen vegetable blends: itlaian style , stir-fry , california or mexican
demonstrations.review: This is definitely delicious and easy to make.  Anyone could make this and I like how it only dirties one pan.  I used cornbread stuffing and added two cloves of garlic for more flavor and nutrition.  It's high in protein and low in fat, watch the cholesterol.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dukhobor borscht

whether this delightful dish is rightfully named i do not know but i do know it is well worth the effort.it is delicious immediately upon completion and just gets better and better each time you reheat it. thanks sue mcnally for providing recipe.

1. boil water in large soup pot
2. add four of the potatoes , carrots and beet , salt to taste
3. in large fry pan , fry onions with 6 tbs butter until golden brown , add tomatoes and fry a little longer
4. remove the potatoes only from the boiling water when they are cooked and mash with six tbs of butter
5. add half the contents of your frying pan to soup pot
6. peel and cube remaining potatoes and add to pot
7. now put remainder of contents of your frying pan into pot with 1tbs butter and boil for 5 min
8. meanwhile fry remainder of cabbage in the rest of the butter add celery , pepper and 1 cup of cabbage to pot and let boil for about two min
9. add mashed potatoes and dill
10. cook for two minutes
11. add fried cabbage
12. let simmer for a short while and serve
demonstrations.review: I had never made borscht before.  I have to say it was really fun and tasted delicious - it's perfect for serving to guests as a warm-up to the main meal.  I will definitely make again, it tasted real, fresh and healthy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
artichoke and chicken bake

this easy but elegant entree first appeared in "quick cooking" magazine. someone posted this at the somersize website, which is where i found it. i usually have this over a bed of fried spinach or zucchini ribbons.

1. preheat oven to 375
2. spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with pam
3. salt and pepper the chicken breast halves and place in the dish
4. in a bowl , combine the artichoke hearts , parmesan cheese , mayonnaise and garlic powder
5. mix well
6. spread artichoke mixture over chicken breasts
7. bake , uncovered , 30-35 minutes or until chicken juices run clear
demonstrations.review: I was really surprised at how good this is.  It is now one of our all-time favorites.  I used two cans of artichokes and rinsed them to decrease the tart taste (we love artichokes!).  I also used two cloves of fresh garlic - minced which gave it a wonderful flavor.  I always buy a large bag of seasoned chicken in the bulk section and this gave it more even more flavor.  And to decrease the calories and fat - I used Best Foods Reduced Fat Mayonaise.  Suberb!  I will have to double the amounts next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stuffed grape leaves

this recipe came from my grandfather, he was 100% lebanese. i have a lebanese reunion every year and this is what i make and it's the first to go. i serve it with my home made garlic sauce and lebanese bread yum!

1. wash& stem fresh grape leaves briefly to slightly wilt and drape over something
2. while drying make filling sauce
3. mix lamb , rice , seasonings , lemon juice and butter
4. stuff grape leaves with half of a tablespoon or more of the rice mixture
5. put the mixture close to the bottom where the stem was at , fold and roll like you would a burrito
6. when done stuffing , line bottom of stock pot with torn or broken grape leaves then layer with stuffed grape leaves firmly packed with loose flap down in a 3 quart pot , in tight parallel rows , alternating each layer the opposite way when done line with more torn grape leaves on top , put flat plate on top of grape leave and a pitcher of water on top of the plate to help keep it down
7. fill pot with about 4 to 6 cups of boiled water , 2 tablespoons of olive oil , and a 1 / 2 cup of lemon juice and salt so that it is just above the grape leaves
8. bring to boil and simmer for about 20 to 25 till done
9. remove grape leaves with tongs
demonstrations.review: The only thing this recipe is missing is mint and garlic.  This is very similiar to what I make.  My grandmother is lebanese and I grew up learning how to make all sorts of wonderful middle eastern cuisine.  The only thing I do differently is use white basmati rice - I get rave reviews from suspicious eaters when I use this rice.  It is very important that you rinse the leaves individually.  Also you can subsitute the lamb for ground beef.  don't try to make it "healthier" by using lean beef or ground turkey - it won't come out right.  Serve with pita bread and hummus for the full effect.  Other foods that go with it are falafels and tahini.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
onion lentils and rice

this recipe is adapted from "what to cook" cookbook. other than slicing the onions, it doesn't take a lot of prep time. this is what i make when i come home from work hungry and exhausted and want something yummy and filling for dinner.

1. heat olive oil in skillet , saute the onions with 1 tsp cumin until lightly browned
2. remove 1 / 3 of the onions and set aside
3. continue cooking the rest of the onions until dark brown and black in places
4. in the meantime , bring water to a boil in a saucepan , add the lentils , reduce heat , and cover , simmering for 15 minutes
5. to the lentils , add the 1 / 3 lightly browned onions , rice , salt , and remaining 1 tsp cumin
6. cover and simmer 15 minutes or until rice is tender
7. remove from heat and stir in the well-browned onions
8. cover and let stand for 5-10 minutes
9. serve !
10. especially good with chopped lettuce , tomatoes , and a dollop of yogurt or sour cream on top
11. also good with cooked spinach
demonstrations.review: I used Basmati rice for extra flavor. At first, the onions seemed like two much so I only cut up two, but when sauteed, they cook down to a smaller size and I ended up cutting the third onion. Definitely tasty. If you use Basmati rice you need to add about 1/4 extra water. I will defintely make this again.  My husband didn't like this.  It doesn't look very attractive so I think he judged it before he even tried it.  My mother's side of the family is lebanese and I know that they would love this.  Goes great with any middle eastern course.

target.recipe_text:
the best tres leches cake

this is so good! it's a moist, rich, sweet and yummy cake, made with a simple sauce that is poured over it, and slowly seeps into it. leaving you with heaven in every bite. "tres leche" means three milks therefor, this cake has three different types of milk: condensed, evaporated and regular milk. the top of the cake is ugly, because you have to poke holes in it, so i like to top it with whipped topping, and berries. try it!

1. mix together the cake mix , eggs , and water in a large bowl
2. pour into a greased large baking pan , and bake at 350 degrees for 25-35 minute or until toothpick comes out clean
3. meanwhile , in a large sauce pan heat up the three milks , and whisk until well combined
4. take the cake out of the oven , and let it cool for 15-20 minute once cool you can take either a tooth pick , or a fork and poke many holes into the cake
5. slowly pour milk mixture over the cake , so it seeps in through the holes
6. let it sit until all milk is absorbed , and thenplace in the refrigerator until cold
7. top with whipped topping , and enjoy !
target.review: Yum!  We made this , but followed the directions on the cake mix to bake the cake...then followed the rest of your directions.  I would suggest to anyone making this to prepare it at least a day in advance as the cake soaks up more of the milk as it chills overnight in the fridge.  We refrigerated it overnight, then spread a layer of Cool Whip Lite on top, and served.  It was delicious!  My brother loves to order Tres Leche cake at a local cafe and he deemed this one BETTER than the restaurant version!  So thanks a lot Leenie!  We can't wait to make it again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bev s spaghetti sauce

this is a recipe i have developed over a number of years. this is the only spaghetti sauce my family will request! very easy to make. i hope your family enjoys it as much as mine does!

1. brown the ground beef , onion and garlic in olive oil with bay leaves , oregano , basil , italian seasoning , salt and pepper
2. add tomato paste , tomato sauce and diced tomatoes
3. stir well and bring to a simmer over medium heat
4. cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
5. use sauce to top your cooked spaghetti
6. top with sauteed mushroom
7. pass the parmesan
demonstrations.review: Excellent sauce!  Very easy, too!  We followed the recipe as written but omitted the mushrooms as we don't care for them in our sauce and subbed ground turkey for the gr. beef.  We served it over spaghetti and it got rave reviews from all !  Tasted so much better than any jarred sauce..and it was not time consuming at all!  You will not be disappointed if you try this recipe!  We WILL be making this again!  Thanks Bev!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut squash souffle or kugel

this is a delicious healthy side dish. pretty enough for company, but kids enjoy the sweet taste! fresh squash is easy to cook in the microwave, but frozen tastes just as good. for the milk, i used nonfat, my neighbor uses mocha mix to make it non-dairy. from my neighbor, tiffanie, who is the best kosher cook ever!!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. if using fresh squash , microwave- cut in half , remove seeds , place cut side down in small amount of water , cover with plastic wrap and cook on high 15 minutes
3. scrape flesh from skin- should be 3-4 cups
4. beat together flour , sugar , oil , eggs , and milk
5. add squash and mix well
6. bake in 9x13 glass or ceramic baking dish for 60 minutes
7. can sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top after 30 minutes in oven
demonstrations.review: This was unbelievably easy to make and got so many oooohs and ahhhs from everyone who thought it must have taken a long time to prepare.  I ended up doubling the recipe and using an 8" round souffle dish only because I did not have the other size dish available and it worked out great.  I think I would use that same size dish again, as I think the souffle would be too shallow in a larger pan.  It was really a wonderful recipe loved by adults and kids alike.  Very creamy and rich tasting without all the fattening ingredients.  Just perfect!  We will be making again as a side dish this year for Thanksgiving! Thanks for a superb recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my favorite oriental coleslaw

i know there are other recipes for oriental coleslaw here. i mentioned in a thread on 

1. in a large bowl , break up ramen noodles into smaller pieces
2. add coleslaw mix , sunflower seeds , green onions , and water chestnuts
3. stir to combine
4. to make dressing: in a small bowl whisk together vinegar , oil , sugar , soy sauce and seasoning packets until combined
5. pour over salad , toss well to make sure dressing is evenly distributed
6. if you want the noodles to soften , refrigerate overnight
demonstrations.review: Very tasty and easy to prepare!! It did well in the fridge for a few days. The only complaint I had was it was a bit too sweet for my tastes, will definitely make it again, but will reduce the sugar a bit...thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crab quiche

we live on the oregon coast and lots of fresh crab is the benefit. this is very tasty.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a medium bowl , whisk together eggs , sour cream , milk , butter , flour , salt and pepper until thoroughly blended
3. fold in crab , cheese and onions , blending well , spread into prepared pie shell
4. bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: Fantastic recipe!!! I picked up some fresh crabmeat on sale and did a search here to see what recipe I could use it in. I ended up doubling the recipe and made 2 quiches.  Used Mrs. Smith's frozen pie shells.(first time using them and they were quite flaky and yummy!)  I brought the 2nd quiche over to my brothers house while it was still warm from the oven.  He isnt the type to give out praise so easily and he must have told me at least 3 times , "good job with that quiche!" as he kept on eating more of the quiche.  Thanks Marcie for a great and easy recipe that we will be making again and again!!  You rock!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian love cake

a luscious combination marble cake and cheese cake with a creamy chocolate topping. it tastes like a chocolate eclair

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. prepare cake as directed on box and pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
3. in separate bowl , combine ricotta , sugar , eggs , and vanilla
4. mix well
5. spoon over unbaked cake
6. bake cake for 1 hour
7. cool
8. mix instant pudding with milk
9. fold in whipped topping
10. spread over cake
11. refrigerate
demonstrations.review: I finally had the chance to bake this cake after seeing the recipe on here a few times! It came out great! I substituted Splenda for the sugar and used fat free Cool Whip just to keep the calories down. The cake only took 45 minutes to bake in my oven. I kept an eye on the cake as I noticed it began to brown before the recommended hour was up,but if I had left it in any longer it would have burned. It came out a beautiful golden brown on top. I grated dark chocolate shavings over the frosting before chilling it in the fridge. It made for a beautiful presentation! Everyone loved it!  Thanks so much for the recipe, Steve!

target.recipe_text:
chicken delicious

this is a fantastic crockpot recipe! found it on the internet years ago and have modified it some. the chicken is so tender, it falls apart, and it makes incredible gravy. it's my most requested recipe and our favorite meal. my daugters (ages 4 and 1) love it too! we eat it with a side of vegetable and sometimes with texas toast.

1. rinse chicken and pat dry
2. in a large bowl or meat platter , season chicken with lemon juice , pepper , celery salt and paprika
3. place in crock-pot
4. in medium bowl or pan , mix the soups with the sherry
5. pour over chicken breasts
6. sprinkle generously w / parmesan cheese
7. cover and cook on low 7 to 10 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours
8. serve over noodles or rice
target.review: Joy, this chicken dish was delicious so the name really fits. I used white wine in the sauce. Only cooked about 5 hours on low and the chicken was perfectly tender. The sauce was so creamy and rich. Thanks for a great crock-pot recipe. bella

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bandito chili dogs

i got this recipe for toh's quick cooking magazine. my dh and his buddies just absolutely raved about these. they were devoured!!

1. place hot dogs in a slow cooker
2. in a bowl , combine the chili , soup , and green chilies
3. pour over hot dogs
4. cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours
5. serve hot dogs in buns
6. top with chili mixture , onion , corn chips , and cheese
demonstrations.review: Talk about chili dogs with the works. This is the best as far as my husband and I are concerned. I put everything in the crockpot in the afternoon. It was ready right on time for dinner. The chili cheese sauce is to die for. We used all the toppings. I especially liked the corn chips. Great all-American food. Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked butternut squash with apples and maple syrup

i got this recipe years ago from bon appetit. perfect for the fall season.

1. cook squash in a large pot of boiling salted water until almost tender
2. about 3 minutes
3. drain well
4. combine squash , apples and currants in a 13x9 inch casserole dish
5. season with nutmeg , salt , and pepper
6. in a saucepan , combine maple syrup , butter , and lemon juice
7. whisk over low heat until butter melts
8. pour syrup over squash mixture and toss to coat
9. bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour or until squash and apples are very tender
10. stir occasionally
11. cool 5 minutes and serve
demonstrations.review: This dish is a real winner and that is coming from me and my husband. The squash and apples baked so very tender. The maple flavor and spices were the perfect enhancement. I am making this again and taking to my parent's house for Thanksgiving. I can't wait to share it with them. Thanks Nurse Di.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese tortellini with vegetables

nan

1. spray a nonstick skillet with non-fat cooking spray
2. on medium heat , saute onion and pepper for about 10 minutes
3. stir in chopped broccoli
4. pour in the lemon juice and wine
5. add the tarragon
6. cover and cook over low heat for about 15 minutes
7. prepare tortellini according to package directions while veggies are cooking
8. stir the olive oil and sun-dried tomatoes with the veggie mixture
9. serve over prepared tortellini
demonstrations.review: This is such a yummy, healthy stir fry recipe. The vegetables all combine well and the white wine-lemon juice accents their flavor. All served over yummy cheese tortellini. Just wonderful. Thanks Dancer^.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
harvest pumpkin cheesecake

indulge!!

1. in a small bowl , combine cracker crumbs and sugar
2. stir in the butter
3. press onto the bottom and 2 inches up the sides of a greased 9-inch springform pan
4. bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes
5. cool on a wire rack
6. in a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla until smooth
7. add eggs , pumpkin and spices
8. beat just until combined
9. pour into crust
10. place cheesecake / pan in a large rectangular baking pan filled with 2 inches of hot water
11. place in a 350 degree oven and bake for 1 hour or until center is almost set
12. remove cheesecake from oven and water-filled pan and cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes
13. carefully run a knife around edge of pan to loosen
14. cool 1 hour longer
15. refrigerate until completely cooled
16. remove sides of pan just before serving
17. garnish with whipped cream
demonstrations.review: This cheesecake made our Thanksgiving an elegant family celebration. It turned out beautifully. Very rich and the texture was smooth with no curdles. Received highest praise from all. Thanks Nurse Di.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bbq chicken sandwiches

toh; family favorite for fall/winter sports weekends.

1. in crock pot , combine all ingredients except buns
2. mix well
3. cook on low for 6-8 hours
4. serve on buns
5. we toast our hamburger buns
demonstrations.review: WOW!! This was very, very tasty and so easy. I cooked and shredded the chicken meat the night before. Put everything in the crockpot in the morning and cooked on low all day. We came home and had incredible BBQ sandwiches. So simple and easy. Something that will be a regular thing around here. Thanks Nurse Di.

target.recipe_text:
fresh green beans deluxe

these beans are so good. your family and guests will love them!!

1. cook bacon until crisp
2. drain on paper towels
3. to skillet drippings , add beans and saute for 10 minutes
4. add garlic
5. cook 2 minutes
6. stir in tomatoes , salt , and pepper
7. heat through
8. stir in bacon and almonds
target.review: This is the absolute best green beans recipe ever!  I've tried so many and some were good, but this was amazing!  The bacon added so much to the taste as well, the cherry tomatoes were yummy too!  Will make this a regular side dish from now on.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stir fried shrimp in garlic sauce

this has a great garlic flavor and tastes delicious with or without the heaters!

1. in a small bowl , mix together chicken broth , vinegar , soy sauce , sesame oil , chile paste and sherry
2. set aside
3. in another small bowl or cup , stir together the tbsp of cornstarch with the 3 tbsp of water and set aside
4. heat the oil over medium-high heat in a wok
5. add ginger and garlic and sizzle briefly , then add vegetables and thai chilies
6. stir-fry vegetables for approximately 3 minutes , then add the shrimp
7. cook the shrimp 2 minutes or until it curls and turns opaque or pink
8. add the sauce mixture and cook 1 minute more
9. then stir in the thickener and stir-fry until mixture thickens , about 1 minute
10. serve with hot cooked rice
demonstrations.review: Just needed a quick shrimp stir fry for dinner tonight.  Had *most* of the ingredients in hand so I thought I'll just play it by ear.  Things didn't start out right at first.  While mixing the sauce, I mistook a carton of beef broth for chicken broth.  But oh well.  Didn't have rice wine vinegar so used white wine vinegar.  Didn't have sherry or sake so just used white wine.  Didn't bother with the chiles as I was cooking for two kids, 7 and 2.  But when all was said and done, this actually turned out fantastic!  I was so happy that everything came together and the kids and hubby ate without complaint.  I'm so glad I found this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baltimore crab cakes

phillips seafood restaurant, in baltimore's inner harbor, serves some of the best crab cakes i have ever had. here is a copycat recipe for this traditional maryland delicacy

1. whisk together all ingredients except crab meat
2. fold in crab meat
3. divide mixture into 4 parts and shape into cakes approximately 3 / 4 thick
4. pan fry the cakes in a little peanut oil or canola oil
5. serve hot , garnished with lemon
demonstrations.review: I'm afraid this recipe did nothing for me.  Hubby kinda' liked it, but it just wasn't what I expected.  Very easy to make and I put more than the specified amount of Old Bay but that didn't help unfortunately.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swedish apple pie

this is a "no crust" apple pie that my mom used to make. it is great served alone or with vanilla ice cream. this is a "must" for our family at holiday gatherings.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. fill pie pan 3 / 4 full with apples
3. mix 1 / 4 cup sugar and 3 tsp cinnamon
4. sprinkle over apples
5. in saucepan , melt butter and remove from heat
6. add remaining ingredients
7. pour evenly over the apples in pan
8. bake 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was beyond excellent!  From the first taste, my hubby was hooked, and that's saying a LOT about my apple pie "connoiseur", lol!  But we gobbled it up so fast, we couldn't get over how yummy it was.  Hubby told me to use half brown suger and half granulated suger, which made an almost caramel-like sauce after it was baked.  Yum!  Will make this over and over again...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker rustic chicken stew

nan

1. combine the first 5 ingredients in the crockery pot
2. stir in the next 5 ingredients
3. cover and cook on low until the chicken is done and the vegetables are tender , 7-9 hrs
4. or on high 4-6 hrs
5. stir in the peas and cook until they are done , 15 to 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was surprisingly awesome!  No onions but threw in 2 quartered shallots and 3 smashed garlic cloves.  Everything else was exactly to the recipe.  Cooked on high for 4 1/2 hours and the house smelled yummy.  Served with crusty bread and went back for seconds! :-D

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jo mama s world famous spaghetti

my kids will give up a steak dinner for this spaghetti. it is a recipe i have been perfecting for years and it is so good (if i may humbly say) that my kids are disappointed when they eat spaghetti anywhere else but home! in fact they tell me i should open a restaurant and serve only this spaghetti and garlic bread. in response to requests, i have posted the recipe for recipe #28559 that uses approximately 1/2 of the sauce from this
