The only reason I didnt give it 5 full stars was because I think they need a bit more sugar. Even 1/4 C extra and without the toppings I used they were just a bit too dark tasting. Great recipe tho! Thank you Kittencal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork tenderloin w  balsamic marinade

this is an incredibly tasty way prepare a pork tenderloin. i could not get over how delicious it was. even my young kids like it. the amount of chili powder is deceiving, i thought it would be very spicy and it was not.
absolutely perfect for company!  serve with buttered noodles, baked apple sauce and you're good to go! enjoy.
note: 6-8 hour marination time required

1. trim and rinse pork as needed
2. place in a ziplock bag or dish with a tight seal
3. whisk together all ingredients until thoroughly blended
4. pour marinade over pork
5. marinate in refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight , turning occasionally
6. heat grill to medium high
7. grill pork until center is pale pink , about 15-17 minutes or to desired doneness
8. let rest for 5 minutes , slice & serve immediately
9. may need to adjust cooking time + / - depending on the size & thickness or the tenderloin
10. the chili powder does not add the heat you may expect
11. not sure why , but it won't be spicy as one might anticipate
demonstrations.review:
I have done this twice now and I know I will make it again. I usually marinate over night then all day until time to grill. I have never done this in the oven so I am speaking from a grilling stand point only.

I find it keeps the meat tender, juicy and wonderful flavor. It is a recipe I will use for years to come. Thank you!

target.recipe_text:
sausage wraps

this is fast and easy to make and yummy. it's a big hit for either breakfast or an appetizer at a party. kids love them and so do adults. you can either use already formed sausage patties or make your own patties from a tube of sausage. i prefer to make my own, you can make them a bit smaller and have a little variety as to what kind of seasoned sausage you use.

1. preheat oven to 375
2. in a skillet cook up the patties or form your own patties , small
3. remove from heat and blot on paper towel
4. seperate and cut dough into triangles enough for each patty
5. brush with the mustard and place piece of cheese small enough to fit under the patty
6. place sausage on top of triangle and wrap around it , covering most of it by crisscrossing
7. place wrapped patty on ungreased cookie sheet or baking stone and bake for 11-13 minutes or until golden brown
8. how many this yields depends mostly on how big you make the patties and how many triangles you cut
9. for ready made patties it makes 8
target.review: These were fabulous!  I was skeptical about the mustard...but it was great!  These were pretty, light and tasty all at once.  I used the hot sausage as we are "spicy" food people, my kids ate all the leftovers for "brunch"!  Ha!  Thanks!  I loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
healing ginger detox tea with turmeric

adapted from the seasonal detox diet, by carrie l’esperance.  there has been a lot in the news lately about the amazing healing properties of turmeric, a free-radical-fighting antioxidant-rich spice that has been hailed as a defense against both cancer and alzheimer’s.

1. bring water to a boil , then add powdered herbs
2. simmer for 10 minutes
3. strain tea into a mug , add maple syrup and lemon , stirring to combine
4. drink warm
demonstrations.review: I am so glad I found this recipe. I have a teen son with cancer, and have studied on foods that can possibly help later in his years with recurrence etc.  Apparently, turmeric is one of the most powerful spices there are, along with ginger and green tea.  I read a book called Anti Cancer: A New Way of LIfe.  Studies show that a pinch (just a pinch) of black pepper increases the power of the turmeric by 1000 times.  I dashed it in my tea and although it doesn't look pleasing, I didn't taste any difference!  This has grown on me, a die hard coffee and diet coke drinker.  My son likes it too.  Thanks!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best white chicken chili

this is the first recipe i ever tried for white chili, and it is the best one i have ever found. i found it in a cookbook called so fat, low fat, no fat, but don't let that fool you. the chili may be low on fat but it has a fantastic flavor and always gets raves every time i make it. this is not the exact recipe in the book, as i have made a few minor adjustments to make it a little easier.

1. in a 5-qt stockpot , combine water with the lemon pepper , 1 tsp ground cumin , and olive oil
2. bring to a boil
3. add the chicken breast halves and return to a low boil , then reduce the heat to low and simmer 20-30 minutes or until the chicken is fork tender and the juices are clear
4. remove the chicken from the broth and cut into bite-size pieces , then return it to the broth
5. add the garlic , onion , corn , green chiles , 1 tsp ground cumin , lime juice , and great northern beans to the broth
6. bring to a boil
7. simmer until thoroughly heated , about 45 minutes
8. to serve , ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle cheese on top
9. refrigerate any leftovers
10. this chili is usually even better heated up the next day
demonstrations.review: I loved this recipe.  I've tried several on this site, and they are all very good, but this one was the easiest!!  I threw EVERYTHING into a crockpot and walked out the door.  When I came home, it was ready. I added chopped fresh cilantro, shredded the chicken and returned to the pot.  We crushed corn chips over the top, some shredded cheese, sour cream and served with steamed tortillas! YUM!!!!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and spaghetti casserole

i never liked spinach til i had to try this recipe at my sister-n-laws and from than on i made this casserole for special dinners i either attended or made for supper at home. its a favorite to many of my friends and family and i thought i would share with everyone here at recipezaar. hope you like it too!

1. preheat oven to 350'
2. cook spinach and drain well
3. cook angel hair spaghetti according to package and drain well
4. combine egg , sour cream , milk , parmesan cheese , chopped onion , salt , black pepper , and montery jack cheese in a large bowl
5. stir well to combine add cooked / drained spaghetti and spinach to mixture and mix well
6. grease lightly a casserole dish and spread mixture into dish
7. cover casserole dish and bake for 15 minutes than take out of oven and uncover and bake for 45 minutes longer in oven or until lightly browned
demonstrations.review: I liked this recipe alot.  My kids liked it.  The only thing I might add is more moisture, such as cream of mushroom.  Had good flavor, but mine was dry when I pulled it out of the oven.  Thanks for a good keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
plum tomato   feta pasta

a wonderful side dish. the feta cheese adds a special touch to this recipe.

1. cook pasta according to package directions
2. drain
3. combine tomatoes , onion , oil , parsley , salt and pepper in a large mixing bowl
4. add feta and warm pasta
5. toss
6. can serve at room temperature or chill before serving
demonstrations.review: This dish is so fast, so simple, and tastes amazing!  I have made it 3 times now, once each week on the busy nights we have football practice.  It saves time, money, and you can eat together at home!  Thank you very much for this recipe!!!  It is awesome!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hamburger skillet meal

delicious!

1. cut up 3 strips of bacon and fry until crisp
2. add 1 lb hamburger meat and 3 tbsp chopped onions and brown
3. add 1 / 4 cup soy sauce , 1 / 4 tsp pepper and 1 / 2 cup water
4. add the last 5 vegetables in layers
5. cover and cook over high heat for 1 minute
6. reduce heat and cook slowly for 15 minutes more
demonstrations.review: I liked this recipe.  I added Louisiana Hot Sauce cuz we like spicy, and also used ground venison.  My husband loved the cabbage.  It's a good recipe and an easy one to have around as a "staple".  Easy and flavorful.

target.recipe_text:
roy rogers crispy fried chicken   copycat

posted in response to a request and located in an online search.  roy rogers® was a huge fast-food chain in the eastern u.s. the chain was unique because not only did they offer-up burgers, but fried chicken as well. people really enjoyed their chicken. in fact, to this day there are arguments over who had better chicken---roy rogers® or kfc®.  hardees® bought the chain, and eventually phased it out---much like they did with burger-chef®.
this is a "per-serving" recipe. multiply by number of servings. (one serving= 3 drumsticks).  prep time is estimated.

1. pre-heat your deep fryer to 375
2. in a mixing bowl , blend egg whites and milk with a wire whisk -- set aside
3. measure dry ingredients into a gallon sized zip lock type bag , close , and shake well to mix
4. generously coat the drumsticks with the milk-egg mixture , and place them in the bag of seasonings
5. then shake the bag until well coated
6. drop into deep fryer and allow to cook 15 minutes
7. when the drumsticks are done , they will be a dark golden brown
8. remove crispy chicken and drain on a paper towel lined plate
9. caution ! they will be very hot , so allow them to cool 5-8 minutes before serving
10. just cut up boneless breasts into bite sized pieces , coat with milk-egg / seasoning and deep fry
11. just be sure to coat well and adjust cooking time for the different sizes of chicken
target.review: Ok seriously only 3 people have reviewed this recipe... I happened upon this recipe because I had a package of drumsticks and just needed some idea's I originally was gonna make catitore but desided last min to make fried chicken and OMG let me tell you that this is dead on to roy rogers!!!!... My husband who normally doesn't like chicken legs loved when I made this.. it was like a blast from the past!!  there are no roy rogers around us anymore..last one is on the parkway about 1 hour away.. so this was so delish. and hit the stop..i cannot wait to try it with wings and thighs as well.. only one thing I didn't add was msg because I didn't even know that you can buy that in the store lol.. so happy you shared... everyone needs to try this!!<br/><br/>ok _ so tonight  2/13/2014 DH wanted this again.. craving it ever since I made it.. so this time I breaded chicken cutlets and guess what... still delish!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pecans sweet vanilla

this was from the telephone pioneers, ms chapter #36 and called bell's best.  i wanted the title to tell me more about what was in it.  i like using the egg white as the flavor binder.

1. whip egg white and slowly add the brown sugar mixed with flour
2. add salt and vanilla flavoring , then fold in pecans
3. lay on greased pan and bake at 250 degrees for 45 minutes or less
demonstrations.review:
OMG i cannot believe no one has ever made and reviewed these delish candy before!!
I came across tonight and instantly was inticed by the ingredient list!!
I had all on hand and made a batch and it was sweet without being overly sweet and light and fluffy from the egg whites and crunchy from the toasted nuts!! you must try.. do not overlook try now and you may be as hooked as i am.. k got to go and eat some more!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tsr version of breakfast burritos mcdonald s by todd wilbur

from top  secret recipes www.topsecretrecipes.com. "this famous food chain begun offered breakfast back in the late seventies, shortly after introducing the egg mcmuffin. the company quickly realized the potential of a quick, drive-thru breakfast, and developed several breakfast selections. the breakfast burrito was introduced in 1991, and nowadays, one out of every four breakfasts eaten on the is from mcdonald's."

1. preheat a skillet over medium heat
2. crumble the sausage into the pan , then add the onion
3. saut the sausage and onion for 3 to 4 minutes or until the sausage is browned
4. add the mild green chilies and continue to saut for 1 minute more
5. pour the beaten eggs into the pan and scramble the eggs with the sausage and vegetables
6. add a dash of salt and pepper
7. heat up the tortillas by steaming them in the microwave in moist paper towels or a tortilla steamer for 20 to 30 seconds
8. break each slice of cheese in half and position two halves end-to-end in the middle of each tortilla
9. to make the burrito , spoon 1 / 4 of the egg filling onto the cheese in a tortilla
10. fold one side of the tortilla over the filling , then fold up about two inches of one end
11. fold over the other side of the tortilla to complete the burrito
12. serve hot with salsa on the side , if desired
13. repeat with remaining ingredients
14. makes 4 burritos
demonstrations.review:
this was so easy and so delish,, it totally tasted like the one from mac donalds, except the eggs werent microwaved and all ingredients were fresh and not frozen :) thanks for posting this,, when i get a min in the day i will upload the pics i took

thanks for posting

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy layered taco bake

i received a booklet from kraft foods today which is called "food & family" and this is one of the recipes in it that i am posting here to try at a later date.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. prepare the mac & cheese dinner as directed on package
3. cook meat with taco seasoning
4. layer seasoned meat , mac & cheese and salsa in 8-inch square baking dish
5. bake 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: Made this for dinner tonight...the only thing I substituted was egg noodles for the Mac and cheese..because I have a can of 'Mac yourself' and will make a homemade type of Mac and. Cheese...it smells delish...thanks for sharing!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
suzy q cake

i forgot that i had this recipe until someone asked about it.  shaped and tastes like the suzy-q snack cakes (made by hostess)!

1. in a large mixing bowl , beat together cake mix , water , vegetable oil and eggs until smooth
2. pour into a greased and floured 13" x 9" pan and bake according to the package directions
3. when cake is cooled , remove from pan to flat surface and cut cake in half horizontally
4. to prepare filling , cook flour and milk in a saucepan over low heat until thickened
5. whisking often
6. cool mixture completely in refrigerator
7. while heated mixture cools , beat together sugar , crisco , salt and vanilla
8. add to cooled flour / milk mixture and beat until smooth and creamy
9. spread filling on 1 half of cake
10. place other half of cake on top and sprinkle with powdered sugar , if desired
demonstrations.review: Great recipe... I made this tonight for my mother in laws birthday tomorrow.. suzie q's are her most favorite snack cake and when I found this recipe I knew this was definitely for her..I did have an issue with making the filling.. only because I goofed the instructions,,, so I dumped it and retried and the second time it came out pretty good.. I don't know if I did something wrong but the texture was kinda lumpy and not like whipped cream.. but I tasted it and it was delish so I filled the cake anyway.. I figure a night in the fridge may help set up the filling just right,,  thank you so much for sharing as I know my MIL will love it!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey garlic chicken skewers

these can be grilled on the bbq for about 5-6 minutes also. make certain to soak the wooden skewers for minimum 30 minutes to prevent from burning, this recipe makes about 12 skewers but can be doubled if desired, these are popular at my bbq get togethers, hope you enjoy!

1. for the marinade: combine all ingredients
2. coat the chicken strips in the marinade to coat well
3. transfer to a glass dish
4. cover and marinate overnight
5. thread the chicken strips on the water-soaked wooden skewers
6. preheat the broiler to high heat
7. arrange the skewers on a greased foil-lined baking sheet
8. broil for about 6-7 minutes until well browned and thoroughly cooked
demonstrations.review:
ok well i was a but hesitant about trying this recipe because all the reviews seem to be a lot of misses

what i did.. i did not have any honey so i substituted maple syrup and just about increased all ingredients by double..I omitted the hot sauce cause dh and ds do not care for it

i also added some pats of butter to the tops of each kabob.. i only had enough to make 4 kabobs.. and stuck them under the broiler until chicken was cooked.. sprinkled a little garlic salt after they came and and they were delish!!!! def adding this to my keeper box..

these are the best quickest to cook ( after the overnight in the marinade) yum yum yum in my tum tum

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s chocolate frosting icing

a wonderful frosting i have used for years made in very little time with perfect results and 100% better than any canned, this frosting is so good you will find yourself eating a fair amount of it before even using it to frost with! --- choose the amount of cocoa powder you desire for either a light, medium or dark frosting, and make certain to sift the cocoa powder and the confectioners sugar before using for the recipe--- this frosting *freezes* very well so double the recipe and freeze one batch for next time --- *note* for an ultra creamy fluffy milk chocolate frosting add in 1 to 1-1/2 cups thawed cool whip topping at the end of mixing the frosting and beat on low speed until blended ------- also see my recipe#80118 ---- recipe#282040 --- recipe#90142

1. cream the butter in a small bowl
2. blend in the cocoa powder , vanilla , confectioners sugar , alternately with the cream
3. beat with an electric mixer , until the desired texture is achieved
target.review:
This was scrumptious.  I love that I can pick how chocolately I want my icing to be.  I paired it with Rainy Day Yellow Cake (Recipe #108059) and it was such a great combo.
Update: I used cream instead of milk and it is so much better -

demonstrations.recipe_text:
24k carrots

carrots coated with a yummy butter, brown sugar and ginger sauce. i grew up eating these in texas. easy, quick and yummy!-- great way to get kids to enjoy this veggie! if you like a lot of sauce double the sauce ingredients. i posted this less 'saucy' to keep the fat and calories down. the sauce is yummy and great on rice or just on a spoon! hope you enjoy it as much as we do!  i am so honored that this simple little recipe of mine has been so well received. thank you all for your reviews!

1. cook carrots until tender- or to desired doneness
2. melt butter and add brown sugar and ginger , stirring to blend
3. add sauce to carrots and stir to coat
demonstrations.review: Mama, these are absolutely great!  I mixed the sauce separately and poured it over the sliced carrots which I had in a glass bowl, covered it with plastic wrap as recommended by MollyJ, and microwaved it 6 minutes.  Perfection....

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate fudge frosting   dairy free

a special treat for chocolate cake lovers.

1. mix all ingredients except vanilla
2. bring to full rolling boil and boil for 1 minute
3. remove from heat , add vanilla and beat until creamy
demonstrations.review: I am extremely happy with this recipe, especially considering it doesn't call for eggs or milk.  I halved the recipe and it was just enough for 12 cupcakes (with extra frosting on each).  I boiled the mixture about 2 minutes rather than one.  While the result was a big grainy, I like it that way.  I don't think I've ever had frosting that calls for granulated sugar be perfectly smooth -- I think it's just a more old-fashioned taste, that I personally enjoy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
softest ever bread machine bread

my sister gave me this recipe soon after i brought home my bread machine. it's a staple in our house. soft and fluffy and great for sandwiches or just to eat fresh out of the oven!
update 3/25/2005 - i made this using the dough cycle of my bread maker today but baked it in the oven and it turned out perfectly! i baked it at 350°f for 25-30 minutes.

1. place the water , sugar and yeast in the pan of the bread machine
2. let the yeast dissolve and foam for 10 minutes
3. add the oil , flour and salt to the yeast
4. select basic or white bread setting , and press start
5. you can also use the dough cycle of your bread maker and then place in a greased loaf pan
6. punch down and let rise again and then bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until done
demonstrations.review: This is my regular bread recipe!  I make it about 3 times a week.  My husband likes to eat it plain as well as with sandwiches.  It does taste better with all white bread flour, but I usually try to use at least one cup of whole wheat flour.  I also add a few tablespoons of whole wheat gluten.  It's important to take the bread directly out of the bread machine and out of the pan as soon as possible so it doesn't get soggy on the bottom.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted garlic mashed potatoes   the best you ve ever had

nan

1. separate head of garlic into individual cloves
2. toss in olive oil and wrap tightly in small piece of aluminum foil
3. bake in 350f oven for 45 minutes
4. when the garlic has cooled to the touch you should be able to squeeze it out of the 'paper' shell of the individual cloves
5. mash the roasted garlic with a fork , or force through a fine strainer
6. if you use a ricer as recommended below , simply rice the garlic along with the potatoes
7. peel and boil potatoes in salted water until tender
8. force the cooked potatoes through a ricer or mash by your usual method
9. put the riced potatoes , garlic , sour cream , butter , and salt and white pepper in a mixer bowl , and whip at medium speed until smooth
10. add cream or milk to adjust consistency
demonstrations.review: This turned out really great, however I used less butter, more olive oil, about a teaspoon of cayenne (we like it spicy!) and fresh ground black pepper instead of white pepper.  Added a little 2% milk and it was great as a side to simmered round beef and sauteed whole kernel corn!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
demonstrations.review: I made this bread into muffins, and cooked them for about 40 minutes... I can see how it would be much better in a loaf pan.  My muffins turned out dry, though still good.  They tasted a bit plain to me; next time I might add pecans or walnuts.

target.recipe_text:
gnocchi al gorgonzola

this is a creamy dish. it goes well with the gnocchi. use as a main course or side dish. you could use the sauce on other types of pasta too.

1. put crumbled gorgazola into bowl with melted butter and a pinch of pepper
2. blend with a wooden spoon until creamy
3. stir in parmesan and heated cream
4. keep sauce warm
5. bring a large pan of salted water to a boil
6. add gnocchi carefully to boiling water
7. stir and cook briskly
8. when they come to surface , remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to bowl with the sauce
9. stir well to coat gnocchi with sauce
10. serve immediately
target.review: Oh my goodness - this is soooooo good.  I made it according to recipe the first time - it was amazing but I felt guilty about the calories.  So the second time I made it, I used only 1 Tbsp butter and replaced the cream with 1% milk with 1 tsp cornstarch.  To be honest, it wasn't as creamy as the first time, but for the huge calorie and fat reduction, it was still pretty darn good.  Actually if I hadn't had the original recipe first, I would probably give the lower fat version a 5 star anyway.  The picture I uploaded had some fresh basil added for garnish.  This is an amazing recipe.  Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
outstanding oatmeal bread for bread machine

really really good bread right out of you bread machine.crunchy!!!
i have been using the bread machine and baking it in the oven with great success. try 1/2 white and 1/2 whole wheat flour for and even better flavour.

1. add the water , butter , honey in the bread machine
2. add dry milk , salt and flour
3. add yeast in a groove on top of the flour
4. you can make the bread on the white bread cycle or on the dough cycle
5. when the beep comes on
6. add oatmeal
7. if you chose the dough cycle remove and shape into one loaf or 2 smaller ones
8. sprinkle a bit of oatmeal on top
9. preheat oven 375
10. let rise app 40 minutes
11. lower heat to 350 and bake at app 30 minutes
12. optional
13. use 1 / 2 whole wheat flour
14. success hints: for added texture , add the oats after the first knead or at the beep on the fruit and nut cycle
15. for additional crunch , sprinkle a few oats on top of the loaf after the final rise
16. when you are baking it in the machine and you see it rising to the top while it is baking , use a needle to make a few tiny holes to punch it slowly down and it avoids having it ruin the top of the bread
17. instant oatmeal doesn't work , but quick-cooking oats do
demonstrations.review: Possibly the best bread machine recipe I've ever tried.  Crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside.  I used the 2.0 lb White Bread cycle on the light crust setting.  Absolutely fantastic!!!  Thanks so much for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tilapia a la portuguesa

this is very easy to make and is simply delicious. the wine is an optional ingredient, but i think it really gives the fish great flavor.

1. preheat oven to 375
2. place fillets in a baking dish
3. brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
4. layer vegetables over fish , and add wine if using
5. season veggies with salt and pepper to taste
6. cover baking dish tightly with foil
7. bake 25-30 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork , and veggies are tender
8. another way to do this is to pan fry the fish in a little olive oil , sautee the vegetables until tender and spoon the sauce over the fish
9. i just think that the oven is easier
10. garnish with fresh chopped parsley
demonstrations.review: Simple recipe.  Super tasty and healthy.  I didn't have any Chardonnay, so I put in some cooking sherry - still tasted wonderful.  I thickened the wine sauce a little with cornstarch and it was fantastic over rice.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low fat shrimp pasta salad

not sure about the serving size on this recipe because i have not made it yet and it does not tell you. i would guess about 4.

1. cook pasta until al dente
2. cool and rinse pasta
3. mix well with other ingredients
4. chill
demonstrations.review: This is fabulous.  I was never convinced that low-fat yogurt could taste good in a salad, but this converted me.  I had half a zucchini left in the fridge, so I tossed it in too (I put the zucchini in the pasta water for a minute to get rid of the "raw" taste). I've made this twice now, the second time I used fennel instead of celery, and both times, it turned out wonderfully.  Absolutely fantastic recipe.  Thanks so much!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy to prepare honeydew sago pudding

a light, easy-to-prepare, delicious dessert! perfect after a heavy meal. plus the yellow-and-white combination looks wonderful! (the 3 hours cook time includes the time taken to chill the dessert)

1. soak sago in water for 5 minutes
2. bring milk to a boil- keep stirring or else the milk will stick to the bottom of the pot
3. add sugar to milk
4. drain the sago and add sago to milk
5. cook milk / sago mixture until sago changes colour
6. add diced honeydew after milk / sago mixture has cooled
7. serve chilled !
demonstrations.review: This is very similar to an authentic Chinese honeydew sago dessert soup, just a little thicker and richer.  Fabulous recipe, super easy to make.  If you want the dessert to look a little more exotic, puree 1/2 cup of honeydew melon and add to the cooled mixture to make a funky green dessert soup.  Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tofu  alfredo  sauce

this is a very creamy guilt free sauce.

1. cook pasta per package directions
2. whiz the rest of the ingredients in a blender until smooth
3. pour over hot pasta and mix well
demonstrations.review: This low-fat tofu sauce is ridiculously good.  It is so creamy that I actually got that I-am-being-a-pig feeling when I was eating it.  I tried one variation that worked out quite well - I added a couple drops of liquid smoke and voila, you got yourself a vegetarian carbonara sauce!  Awesome recipe.

target.recipe_text:
buttermilk chicken

this is one of the easiest, most flavorful chicken recipes. the chicken is extremely tender... but it's the gravy that makes this dish remarkable.

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. melt margarine in a 9x13 inch casserole dish or baking pan
3. mix flour , salt , pepper
4. dip chicken in 1 / 2 cup of buttermilk
5. dredge chicken in flour mixture
6. place chicken in melted margarine
7. bake for 30 minutes , uncovered
8. turn chicken and bake for 15 minutes
9. mix soup and remaining cup of buttermilk
10. pour soup / buttermilk mixture over chicken
11. bake another 15 minutes , until bubbly
12. take care , if 425 degrees f seems to be too hot , turn oven down a bit to prevent margarine from burning
target.review: Made this for my hubby and I tonight and it turned out great!  Love the gravy and the chicken was very moist and tender.  I used cream of chicken soup like the other review and I baked this at 400 for the first 15 minutes then at 375.  I served this with mashed potatoes and a veggie.  Thanks for the recipe Vickie and I will be making this again for sure!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon swirl quick bread

this rich quick bread is a favorite with my family. i often give my husband a few slices to take with him on his commute to work, along with a tall travel mug of coffee.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. in a large mixing bowl , beat together butter , 1 cup sugar , and egg
3. combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. add the flour mixture to the egg mixture alternately with the buttermilk
5. in a small bowl , combine the cinnamon and remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar
6. pour a third of the batter into a greased 8x4x2-inch loaf pan
7. sprinkle a third of the cinnamon sugar on top of batter
8. repeat layers twice
9. bake for 45-50 minutes , until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
10. cool in pan for 10 minutes
11. remove from pan to a wire rack to cool completely
demonstrations.review:
This bread was great! Very easy and quick to make.  I did find that making it in a 9x5 pan was better and to put more cinnamon/sugar mixtue on the first two layers and less on top.  I will definitely make this again. My husband and I could not stop eating it!
Thanks
KEP

demonstrations.recipe_text:
melt in your mouth pumpkin bread

i got this recipe out of a church cookbook many years ago. it is a simple and delicious pumpkin bread. my daughter who hates coconut loves this bread. it is so moist and tasty that it really does melt in your mouth.

1. mix oil , eggs and pumpkin
2. combine remaining ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture
3. bake in a 9x5x3-inch pan at 325 for 1 hour
demonstrations.review:
This pumpkin bread has got to be the best one I have ever made! My husband cannot get enough of it! So easy to make. I could not find instant coconut pudding mix, but used vanilla and added a teaspoon of coconut extract. Will try the regular coconut pudding next time. I also added some chopped pecans.
Thank you so much Mystery Girl for sharing this recipe!
KEP

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ham  egg and cheese breakfast bake

a standard egg casserole at our house. great with left-over ham or turkey. you can also add bacon or veggies if you like.

1. add milk to eggs
2. mix egg mixture , salt and pepper together
3. spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray
4. put bread pieces in bottom of pan
5. sprinkle ham or sausage over bread and sprinkle cheese over the meat
6. pour egg mixture over all
7. bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes
demonstrations.review:
This was easy and tasted great.  I added some green pepper and some red pepper flakes which we prefer things a little spicy and it turned out very nice.  Love it because we had some left-over ham to use.
Thanks for sharing!
Kep

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberries   cream bread  strawberry or blueberry

a wonderful recipe using fresh strawberries from netherhill strawberry farm in australia. this recipe also yields a tried and true (and reviewed) great blueberry & cream bread.

1. combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
2. set aside
3. in small bowl , beat butter until creamy
4. gradually add sugar , beat 1 minute or until light and airy
5. add brown sugar
6. beat in eggs , one at a time
7. beat in sour cream and vanilla
8. stir into flour mixture only until dry ingredients are moistened
9. fold in strawberries and nuts
10. pour into a greased 8 x 4 inch loaf pan
11. bake at 350f for 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
12. let stand 10 minutes in pan
13. turn out on rack to cool
demonstrations.review:
So glad I tried this recipe!  It was so good and moist.  My hubby and I loved it!  I used Blueberry's and will make it again for sure.  I used the light brown sugar and it was just right for us!  I had it for breakfast today and could have eaten more, but I want to save some for my husband!
Thanks for the recipe!
Kep

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amish sugar cream pie

my whole family loves this recipe, even my husbands family loves it!  this came from an amish family in indiana.

1. in sauce pan combine , white sugar , salt , half-and-half and whipping cream
2. bring to a boil
3. in another sauce pan , combine br
4. sugar & cornstarch
5. gradually whisk in hot mixture into br
6. sugar mixture
7. add margarine / or butter
8. cook over med
9. heat , whisk constantly , 5 min or until thick
10. simmer 1 minute and stir in van
11. pour into uncooked pie shell and sprinkle w / cinnamon and nutmeg
12. bake at 375f for 25 minutes
13. i recommend recipe #126072 for this pie
demonstrations.review:
Great pie!  Easy to make and I will make it again for sure! I made this for my family on Thanksgiving and they really enjoyed it and want me to make this again!  Since I am in Indiana, I knew this receipe would be good!  Thanks!
Kep

target.recipe_text:
pork and noodle skillet dinner

a yummy stick-to-your-ribs dinner that has become one of my favorites! inexpensive to make-i use pork shoulder steak (the cheap stuff) and the dish turns out wonderfully.

1. trim fat from pork and cut into thin , bite sized strips
2. cook pork and onion in oil in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat
3. for 3-4 minutes
4. stir in all remaining ingredients and bring to boil
5. reduce heat to simmer
6. cover and cook for 12-15 minutes , or until noodles are tender
target.review: This recipe was very tasty, and a nice change from our usual chicken dinners.  It was extremely easy to make, and my family really enjoyed it.  Thanks for the great recipe!  I'll definitely be making it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fried macaroni and cheese

nan

1. cook macaroni in water and the salt until tender
2. drain
3. in a large skillet , heat the butter or margarine , pour the well drained macaroni into the skillet
4. beat the eggs as for scrambled , pour this over the macaroni
5. fry on medium heat
6. add the shredded cheese over the top and cook until the eggs , macaroni , and cheese are all blended and a golden brown on both sides
demonstrations.review: This wasn't my favorite macaroni and cheese.  My son liked it a lot, but I didn't think it had much flavor.  I would say that it needs some additional spices.  I probably won't try it again.  Sorry Troy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked chicken and dressing

this dish is good enough for company. it is an easy dish to make and looks good. the chicken stays very moist.

1. place chicken in baking dish , sprayed with no-stick spray
2. put cheese on top of each piece of chicken
3. mix soup and water and pour over the top
4. mix melted margarine with dressing and sprinkle on top of cheese
5. bake 1 hour , uncovered , at 325 f degrees
demonstrations.review: My family loved this recipe.  I followed a previous reviewer's advice and mixed the soup in with the stuffing before I baked it.  The stuffing turned out very moist, and the everything was delicious!  This one is definitely a keeper!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian hamburgers

these tasty seasoned hamburgers are topped with tomato sauce and parmesan cheese. they make a quick and delicious meal. serve alone or over pasta.

1. combine the first seven ingredients
2. add beef and 3 tblsp
3. of parmesan cheese
4. mix well
5. shape into six patties
6. in a skillet , brown patties for 2 minutes on each side
7. combine the tomato saude and italian seasoning
8. pour over patties
9. reduce heat
10. cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until meat is no longer pink
11. sprinkle with remaining cheese
12. serve patties and sauce alone or over pasta if desired
demonstrations.review: My son pronounced these the best hamburgers he has ever had.  I made them last week and I'm already planning to make them again this week.  I served the burgers on buns.  They looked and tasted a little bit like pizza burgers.  We may never want plain hamburgers again!  Thanks for a great recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy spaghetti and ham bake

i couldn't find a spaghetti and ham pie on zaar. this came from southernfood.com.

1. in a skillet , melt butter with oil , saute mushrooms until tender
2. add green onions and ham , saute for 2 more minutes
3. stir in flour , gradually add broth and milk
4. add cheese , stirring until smooth and thickened
5. salt and pepper to taste
6. combine with spaghetti and pour into a lightly buttered deep dish pie plate or casserole
7. top with buttered bread crumbs , if desired
8. bake for 20 minutes at 325
demonstrations.review: This has become one of my family's favorite meals.  I change the recipe a little bit.  I leave out the green onions and mushrooms (I am the only one who likes mushrooms).  Basically I saute the ham and then follow the rest of the recipe, except that I use pasta instead of spaghetti, and increase the amount of cheese (1 cup of cheddar and 2 cups of parmesan).  The result is one of the best things I have ever tasted!  Too good, really, because it's hard to stop eating it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked chicken italiano

nan

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. heat olive oil in large frying pan
3. dip chicken in salad dressing , then in bread crumbs
4. brown in oil
5. transfer to shallow baking dish
6. spoon marinara sauce over chicken
7. top with sliced mozzarella , then chopped tomato
8. sprinkle with herbs and a generous shake of parmesan cheese
9. bake for 45 minutes
10. if tomatoes begin to burn , cover loosely with foil
demonstrations.review: This recipe was a big hit with my family.  It looked very impressive, but it was actually quite easy to make.  I left out the tomatoes and used extra marinara sauce, and then I served it with spaghetti and put the sauce over everything.  It was awesome!  This is definitely one of my favorite Italian chicken recipes, and I'll be serving it quite often.

target.recipe_text:
chocolate banana cake

this is a very moist & very fudgey cake. it tastes best the second day.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. cream margarine with sugar and eggs
3. mix in banana and vanilla
4. mix flour with remaining dry ingredients
5. add flour mixture to margarine mixture in 3 parts , alternately with sour milk
6. begin and end with flour
7. spread in 2 greased 8" cake pans
8. bake in oven about 40 minutes
9. when cool , frost generously with chocolate butter frosting
target.review: My husband (who has never baked before) made it while I was out and said it was very easy. Even added raisins and says that next time he'll try some nuts in it! We didn't bother with frosting either. Thanks, Debbb. Dee in Coquitlam

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple cobbler just for two

this is a great way to have a little dessert with a lot of flavor.  a perfect dish for the 2 of you.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. spray 2 5-0z custard cups with non-stick cooking spray
3. toss the apple with the cinnamon sugar , divide between the 2 custard cups and sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon water
4. in a small bowl , mix together the flour , oatmeal , baking powder , brown sugar and 1 / 2 teaspoon apple pie spice
5. cut in the butter until crumbly
6. sprinkle the crumb mixture over the apples and place in preheated oven
7. bake for 35 minutes or until golden
8. serve warm with vanilla ice cream , whipped cream or plain
demonstrations.review: Used this as a resource for the topping. Used pure Maple syrup instead of the water over 3 small Macs and put 1 tsp cinnamon in the topping instead of the apple pie spice. Will cut the brown sugar back to 2 Tbsp next time because we found it too sweet. Overall good with no leftovers to tempt the sweet tooth. Will be easy to increase proportions for company.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy general tso s chicken

we love chinese food and general tso's has long been a favorite. however the high fat content of the regular version in a restaurant isn't always a great option.

this is a moderately spicy version of the recipe. reduce the ginger, garlic, scallions or red pepper flakes as your tastes desire. you can also substitute higher calorie options, such as regular sugar for the splenda, or vegetable oil instead of pam cooking spray.

1. whisk together broth , splenda , soy sauce , vinegar and ginger
2. set aside
3. wait until just before pouring over the meal to add in the cornstarch
4. spray a wok or non-stick skillet liberally with pam
5. add scallions , garlic and red pepper flakes
6. cook for 2-3 minutes
7. add chicken and brown
8. use more spray if necessary to assist with the browning
9. cook about 5-8 minutes
10. the chicken should be almost done before you add the sauce
11. add cornstarch to your sauce bowl and whisk to create a slurry
12. add to your chicken in the pan and heat until boiling , then reduce to a simmer
13. the boiling of the sauce will cause the cornstarch to thicken
14. soon it will be as thick as the general tso's sauce you're used to !
15. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: Chose this because it didn't involve deep frying of the chicken.  Used 1 very large breast (cut up, though it wasn't called for) for 2 of us. Added some red and yellow pepper  as did another reviewer and cut back the red pepper flakes to 1 tsp and will cut that back the next time because we found it quite spicy but delicious served over some sticky rice I had in the freezer. Thanks for submitting this one.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tea leaf eggs

these delicately flavored eggs have an intricate marbled appearance.

1. in saucepan cover eggs with cold water to a depth of at least 1 inch above eggs
2. rapidly bring to a boil
3. cover pan tightly
4. reduce heat , and simmer for 15 minutes
5. rinse quickly in cold water till eggs are cool enough to handle
6. drain
7. tap eggs lightly all over till eggs are a network of fine cracks , but do not peel
8. return eggs , gently to the saucepan , add soy sauce , aniseed , cinnamon , tea , sugar , salt , and 2 cups of the cold water
9. bring to a boil
10. then reduce heat , and simmer , covered , for 1 1 / 2 hours , adding water to keep eggs covered , if needed
11. drain eggs , and chill
12. to serve , roll eggs between the palms of your hands to loosen shell
13. peel , starting from the large end of egg
demonstrations.review: These were OK. Made for Chinese New Year Dimsum for my Red Hat group. The shells and skin underneath were very hard and the tea/soy solution didn't get to marblelize as it should have. May try again next year.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swiss oatmeal

fantasticly enhanced oatmeal. dry mixture will keep for up to 2 months. suggest dried fruit ingredient be berries n' cherries (chopped). found recipe years ago in 

1. mix all ingredients together
2. store in airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 months
3. prep for 1 serving: bring 1 cup water to boil in small saucepan and add 1 / 2 cup mix
4. cook stirring frequently for 1 minute
5. cover and let stand 2 minutes
6. 1 / 3 cup mix to 2 / 3 cup water
7. put the water and mix in a bowl
8. stir
9. nuke on high until oatmeal bubbles to the top of the bowl
10. stir
11. let sit for a minute
12. add milk , sugar , or whatever else seems interesting
demonstrations.review: I've been making this with a few personal changes for many years. I always add a shake of ground cinnamon in the bottom of the large cup I use. I put it in first because it seems to blend in better than putting it on top. Also, raisins are part of the deal because my other half likes them. Thanks for the starter recipe, Satisfied Kris.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bergy dim sum  10  honey soy braised chicken wings

mmmmm these are tasty wings, sticky but tasty. excellent as an appetizer or part of your dim sum brunch. have them as part of your home cooked chinese dinner.

1. cut wings intp three pieces
2. heat oil in wok and fry the larger joints on high heat for 3-4 minutes or until browned
3. add soy , honey , wine , garlic and ginger , stir well
4. reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the wings are tender
5. towards the end watch the wings carefully , stir frequently to make sure the glaze does not burn
6. serve warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: Another hit for Bergy! Made these for Chinese New Year Dimsum for my Red Hat group. May try getting them browned on the G. Forman grill next time because they kind of spattered but the sauce caramelized nicely.

target.recipe_text:
delicious chicken pot pie

this chicken pot pie recipe takes a little time, but it is well worth it!! this is an all-time favorite in our family. great on a cold winter day.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. saute onion , celery , carrots and potatoes in margarine for 10 minutes
3. add flour to sauteed mixture , stirring well , cook one minute stirring constantly
4. combine broth and half and half
5. gradually stir into vegetable mixture
6. cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly
7. stir in salt and pepper
8. add chicken and stir well
9. pour into shallow 2 quart casserole dish and top with pie shells
10. cut slits to allow steam to escape
11. bake for 40-50 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and filling is bubbly and cooked through
target.review: Just made this today, and it was wonderful!! My husband gave me a big smile while he was eating it. It wasn't hard at all, and was well worth the time chopping the veggies, etc. I did add a half bag of frozen corn to it. Next time I want peas in it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
veronica s easy spanish rice

dh wanted spanish rice one night so i made the following recipe that i got from betty crocker. omg, it was just like eating my mom's. i forgot how good her spanish rice was!!! try it, you won't be disappointed!!! serve as a meal in its self or as a side dish.

1. in a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. add rice and onion and cook stirring occasionally , until rice is golden brown and onion is tender
3. stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until rice is tender
demonstrations.review:
I made this recipe on Saturday for a church function, changed it to 40 servings. It was great!! People were coming up telling me how good it was. I used recipe # 63786, chicken or steak fajitas. People thought it was a catered lunch. 
Again, a wonderful recipe that I will use over and over.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best apple pie jam

a friend gave me this wonderful recipe, and oh my, it is so good. just like a extra good apple pie filling, but in jam form. if you love apple pie, you are going to have to make this wonderful recipe. my husband who only likes strawberry jam, said, "this recipe was excellent!" it is excellent on english muffins, pancakes or toast. even over ice cream too!!

1. measure apples in a measuring cup , now add in the same measuring cup water to fill up to the 4 cup line
2. add pectin and the butter and spices , lemon juice
3. bring to a boil
4. add sugars and bring back to a full rolling boil , boil 1 minute
5. stir constantly
6. remove from the heat
7. skim off any foam
8. ladle into hot jars leaving 1 / 4-inch headspace
9. put on lids
10. process in water bath 10 minutes
demonstrations.review:
I forgot to put my review on when I made this. I have had so many people tell me how much they loved this jam. They are telling me they want more. So I will be making this again when it gets cooler.
Again it is the BEST!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
perfect pasta salad

this is an absolutely incredible recipe. every time i've made it i've had to double it and it is still gone in nothing flat. people will beg you for the recipe

1. mix together dressing first and set aside until sugar is dissolved completely
2. cook pasta according to box directions and rinse under cold water until cool
3. slice the sliced pepperoni circles in half and separate slices
4. mix together with pasta and chopped items , except the provolone cheese
5. pour dressing over it all and mix well
6. chill well
7. add provolone cheese to salad before serving , otherwise it gets soggy
8. you may have to add extra red wine vinegar or olive oil to get it to the desired consistency
9. some people like it moist , others on the drier side
10. this is guaranteed not to last long before it is completely devoured !
11. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
I found this recipe before our church conference. I just doubled for lunch, since we were not having that many. I got so many people who loved this. They said it was like a mouthful of explosions of flavor!! 
It was easy and tasty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
4th of july grilled salmon  or chicken

a friend of mine made this at last year's 4th of july celebration, and after much begging and groveling, shared this super-easy, fun, and very yummy recipe, which you can easily double or triple for a big crowd!   the cold left-overs (if any) the next day are fabulous!  try this with chicken!!  grill 4 chx breasts 4-5 min ea side, then finish in 350 degree oven in covered pan with butter & olive oil for +/-20 min.  oh!  magnificent (great sandwiches w/tomato, cream cheese, and avocado).

1. into a large zip-lock bag , make marinade out of peanut oil , soy sauce , vinegar , onions , brown sugar , garlic , ginger , red pepper flakes , sesame oil and salt
2. combine well , and insert fish or chicken
3. seal and marinate in refrigerator 4-24 hours
4. oil and preheat grill on medium-high heat
5. grill fish ~5 minutes per side , until fish just flakes with a fork
demonstrations.review:
I have used this recipe many times, and I haven NOT reviewed it. What was I thinking?? It is wonderful. I am going to do it today with Salmon. It leaves it tasty and moist. I have made it with the chicken, and everyone couldn't belive how moist it is. 
Great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
joshua s favorite tilapia with jasmine rice

this is my very own creation, i whipped this up one day quite by accident. i call this joshua's favorite tilapia, because my husband (like me) could eat this 7 nights a week if we could. this is the easiest way to cook tilapia, and if you are watching those calories then you need not worry this is extremely low fat, oh and did i mention to die for !!! this recipe is simple with few ingredients, but has the potential to add what ever you want. i like it as is !

1. pour your dressing straight from the bottle into the pan , i usually make sure the bottom is covered but not too much , i gave approximate measures here
2. place the fillets on top of the dressing in the pan
3. sprinkle with all 4 seasonings
4. i usually just sprinkle a generous amount on each filet
5. don't leave out the cumin it is a wonderful addition to the fish
6. saute the fillets on med-low heat approximate 4-5 minutes each side until fish flakes easy with a fork
7. while the fish is slowly cooking , cook the rice , using 2 1 / 2 cups water and 1 cup rice , with butter , bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes on low
8. serve the fillet on top of the jasmine rice
9. i will usually add more s&p and cumin according to my taste
demonstrations.review: I am getting ready to make this again, and I noticed that I have not reviewed it. We love it here at home. I didn't have any Italian dressing the first time, so I used balsamic dressing with it. My husband loved it. Tonight I am going to make it with Italian and no rice. Just some red potatoes and corn on the cob. But this is a keeper for sure.

target.recipe_text:
tom   jerry

a classic warm winter toddy.  enjoy!

1. beat egg whites til they are a stiff froth
2. separately beat egg yolks until light in color
3. gradually beat sugar , allspice , cinnamon and cloves into the yolk mixture
4. fold yolk mixture into whites and pour 2 tablespoons of this mixture into each of four 8-ounce mugs
5. add brandy and rum to each mug
6. fill mugs with very hot water , milk , or coffee
7. stir well and sprinkle the top with grated nutmeg
target.review: This is the real McCoy.  I remember my parents making this when I was a kid.  I could even have one sans booze.  I use piping hot milk, and because I like them a little sweeter, I add some powdered sugar to the milk.  I added 2 tablespoons of the \

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beef and noodle skillet

the perfect week night dinner main dish. quick, inexpensive and - and - well, you'll find out! recipe from hidden valley.

1. cook noodles according to package directions
2. drain and combine with mix , ground beef , mushrooms , sour cream and milk
3. cook and stir until thoroughly heated
4. sprinkle with cheese
5. garnish with green onions , if desired
demonstrations.review: This is a good, quick and simple meal.  I used about 1 1/2 lb. ground beef, and I took the suggesions of others and added an additional packet of Hidden Valley.  Next time I will toss in some onion and mushroom with the ground beef while it browns.  I will probably toss it in a baking dish

demonstrations.recipe_text:
philadelphia scrapple

i was raised on this in philadelphia and i combined several recipes in developing this original and authentic recipe!

1. in a large pot , barely cover pork with water and cook on high until pork turns a grey color and is tender
2. strain all the water out real well and set pork aside
3. bring 1 / 2 of the stock to a boil and slowly add cornmeal , stirring to avoid lumps
4. return meat to the cornmeal mixture and mix thoroughly
5. continue to stir over medium heat for additional 30 minutes
6. add all of the seasonings and again mix thoroughly
7. pour into either loaf pans or loaf baking dishes and immediately chill in refrigerator
8. to serve , slice in 1 / 2 inch thick slices and fry in a skillet , being careful not to burn the scrapple
9. you may or may not wish to serve with ketchup on top of the individual slices
10. scrapple is an excellent addition at your breakfast with eggs and fried potatoes
demonstrations.review: This was very good indeed.  I made eough to share with friends who'd never tasted scrapple, and they loved it.  I took some liberties with the cooking technique though.  I covered the pork with water and then added all the seasonings.  I let it simmer until the pork was tender then I used a sifter and gradually instroducted the cornmeal stirring all the while.  It worked great, and the loaves set up beautifully.  Next time I will add more seasonings because I like intense flavors, I may add a pinch of thyme too.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hamburgers with brown gravy  total comfort food aka  meat cakes

these are sooooo great (and ez)! i grew up eating these about once a week and they are incredible with mashed potatoes or buttered egg noodles and a veggie. while this recipe is basically my mom's, i have changed one thing...instead of using chopped onion in the burgers, i use an envelope of onion soup mix...it gives them the perfect flavor! this is now one of my family's favorite meals...try it and it will probably become one of your's, too. p.s. these burgers also work for grilling (without the gravy :).

1. combine ground beef , bread , soup mix , salt , pepper , ketchup , garlic powder , parsley and eggs in a large bowl until well mixed
2. prepare each burger with approx 1 / 3 cup of meat mixture and form into patties about 1 / 2 inch thick
3. heat a 12" skillet over med-high heat and fry burgers for about 5 minutes on each side , until they are almost done
4. remove burgers to a plate and discard all but about a tablespoon of drippings from skillet
5. lower heat under skillet and prepare brown gravy with water in a bowl or measuring cup
6. slowly pour into skillet , stirring constantly , scraping up any brown bits from the bottom
7. when gravy has thickened , place burgers back in the pan and cover
8. simmer for about 20 minutes , or until burgers are done
9. serve with mashed potatoes or egg noodles
10. yummy !
demonstrations.review: Holy Cow!  This is a great dish.  It's kid friendly and an adult pleaser. After I removed the burgers from the pan, I threw in some sliced mushrooms and let them cook a bit before adding the gravy mix.  EZ and delicious. The night I made it, it was 3 degrees in Spokane, WA.  Talk about a warming yummy comfort food.  THANKS KAREN

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta with rosemary cream sauce

nan

1. cook the pasta until al dente
2. in the meantime , using a saucepan , saute the rosemary and garlic in olive oil over low heat for about 3 minutes
3. add the tomato puree , and season with salt and pepper
4. simmer for about 15 minutes
5. stir in cream and parmesan until heated through
6. drain pasta and toss with the sauce
demonstrations.review: Very simple to make, but I did not care for this dish.  I thought the sauce tasted akin to a canned spaghetti I used to eat when I was a kid.  The tomato puree was very acrid so I added a pinch of sugar to tone it down.  You might want to be careful when you stir the cream into the simmered puree.  If it's too hot, the cream could curdle.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s hamburgers

my mom made them when we had camp outs when we were younger and that's how she got the name.

1. combine ingredients
2. mix throughly
3. form into patties
4. grill
demonstrations.review: I made these for a quick dinner last night.  I used hamburger with 15% fat content and they were crumbly and didn't stick together well to make a patty.  Some of the meat found it's way on to the coals.  Even though crubly, they tasted pretty good.  The kids liked them a lot.

target.recipe_text:
beth s melt in your mouth barbecue ribs  oven

i almost didn't want to share this ribs recipe because this is one of the dishes that i make that keep my sons coming back home! these can be done with baby back or regular pork ribs. i have also made split chickens this way. the ribs are tender, moist and just slide off of the bone. i know that your family will love them just as much as my family does.
i noticed that some are unable to find hickory smoked salt. you can use smoked paprika or just brush the ribs with liquid smoke before applying the rub. the smoke flavor is nice because it helps give the ribs a cooked-on-the-grill flavor.
also, the easiest way to remove the membrane is to work a spoon, or i use the tips of my kitchen shears, into the bottom center of the membrane, work it back and forth to form a "pocket," then i slide my thumbs in and work the membrane off from the center outward to the ends.

1. preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. line a baking sheet with two layers of foil , shiny side out
3. peel off tough membrane that covers the bony side of the ribs
4. season the ribs on both sides with salt and pepper
5. if using , divide the hickory liquid smoke evenly over the ribs
6. in a medium bowl , combine the light brown sugar , paprika , garlic powder and ground red pepper
7. apply the rub to all sides of the ribs
8. lay ribs on the prepared baking sheet , meaty side down
9. lay two layers of foil on top of ribs and roll and crimp edges tightly , edges facing up to seal
10. transfer to the oven and = bake for 2-2 1 / 2 hours or until meat is starting to shrink away from the ends of the bone
11. remove from oven
12. heat broiler
13. cut ribs into serving sized portions of 2 or 3 ribs
14. arrange on broiler pan , bony side up
15. brush on sauce
16. broil for 1 or 2 minutes until sauce is cooked on and bubbly
17. turn ribs over
18. repeat on other side
19. alternately , you can grill the ribs on your grill to cook on the sauce
target.review: When I made these my entire house smelt fantastic!! I don't eat ribs but my hubby does so I made them for him and he said he loved this recipe. This is how I will make them for him from now on. Thanks and so easy. I didn't use the hickory smoke salt though cause I didn't have any I just used regular salt.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fried chicken chicken salad

this chicken salad is made from leftover skinless fried chicken. everyone in my family loves it so i make sure i make extra chicken so i can make this for the next days sandwiches.  can also use to stuff big red tomatoes.  yummy!!!  :)

1. chop fried chicken and mix with diced celery , onion , mayo , pepper and jane's krazy salt
2. mix well and chill for a couple of hours before serving
3. we make sandwiches with it but you can also stuff tomatoes or use it any way you like
4. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was so good! It was for sure something different and unusual. I added almonds to mine though and it gave it a great touch. Next time we are going to try it on a wrap though, I think it would be better that way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the very best crock pot steak

this recipe is one i've used hundred's of times. it is a great family dish, and has endless possibilities. it makes it's own gravy and you can add any spices you like, but it will be a hit just the way it is.

1. cut up the steak in bite size pieces and place in crock pot
2. add the soup and the water
3. cook on low approx 6-8 hours
4. serve with rice
demonstrations.review: I also added onions to it and it added the perfect touch. I did use Cream of Chicken soup instead cause I was out of Cream of Mushroom. It was still outstanding with the change. I will be making this often and it is so easy. Loved it and couldn't get enough! Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken rollups

these are extremely easy to make and are very fast! only 5 ingredients to buy, so it is also inexpensive. i got this from a cousin, and my husband loves it!

1. preheat oven to 375
2. mix chicken and cheese together with enough mayonnaise to hodl it together-- i usually use about 1 tablespoons
3. flatten biscuits and put chicken / cheese mixture inside
4. fold the sides of the biscuit together
5. place chicken rolls in a greased 9x13" pan
6. mix soup and milk and heat in microwave until warm through
7. pour soup and milk mixture over the rollups
8. bake at 375 for 20 minutes or until the biscuits are golden brown
demonstrations.review: These were awesome! I also used cream of mushroom soup instead of chicken. I also did not use store bought biscuits, I used homemade one's. It took a little longer to make cause of making the biscuits/ but I think it was so good cause they added the right touch. I also had to cook a little longer cause of the biscuits. I will for sure make it again. Thanks for the new recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken ol    low fat

my family has loved this casserole for years. i don't remember where i got this, and i was surprised not to find this same one on zaar, but it's so easy and tasty i thought i would share it. i've been unable to find ore-ida cheddar browns here lately, i don't know if they quit making them or what, so i just use plain hashbrown squares and sprinkle with cheddar cheese.  i always double this recipe and use a 9x13, and still it never lasts long! it's one of those dishes that just doesn't seem lowfat. my husband calls it one of his "hurt me meals" because he always eats too much!  enjoy!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. arrange the 4 frozen cheddar browns in bottom of an 8" casserole sprayed with cooking spray
3. add cooked chicken in an even layer
4. mix together soup and canned tomato / jalapeno
5. pour this mixture over chicken
6. bake 40-45 minutes until potatoes are done and sauce in bubbly hot
demonstrations.review: My hubby really enjoyed this! I thought it was pretty good also. It is a little bit on the spicy side though. I choose not to feed it to my 5 year old and 16 month old cause of the spice. We served it with white corn tortilla chips, which added the perfect touch. So easy to make!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy dorito chicken casserole

this recipe is something i made up when we ran out of taco seasoning & tortillas.

1. cook chicken through
2. add all spices to the chicken
3. in another small pot , mix soup , rotel tomatoes , cheese , and sour cream
4. crunch the doritos on the bottom of a 9x13 pan
5. add chicken on top of doritos , and then the soup / cheese mixture
6. top with cheddar cheese and cook in 350 deg
7. oven until melted
demonstrations.review: My husband loved this! I thought it was great to, it was just really really spicy. So I couldn't feed it to the kids. So next time I make it I am going to make a pan with less spice for the kids and I. My husband thought it was perfect!

target.recipe_text:
tropical chicken stir fry

a stir-fry that is a little different, and relatively easy to put together.  found this recipe on the web.  can easily use white or brown rice instead of the jasmine rice!

1. drain tropical fruit , reserving juice
2. set aside
3. combine 1 / 2 cup reserved juice with soy sauce , ginger , paprika , turmeric , and allspice in a small bowl
4. set aside
5. mix orange juice and cornstarch in a small bowl
6. set aside
7. salt and pepper chicken
8. heat oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
9. add garlic and scallion and stir-fry for 1 minute
10. add chicken and stir fry until no longer pink
11. add orange juice and soy sauce mixtures to the wok
12. stir gently for about 30 seconds
13. add fruit salad , cover and cook 2 minutes
14. add orange juice with cornstarch to the wok and stir until thickened
15. serve over hot jasmine rice
target.review:
This was great! Really easy to make and the kids loved it. My DD8 had 4!! helpings so it's definately a keeper.The only thing we would change is to marinate the chicken in the soy sauce mixture, to give it a bit more flavour. This recipe is a good substitute for sweet n sour which most kids love.
Made for ZWT4

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super easy roasted red potatoes

these are a family pleasing easy work night side dish anyone can make!  i approximate my measurements as i tend to be heavy handed and don't measure but did my best to estimate everything. ;)  we also like potatoes a lot and leftovers. ;) ***it came to my attention that i failed to mention a step - basting is always a good idea as you have time. ;)

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. place cleaned potatoes and all liquids and spices in covered baking dish
3. bake for 40 minutes , basting periodically as you have time , or until potatoes are tender when poked with a fork
4. cool 5 minutes and serve - great with any grilled or bakes meat dish - especially pork , beef and salmon !
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
We absolutely LOVED these. I pre-cooked them in the microwave as i was a bit short on time, but they turned out great. I used white wine, which DD normally doesn't want, but she wolfed them down. This is a keeper for us, thank you!
Made for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers, ZWT4

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven roasted sweet potatoes

this is a recipe that i picked up on a recent trip to central market in dallas, tx.  sounds like a healthy way to prepare sweet potatoes.

1. preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. place the sweet potatoes in a shallow roasting pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray
3. drizzle with the oil , sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. toss well to coat
5. place in preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes
6. add the onions
7. stirring well
8. bake an additional 30 minutes
9. remove from oven
10. preheat broiler
11. drizzle the sweet potato mixture with melted butter
12. stirring to coat
13. broil 10 minutes or until browned
demonstrations.review:
This was nice. It could do with a bit more spices, and next time i will take off the skin completely because it dried out a bit with such a long oven time...
All in all a great way to prepare sweet potato.
Made for ZWT4, for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cafe con leche milkshakes

a great way to have your ice cream.  from bobby flay.  simple syrup is equal amounts of sugar and water combined and cooked over medium-low heat until sugar has dissolved and the mixture is clear.

1. combine the milk , coffee , ice cream , simple syrup and liqueur in a blender
2. blend until smooth
3. pour in tall glasses and top with a few chocolate covered espresso beans
demonstrations.review:
I loved this!
I used stracciatella ice cream as it was either that or strawberry, lol. I bought some vanilla ice cream for the next one i'm going to make because the only coffee ice cream they sell here is more like a sundae ice cream. I also used a bit less syrup as the liqueur was already really sweet.
Made for ZWT4 for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yummy cheesy corn

i know this may seem silly to post this simple recipe, but this corn is soooooo good!  i make this at least once a week with a meal and my hubby only likes this kind of corn.  plain corn has gone out the window.  this is so easy and yummy.  anyone could make it in a jiffy!

1. melt butter in medium skillet and add corn
2. add salt and pepper and fry for about 5 minutes
3. add the cheese and stir until it's nice a melted
4. serve immediately !
5. ohhhh -- it's soooo good !
demonstrations.review:
What a great idea to make corn!
Fast and easy, but i will try a different cheese next time because it turned out as a big lump of cheese with most of the corn not covered. Maybe next time i'll pop it in the oven instead.
Made for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers, ZWT4

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asian style turkey burgers

got this at meijer--haven't tried it yet.

1. combine turkey , garlic , onion , green pepper , soy sauce , ginger , salt and pepper in a large bowl
2. divide turkey mixture into 4 portions and shape into patties
3. grill over medium-high heat 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until done [170f]
4. serve on buns
demonstrations.review:
These were great!
I loved the ginger and soy sauce, but omitted the pepper.
I could only get multigrain buns, and they were too heavy for these burgers so there wasn't much of that great taste left. Made for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers, ZWT4

target.recipe_text:
emeril s creamed spinach

i saw this recipe on food tv's web site and had to try it. i love his recipes and this one is no exception. i make it several times a year.

1. preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. lightly grease a 6 cup casserole
3. in a large saute pan , melt the remaining butter
4. add the onions and season with salt and pepper
5. saute for about 2 minutes , or until the onions are soft
6. add the spinach
7. season with salt and pepper
8. saute for 3 to 4 minutes
9. add the garlic and cream
10. mix well
11. season the mixture with salt and pepper
12. bring the liquid to a boil and reduce to a simmer
13. simmer the mixture for 6 minutes
14. remove the pan from the heat and turn into the prepared pan
15. add 1 / 2 of cheese to casserole and stir
16. sprinkle the top with the remainder of the grated cheese and place in the oven
17. bake for about 4 to 6 minutes or until the cheese is slightly brown and bubbly
target.review: Serves 8.  Well, this is a little embarrassing, but it's said that honesty is the best policy.  I made said 8 servings and single-handedly ate them all by myself in one sitting.  Nap time.  Trouble is, I have the makings for another serving of 8 as soon as I wake up.  Boy, this is good.  I thought about adding a few sprinkles of crushed red pepper flakes, but I think I'll appreciate it just as it is for at least a few more 8-serving-sized helpings.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mango curry chicken salad

a cool lunch over a bed of greens.  prep time assumes your chicken is already cooked and cooled.

1. place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and gently toss to mix / coat well
2. chill about 1 hour before serving
3. garnish with extra cilantro , if desired
demonstrations.review: Can we say, "Heaven in a spoonful?"  Yum.  I was unable to let this chill an hour before consuming a big portion of it.  :)  I had had a mango curry chicken salad from the Whole Foods deli.  It was outrageously good.  Next time I went to Whole Foods, of course, it was not to be seen.  So I looked up a recipe.  This sounded pretty close.  And it is.  Yay!  (Much more cost effective to make my own, especially at the rate I eat it up!)  The only changes I made were to up the curry, use fully fatted mayo and sour cream and add dried cranberries.  (I didn't measure how much chicken I used, so upping the curry may have been necessary only because of the amount of chicken I used.  I'm not sure.)  I'll definitely be enjoying this regularly.  Thanks so much for posting it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bow tie pasta with broccoli and broccoli sauce

i've gotten 8 year old boys to eat this and ask for seconds. they never knew they were eating broccoli and i didn't tell them. i adore this dish. normally i cook with olive oil but the butter in this sauce should not be substituted. it will serve 4 as a side dish or 2 as a main course. the original recipe comes from rozanne gold, a favorite cookbook author.

1. cut the broccoli buds into small florets , leaving as short a stem as possible
2. set aside
3. cut the remaining broccoli stems into 1 / 2" pieces
4. boil them , covered , in the 1 1 / 4 cups water , lightly salted , for 15 minutes or until very soft
5. meanwhile , boil the pasta in salted water until al dente
6. drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup of the cooking water
7. return the pasta to the pot and stir until all moisture is evaporated
8. place the reserved florets into a small pot and steam or boil 5 minutes , retaining the bright green color and a bit of crunch
9. in a food processor , puree the cooked broccoli and its cooking water until very smooth , adding a bit of the reserved pasta water if needed to make a smooth sauce
10. add the butter and pulse until melted
11. add salt to taste
12. pour warm sauce over the pasta and stir gently to combine
13. plate and sprinkle with drained florets
demonstrations.review: This was surprisingly good given the minimal ingredients and ease of preparation.  I changed it a bit by sauteeing onion and then the broccoli and then some mushrooms and garlic.  Added a splash of milk while it was pulsing.  Topped it with a few sprinkles of red pepper flakes.  If I had remembered, I would have topped it with a little parmesan, too.  Very tasty, and will be a big staple on days I'm running low on money.  Thanks for posting it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ww 0 point weight watchers cabbage soup

you can eat as much of this 0-point weight watchers cabbage soup as you like. it's so good for you.

1. spray pot with non stick cooking spray saute onions carrots and garlic for 5 minutes
2. add broth , tomato paste , cabbage , green beans , basil , oregano and salt & pepper to taste
3. simmer for a about 5-10 minutes until all vegetables are tender then add the zucchini and simmer for another 5 or so minutes
4. i have tried different variations
5. leaving out green beans
6. adding chopped green onions in addition to the yellow onion
7. all very good
8. you can customize it a bit
demonstrations.review: Fabulous soup!  Admittedly, I altered it enough that it probably blows Weight Watchers' numbers off the chart.  I added hamburger, used a whole can of tomato paste, and, for the liquid, used a combo of chicken broth, veggie broth and white wine.  Oh, and I topped it with a good portion of parmesan cheese.  Yeah, so much for WW, but, oh, it was delish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beet greens with bacon and onion

think you're family won't eat their greens? think again! with all the yummy accompanying flavors in this side dish, you won't find the beet greens overpowering at all.

1. heat the oil on medium-high heat
2. saute the garlic and onion until they are translucent
3. reduce heat to medium and add the beet greens
4. stir until all the greens are wilted and heated
5. add the white wine and bacon
6. cook for another 2-3 minutes
7. serve with salt and fresh ground black pepper
demonstrations.review: I didn't think I would ever find a way to prepare beet greens that made that palatable to me.  I kept trying, though, yes, I did.  And I eventually landed on this recipe.  And THIS is IT--the way to prepare beet greens.  :)  Not only are the palatable, they are yummy!  (I had tried frying them in bacon grease and adding bacon at the end before, but it wasn't quite right.  I think the white wine made all the difference.)  I added toasted pine nuts at the end, which I thought were a nice addition.  Thanks for posting this.  You saved me from tossing my beet greens.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simmered round steak

nan

1. trim fat from steak and cut meat into serving pieces
2. in large frying pan , brown meat in hot oil
3. drain off oil
4. add remaining ingredients
5. stir to combine
6. simmer
7. covered , 1-1 3 / 4 hour or until meat is very tender
8. you can also put meat and sauce in a 13" by 9" pan , cover with foil , and bake in 350 degree oven for 1 3 / 4-2 hours
demonstrations.review: What a DELICIOUSLY easy way to prepare a tough cut of meat.  Wonderful!  My only recommendation--which is minor and, really, unnecessary(!)--would be to combine the mustard, worcestershire, tomato sauce, etc. before adding it to the frying pan.  I sort of slopped things around when trying to get it mixed in the pan.  A most delicious recipe.  Thanks for posting it!

target.recipe_text:
fish cakes fast and simple

i'm a simple man therefore i like simple things and this little recipe is very simple and quick to make. great for a camping trip where you'll cook your catch the same night. i've done it many times. you can use any type of fish making this. serve with a tarter or hollandaise sauce and enjoy.

1. peel and cut up potatoes
2. place in pot with fillets and cover with cold water
3. boil until the potatoes are"fork done"
4. drain off the water
