4. dressing- combine bread cubes , onion and melted margarine with 1 / 2 of the soup to bind
5. in a roasting pan place the bread dressing on bottom of pan
6. add the chicken to the top of the dressing
7. mix 2 tbsp of flour to 1 / 2 can of chicken soup and add 1 1 / 2 cups of water
8. pour over top of chicken and dressing
9. cover tightly and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
10. serve with mashed potatoes , carrotes , yellow beans and peas
demonstrations.review: Well I over ate tonight and it was football practice.  This chicken was so nice and moist and the gravy over mashed potatoes and corn has to be the greatest.  The juice from the chicken makes this a nice golden brown sauce, and the top of the chicken was nice and sticky too.  We will make this often.  Thank you for a nice family recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nee s whipping cream pound cake

this is a great recipe from my grandmother.  she even taught both of my brothers how to make this because it is a family favorite.

i hope you enjoy it as much as we do.

1. using a heavy mixer , beat the butter until light and creamy
2. gradually add the sugar and beat well on medium speed for 6 minutes
3. add the eggs , one at a time
4. add the flour and whipping cream , alternating , but beginning and ending with flour and blending on low until mixture is well blended
5. add the flavorings
6. pour batter into a tube pan which has been greased and floured to prevent sticking
7. bake at 300 for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. cool on wire rack for 15 minutes before turning out on to cake plate
9. this can also be baked in 2 loaf pans for 1 hour or so
demonstrations.review: This is very similar to a cherry loaf my Great Grandmother makes. We made this today and had no troubles at all.  Made this into two loaf cakes,  one for the family and one for Great Grandfather on Fathers Day.  I will update review again letting you know how he enjoyed it.  It is buttery and very delicate to eat.  We had a thin slice with berries and cool whip.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemonade stand teasers

these are melt-in-your-mouth shortbread cookies topped with a light and refreshing frosting - so sweet and mild it imparts the perfect lemon flavor without the tartness. 

note:  please read all the directions before beginning!  the butter needs to reach room temperature before you begin making the dough; this may require two or three hours of passive work time.

1. place the butter on the counter two or three hours before you plan to make the cookies to bring it to room temperature
2. don't let the butter get soft or the cookies will turn out crumbly
3. zest the two lemons
4. let the zest sit out to give it time to dry out
5. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. in a large bowl , beat the butter until creamy
7. add the sugar and beat until light and fluffy
8. mix in the lemon zest , vanilla extract , and salt
9. add the flour and mix until well combined
10. using your hands , roll the dough into 1" balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet
11. bake for 15 minutes , or just until the bottoms begin to turn light brown
12. cool
13. while the cookies are cooling , make the frosting
14. frosting:
15. in a small bowl , beat the butter , milk , vanilla , and lemon zest together until smooth
16. add the powdered sugar and continue beating until you reach the desired consistency
17. the frosting should be firm , but spreadable , and able to stay on the cookie without sliding off the sides
18. frost the tops of each cookie and sprinkle with the remaining lemon zest
demonstrations.review: Made these last night, and they just seem to melt away in your mouth, just making room for the next one.  We only made half the amount of frosting and found that was enough, because they are great without it.  We also dredged these in powdered sugar only, and they  just made us get more butter out for another batch.  Made for my Great Grandfather for Fathers Day, and he will sure enjoy staying home with a cup of tea.

target.recipe_text:
apple pie in a bottle

here's a drink that's great to take on camping trips with good friends, perfect for sharing around the campfire. this is my own recipe that we take to sca camping events in the pacific northwest (other folks have their "secret" recipes they don't share). you know you have good apple pie when you take a sip and you can even taste the crust. :) you don't want to miss out on this one!

1. mix together liquid ingredients
2. stir in apple pie spice
3. pour into a 32 oz bottle , add the cinnamon sticks , and refrigerate for at least a week before serving
4. apple pie is a group drink , often shared straight out of the bottle with folks all sitting around the campfire
5. also , you can use regular apple cider for the entire amount rather than organic , if you need to , but the organic has a different flavor and a much different "mouth feel" because it has more pulp in it
6. get and use the organic , if you can
7. try to use higher proof vodka if you can , but if the red label is too expensive or unavailable , you can substitute another equal quality high proof vodka
8. potato vodka can also be used , but check the taste before using to make sure it's something you like the taste of and that it's not too sweet for you
9. higher proof is generally drier in taste
target.review: I have tried both the apple and blueberry versions and they are fantastic........they are heavy hitters for sure!!!  I can't find vanilla flavored schnapps in my area so I used vanilla vodka and increased the butterscotch schnapps.  Enjoy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked brie in puff pastry with apricot or raspberry preserves

this baked brie puff pastry is rich, creamy, and dessert-like. it always disappears. i'm always asked for the recipe. raspberry preserves goes great in this as well. bringing in 2012 i made this using recipe #463563!

1. preheat oven to 425
2. lightly grease cookie sheet
3. roll puff pastry out slightly
4. place cheese wheel on top
5. place preserves on top of cheese
6. place almonds on top of preserves
7. bundle puff pastry up and around the cheese
8. bake for 20-25 minutes
9. let cool for five minutes
10. serve with your favorite crackers
demonstrations.review: Awesome crowd pleaser!  Make sure you thaw your pastry well and check and double check for any tears or holes in the pastry before baking.  Served with water crackers and green apple slices.  I put it on a hot plate to keep warm.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
not fried  fried ice cream

can't remember where i found this recipe, but it's great for mexican night, or cinco de mayo!! (new note: if you use the new special k cereal with cinnamon and pecans, this is real delicious!  add the sugar and not as much cinnamon, no butter, and you don't have to bake it! very crunchy and so delicious!!! i used about 1 1/4 c special k.)

1. make 8 vanilla ice cream balls and freeze on wax-lined cookie sheet for about an hour
2. mix remaining ingredients and spread on a cookie sheet to bake at 350f until crisp and golden
3. let cool
4. roll ice cream balls in the cooled mixture and refreeze for 2 hours more
5. serve with honey drizzled over each and enjoy !
6. see new
demonstrations.review: Yum!  Had the family over for a Mexican themed dinner and this was a truly grand finale!  I topped with a little caramel and chocolate topping, whipped cream and a cherry and everyone just loved it!!  It was a real fun and different dessert!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
linda s cheesecake stuffed strawberries

omg.. these are like heaven in your mouth!  talk about great taste sensations...  i made these for one of my cooking and recipe events that i hold monthly, and these were a huge hit... a must try for sure!  you can use low fat cream cheese to make these lighter if you like.  you can also dip the ends with any kind of finely chopped nuts, mini chocolate chips, graham cracker crumbs, sprinkles, or dip the ends in chocolate or drizzle with chocolate.  you might even try adding some cocoa powder to the cream cheese and make it a chocolate filling.  the sky is the limit here, just use your imagination!

1. place cream cheese in a bowl , and microwave for 30 seconds , so that it's soft
2. whip together the cream cheese , vanilla , and sugar
3. in the center of each strawberry , using a sharp knife , make a hole in each one , as deep as you can without going out the bottom
4. spoon or pipe the filling into each hole
5. dip cheesecake end of strawberry into chopped almonds , making sure you completely cover the cheesecake filling with the nuts
6. lay strawberries in a pretty serving dish
7. sprinkle with any leftover nuts around the dish
8. chill , and serve
9. makes 24 servings
demonstrations.review: These were simple and fun to make!  I used light cream cheese and graham cracker crumbs, but next time I will use the full fat stuff, I think the texture was a little too light with the Neufchatel.  Also I agree with those who said the recipe needs a bit more sugar.....instead of tasting like cheesecake stuffed berries, it tasted like cream cheese stuffed strawberries!  But even so, these were great and I plan to make them for a dinner party we are hosting soon.  Great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cracker barrel old country store biscuits

i like these because they are so quick and easy. even though you use bisquick, they don't come out tasting like bisquick or like baking powder. i always have to double the batch to make sure i get some!

1. preheat oven to 450f
2. mix the bisquick , buttermilk and sugar together in a bowl
3. add the melted butter into the batter
4. stir until a soft dough forms
5. turn out onto a well floured work surface
6. knead 20 times , and don't be afraid to get additional flour into the dough
7. roll 1 / 2 thick , or thicker if you prefer towering biscuits
8. cut out into 2" rounds
9. place close together on an ungreased baking sheet
10. brush tops with melted butter
11. bake for 8 to 10 minutes
12. i usually find 8 minutes is enough
13. when you remove the biscuits from the oven , brush the tops with melted butter again
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe!  I used the powdered buttermilk and reduced fat Bisquick and they turned out beautifully-great biscuity taste.  The only thing I will do  differently next time is roll them a bit thicker so they rise higher, but other than that I wouldn't change a thing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashioned banana cream pie

before cool whip and instant pudding, this was how a cream pie was made. if you leave out the bananas, you have vanilla cream pie. if you add 1 cup shredded coconut to milk as it's being heated, you have coconut cream pie.

1. have baked 9-inch pie shell ready
2. in a large saucepan , scald the milk
3. in another saucepan , combine the sugar , flour and salt
4. gradually stir in the scalded milk
5. over medium heat , stirring constantly , cook until thickened
6. cover and , stirring occasionally , cook for two minutes longer
7. in a small bowl , have the 3 egg yolks , slightly beaten , ready
8. stir a small amount of the hot mixture into beaten yolks
9. when thoroughly combined , stir yolks into hot mixture
10. cook for one minute longer , stirring constantly
11. remove from heat and blend in the butter and vanilla
12. let sit until lukewarm
13. when ready to pour , slice bananas and scatter in pie shell
14. pour warm mixture over bananas
15. if desired , make a meringue to top the pie , or just let the pie cool until serving
demonstrations.review: This is amazing! I wowed myself and my family when I made this! It has the old-fashioned taste and texture everyone is looking for in a pie like this.....it reminds me of the delicious banana cream pie my husband and I had at Mel's Diner in Florida. Don't be intimidated about cooking the filling as I was-this turned out beautifully! I'll never go back to the instant pudding/whipped topping recipe again!

target.recipe_text:
coconut pineapple banana bread

this is a nice "tropical" flavored banana bread. instead of walnuts, substitute chopped macadamias for a more tropical flavor.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray
3. combine flour , baking soda , salt , nutmeg and ginger in a bowl and stir with a whisk to combine
4. set aside
5. place sugar , oil , yogurt and eggs in mixer bowl and beat at medium speed until well blended
6. add banana , vanilla and pineapple
7. mix until blended
8. add flour mixture and beat on low until just moist
9. stir in walnuts and coconut
10. put batter in loaf pan and bake 60-70 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. cool in pan 10 minutes on wire rack
12. remove from pan and cool completely
13. store in airtight container
target.review: The whole house smelled incredible while the bread was baking.  I used sour cream as I did not have yogurt.  I also used macadamia nuts to give it more of a tropical flavor.  I could hardly taste the pineapple or the spices.  I found it to be a dense banana bread, heavier than other banana breads I have made, but still very good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and mandarin orange salad

nice light lunch, even to take to work, just keep dressing separate.  from cooking light 


1. place 2 cups of spinach on each of 4 plates
2. arrange 1 / 2 cup mushrooms and 1 / 3 cup oranges over spinach
3. sprinkle each serving with 1 tablespoon cheese and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons nuts
4. drizzle each with 2 tablespoons vinaigrette
5. or place ingredients , except vinaigrette , in a bowl , lightly toss and just before serving , drizzle with dressing
demonstrations.review:
Excellent salad.  I used sliced almonds as I did not have pecans or walnuts.
I also used Emerill's  Raspberry Vinaigrette dressing.  I used baby spinach and it was delicious.  I used bleu cheese. Thanks Derf for another great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana cream cheesecake  copycat

i found this recipe in robbie's recipe collection (recipes.robbiehaf.com) and it is as close to the cheesecake factory's recipe as i have tasted.

1. use a blender to finely chop the cookies
2. add margarine and blend until they are well combines
3. press mixture into the bottom of a 10" springform pan and smooth it out
4. refrigerate the crust while you make the filling
5. beat cream cheese with electric mixer until creamy
6. beat in sugar and cornstarch followed by the eggs
7. beat in bananas , whipping cream , and vanilla
8. pour mixture into crust
9. place pan on a cookie sheet and bake in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes
10. reduce oven temperature to 200 degrees and bake an additional 75 minutes , or until center is almost set , adding coconut for last 20 minutes
11. allow to cool completely before removing rim of pan -- before removing the pan , run warm water over a knife and slide a knife around the edge of the cake to separate the cake from the pan cleanly
12. refrigerate cheesecake , uncovered , at least 6 hours
demonstrations.review: Wonderful cheesecake.  My DIL said it was the best cheesecake she ever ate. I made a crust from chocolate wafers and served it to company.  Everyone raved over it.  I garnished it with toasted coconut and it looked like I bought it at the bakery. Try this cake.  It's great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick chicken casserole

very fast to mix up and little cook time. plus you only need 4 ingredients ! i've serve this to guests quite often and i have been asked for the recipe every time!! my sister-in law got this off of the back of a stove top stuffing box.

1. mix first 3 ingredients in a bowl
2. put into a greased casserole dish
3. prepare stuffing mix according to package directions
4. spread on top of chicken mixture
5. bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes
demonstrations.review: We did not care for this dish, but it could be because I used frozen chopped broccoli as I didn't have frozen mixed vegetables.  I think the broccoli should have been cooked first as it was a little hard.  I also think it should be baked at 400 degrees for 30 minutes as the stuffing was a little mushy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
incredible banana coffee cake

i cant wait to bake this! if this sounds good, check out the recipe #35287 i posted. wonderful!

1. preheat oven to 325
2. grease a 3 quart bundt pan
3. puree bananas
4. combine banana , cake mix , pudding , oil , eggs and vanilla extract in large mixing bowl
5. mix well , beat on medium speed 8 minutes , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
6. mix almonds , brown sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
7. pour one-half cake batter into pan
8. sprinkle with sugar mixture , cover with remaining batter
9. stick a knife in the batter , swirl in figure 8 patterns through the layers
10. bake 60-65 minutes
11. cool in pan on rack 10 minutes , then invert on rack to cool completely
12. dust with powdered sugar
13. you may garnish cake with sliced bananas if desired
demonstrations.review: Easy to make and delicious.  Next time I make it, I will add some mini chocolate chips to the sugar-nut mixture.  I will also save some sugar-nut mixture and put it on the top of the cake before putting it in the oven.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oatmeal raisin cheesecake crumble

convenient refrigerated cookies form the delicious crust for rich and creamy dessert squares.  recipe is one of the 100 finalists in the 2010 pillsbury bake-off contest, submitted by maurice chinn - and my favorite!

1. heat oven to 350f in bottom of ungreased 13x9-inch pan , press cookie dough rounds evenly for crust
2. sprinkle with 1 cup of the pecans
3. press firmly into dough
4. bake 13 to 17 minutes or until golden brown
5. meanwhile , in large bowl , beat cream cheese with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth
6. add milk , vanilla and eggs
7. beat until well blended
8. on low speed , beat in 1 / 2 cup of the flour
9. pour over crust
10. spread evenly
11. in medium bowl , mix brown sugar and remaining 1 / 2 cup flour
12. cut in butter , using pastry blender or fork , until mixture looks like coarse crumbs
13. stir in cinnamon chips , raisins , oats and remaining 1 cup pecans
14. sprinkle over cheese mixture
15. bake 35 to 45 minutes longer or until set
16. cool completely , about 2 hours
17. to serve , cut into 4 rows by 4 rows
18. store in refrigerator
demonstrations.review: This recipe needs tweaking as it has an overkill of raisins with the crust and the topping. I would use maybe a sugar cookie crust or no raisins in the topping. If you like oatmeal and raisins , you will like this.  It is expensive to make as it requires 2 cups of pecans.

target.recipe_text:
oreo ice cream crush

a perfect blend of oreo cookies, butter pecan ice cream and hot fudge! count on this dessert for your 4th of july backyard bbq or just simply to satisfy your sweet tooth on a hot summer day!

1. mix crushed cookies with melted butter and spread into a 9x13 inch pan
2. spread the softened ice cream on the crushed cookies and put in the freezer until firm
3. take dessert from the freezer and top with fudge topping and then cool whip topping
4. return dessert to the freezer for about 4 hours or until firm
target.review: knightgoddess, I had this recipe several years ago, and there is something special about the combination of Oreo cookies and butter pecan ice cream together.  It is delicious!  Thank you for sharing this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
german chocolate squares

nan

1. combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl , stirring until dry ingredients are moistened
2. press into bottom of a greased 13x9 inch pan , set aside
3. beat cream cheese and 2 eggs at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended
4. gradually add powdered sugar , beating until blended
5. spread evenly over chocolate batter
6. bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
7. cool on a wire rack , and cut into squares
demonstrations.review: My mother has been making this for over 20 years and it is among our favorite desserts.  After cooling to room temperature, we generally place it in the refrigerator to chill for at least 2 hours so that it is easy to cut.  Thanks for sharing a classic that everyone loves.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandma s vegetable soup

i used to love it when i went to visit my grandma and grandpa in georgia. they made almost everything from scratch. this was one of my favorite dishes. cooking time is approximate.

1. brown ground beef
2. add all but rice and macaroni , do not drain
3. let cook until potatoes are medium soft
4. add rice and cook 10 minutes
5. add macaroni and let cook until tender
demonstrations.review: This recipe brings back fond memories. As a little girl, growing up in Georgia, I used to also visit my adopted American grandmother's house, and when she made this soup, it reminded me of comfort and love.  She used fresh tomatoes from her garden that she had canned in large jars and added fresh okra.  Thank you Icancook for such a wonderful recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brown sugar frosting

good over apple cake or spice cakes..

1. place 3 ingredients into a medium pan
2. bring to a boil over low heat
3. stirring constantly
4. remove from heat -- add vanilla
5. pour into a medium bowl
6. mix 2 minutes with electric mixer
7. cool 10 minutes
8. add powdered sugar -- mix until well combined
demonstrations.review: grandma2969, this is an excellent frosting.  I had this at a friend's house. She made a vanilla cake, frosted it with Brown Sugar Frosting and served it fresh sliced peaches. This recipe is in my permanent recipe collection. Thank you for sharing a frosting recipe that is great on virtually any cake.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kabak mcveri  turkish zucchini fritters

fritters are very popular in the middle east. they are eaten hot or at room temperature as a vegetable side dish or a meze. it couldn’t be simpler to make, but you can dress it up with optional garnishes of black olives, tomatoes, or hard-boiled egg. the perfect use for small, sweet new zucchini. serve alone or with a creamy garlic-lemon yogurt sauce for a perfect complement to any spicy or grilled foods that call for a cooling accompaniment.

1. grate the zucchini and place in a colander
2. sprinkle with salt and let drain for 30 minutes
3. squeeze out moisture and pat with paper towels
4. place the zucchini in a bowl and add the green and yellow onions , dill , parsley , cheese , eggs , flour and salt and pepper to taste
5. mix well
6. in a large saut pan over medium-high heat , pour in oil to a depth of inch
7. when the oil is hot , drop the batter by heaping tablespoonfuls into the pan , allow space in between fritters
8. fry for 2 minutes on the fist side , then turn to brown on the second side for about 3 minutes
9. using a slotted spatula transfer to paper towels or newspaper to drain
10. repeat with remaining batter
demonstrations.review: This was excellent! When I was back in college, I had many friends from Turkey and have tried many sweets, but nothing savory. This was so delicious; I could not stop eating them. These fritters have such a refreshing, herblike flavor, and my family loved them with hot sauce. Thank you for sharing such a wonderful and tasty recipe to be made again and again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
german style eiskaffee  iced coffee drink

in germany, there are charming areas outside many restaurants called a 

1. place ice cream scoop into a decorative wine goblet or tall clear drinking glass
2. add coffee to fill glass 1 / 2-3 / 4 full
3. completely cover with a mountain of sweetened whipped cream - the whipped cream should be plentiful and just start to peak over the top of the glass rim
4. sprinkle with freshly grated good quality chocolate
5. stick a wafer cookie into the whipped cream off to the side
6. serve with some sugar on the side , a long spoon , and a straw
demonstrations.review: My neighbor's children went to Dunkin Donuts and bought this iced coffee shake with whipped cream on top.  When my 7-year-old saw that, he immediately wanted what they had, then I thought of trying this recipe.  It is a yummy, creamy blend of flavors.  Luckily, I had Dallmayr coffee, and all of the ingredients at hand to make Eiskaffee.  Thank you for sharing this classic iced coffee recipe.

target.recipe_text:
weight watchers chicken and cheese casserole

this recipe came from a card that was handed out with my weekly weight watchers materials. it's comfort food for 6 points per serving.  note: substitute turkey for chicken if desired.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in a large casserole , combine all ingredients , mixing well
3. bake , covered , 35-45 minutes
4. remove cover
5. bake 10-15 minutes longer
6. serve immediately
target.review: It was just okay. I added onion flakes and lots of fresh ground black pepper. I also used regular cheese (1/2 Mexican, 1/2 sharp cheddar). I topped it with Pepperidge Farm herbed stuffing mix. It was pretty bland.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven denver omelet

you can make this the night before and it will be ready to put in the oven in the morning. it's a nice light, fluffy omelet.

1. beat eggs and half and half until light and fluffy
2. stir in the cheese , ham , green pepper , onion and parsley
3. pour into a greased 9in square baking dish
4. bake at 400 for 25 minutes or until set
demonstrations.review: I used cheddar cheese cubes, cooked chopped bacon, green peppers, and green onions. I only beat the eggs by hand until they were well mixed. I will try using an electric mixer because now I'm realizing maybe that's what MIzzNezz meant by "beat". I used a 9 x 9 baking dish and it was perfect. I had to cook it for 10 minutes longer than expected though, so if you're making this as a potluck dish right before you go to the event, you'll want to add extra time to your estimate just in case. It got good reviews, but I thought the texture was tough and almost grainy. Maybe that's because I didn't use an electric mixer. I'm so glad I used the cheese cubes because you could really taste the cheese and appreciate it, rather than shreds just being lost in the egg.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tortellini with vegetables

sweet vegetables, cheese-filled pasta, and tangy garlic make this dish perfect for a summer afternoon picnic. this easy and quick recipe was adapted from a weight loss tracking website's newsletter.

1. in a medium saucepan cook tortellini in boiling water until just tender
2. drain and set aside
3. heat oil in a saute pan or medium sized pan and add onion
4. cook until translucent than add garlic , peppers , basil , and beans
5. continue cooking until peppers become slightly soft
6. toss the vegetable mixture with the drained tortellini , toss well , top with parmesan cheese and serve
demonstrations.review: I used a little extra garlic and about 3 shakes of Mrs. Dash and I still thought this dish didn't have much flavor. Also, the green pepper tasted bad. It was a new green pepper, too. Maybe they aren't good partially cooked (so it it is still somewhat crispy). I couldn't even finish eating it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cordon bleu casserole

nan

1. in a large bowl , combine turkey , ham and cheese
2. set aside
3. in a saucepan , saute onion in butter until tender
4. add flour
5. stir to form a paste
6. gradually add cream , stirring constantly
7. bring to a boil
8. boil 1 minute or until thick
9. add dill , mustard and nutmeg
10. mix well
11. remove from the heat and pour over meat mixture
12. spoon into a greased 13 x 9 x 2" baking dish
13. toss bread crumbs , butter and dill
14. stir in cheese and walnuts
15. sprinkle over the casserole
16. bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated through
demonstrations.review: It was decent - not super good. I did have to skip the ham though, because it smelled funny. Also, I didn't have half and half or light cream, so I used milk and sour cream. I also skipped the walnuts. I used crushed croutons as the topping and they had so much herb flavor, that I skipped the dill. If I were to make this again, I would substitute the dill for lots of fresh ground black pepper. If you're not used to eating dill, like us, that would be more suitable, I think.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy chipotle cole slaw

adapted from one of emeril's recipes, where he did an episode with "crazy tacos". we like to make this and serve it in the fish tacos. i don't use emeril's fish taco recipe, though. instead i serve with recipe #232309. i've change the propotions a bit and added some extras like cilantro and carrots. i really like the onions. update 6/6/07: i made this tonight and measured everything as i made it, so i've updated the amounts (usually i don't measure, but just eyeball it).

1. make the dressing first
2. combine the chipotle peppers , mayonnaise , honey and lime juice
3. in another large bowl , combine the cabbages , onions and carrots
4. drizzle the dressing over the top , sprinkle cilantro over the whole thing , and toss well to combine
5. season with salt and pepper as desired and chill until serving time
demonstrations.review: I took one bite and had to put it in the trash. It was way too spicy, but with that aside, the flavor was just very unappetizing. My husband thought it was just okay. To make it easier, instead of trying to finely chop the chiles, I'd put all of the sauce ingredients in a blender or food processor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best chili you will ever taste

this is the best chili recipe i have ever tried. i'm not sure where the recipe originated, but it is amazing! sometimes, i don't bother adding all four cans of the kidney beans and it still turns out wonderful. once anyone tastes this chili, they will be begging for the recipe!! enjoy!

1. heat oil
2. cook onions , garlic and meat until brown
3. add tomatoes , beer , coffee , tomato paste and beef broth
4. add spices stir in 2 cans of kidney beans and peppers
5. reduce heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. add 2 remaining cans of kidney beans and simmer for another 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: I didn't think this had enough chili taste, so I added a bunch of chili powder. I think this recipe could be written a little more clear. It should mention that you should drain the ground beef. It should also mention whether you should drain the beans or not. Also, is it ground coriander? I brewed 3 cups of coffee, then realized maybe the recipe meant 3 cups as in units of measurement. Also, what kind of chili peppers? I ended up using poblanos and that was a nice choice, but I had to figure out how many chili peppers equals one poblano. And for beginner cooks, it should mention what heat settings you should use on your stove. I tried to simmer it and even though I stirred very often, it still ended up burning.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot pork stew

nan

1. heat oil and brown pork
2. in large bowl combine all ingredients except broth and gravy mixes
3. pour into crock pot
4. combine broth and gravy mixes in the bowl and pour over ingredients in crock pot
5. cover and cook on low for 8 hours
target.review: This really turned out perfect for me. Very simple. I used boneless pork rib removed excess fat and cubed. The cut of meat was very tender. I chose red potatoes and ended up with the best textured potato I have ever gotten out of a stew. I substituted homemade Turkey Broth instead of canned chicken. Thanks for the simple basic recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
coconut chicken curry   crock pot

deliciously different!

1. heat oil in a medium fry pan
2. add chicken breasts and brown on both sides
3. place potatoes and onion in crock pot
4. place chicken breasts on top
5. combine coconut milk , salt , pepper , curry powder , hot sauce and chicken broth in a bowl and stir thoroughly
6. add to crock pot
7. cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours
8. one half hour before serving , add peas on top of chicken mixture
9. just before serving , stir mixture thoroughly and sprinkle with toasted coconut if using
10. serve over rice or asian noodles , if desired
demonstrations.review: I have made this twice on the stove top. Once I used bone in breasts simmered for about 50 min, added peas at the end.  The second time I made it with precooked chicken, simply browned the onions added the sauce ingredients heated to a low boil, added peas then added chicken and heated through. I left out the potatoes both times. A very good recipe, I love the chicken pea combination. Served over rice with extra Thai hot sauce. Perfect and easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy no rise pizza crust

you will not believe how easy and quick this is to make.  just stir ingredients together, let sit for ten minutes, then press into baking pan. add your favorite toppings and bake.  pizza in no time!

1. dissolve yeast in warm water in a medium bowl and add rest of ingredients
2. beat vigorously 20 strokes and let rest 10 minutes
3. press dough onto greased 11x17" baking sheet and add topping ingredients of your choice
4. bake at 425 for 15 to 20 minutes or until done
demonstrations.review: I used half whole wheat flour in this recipe and it turned out well.  I precooked the crust for 8 minutes before adding toppings.  I was not really able to stir the batter with the whole wheat mixture, seems it soaked up too much water,   I simply kneaded it for about two minutes right it the bowl and ended up with good texture.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco bell taco sauce

you can have this taste at home!

1. place in sauce pan and stir well , simmer at a very low temperature for 15- 20 minutes
2. remove and cool
3. may be kept in refrigerator for several days
demonstrations.review: I didn't use the water in this sauce and cut down the spices a little to make up for it. mixed the sauce with a can of lentils and added some chopped onions, put on top of seasoned ground beef in a tortilla and topped with cheese. One of those days where I needed to throw stuff together to make a meal but was absolutely wonderful sauce

demonstrations.recipe_text:
3 cheese toasted sandwiches

the mixture of melted cottage cheese, cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese is irresistible paired in crisp toasted bread.  delicious. from better homes and gardens new dieter's cookbook

1. in a medium sized bowl mix all ingredients
2. divide mixture among 3 or 4 slices of bread , top cheese mixture with remaining slices of bread
3. spray with cooking spray or lightly grease skillet , preheat on medium heat
4. cook sandwiches in the skillet , flip when browned and cook the other side until golden brown
5. remove from pan when browned and heated through
6. enjoy immediately !
7. makes 3 to 4 sandwiches
demonstrations.review: I was glad to have this recipe as it didn't seem like I had anything on  hand for a healthy lunch but I did have cottage cheese and celery. I made this mixture minus the green onions and baked it in my toaster oven in a low carb tortilla. Used Ortega taco sauce as a dip and it turned out as a satisfying lunch.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
interesting crock pot chicken

so simple, and so good! add a veggie or salad and dinner's done! i like to serve this over rice, but it is equally as tasty over cooked egg noodles. i also add extra 'shrooms cause we love them!

1. mix together dressing mix , chicken , mushrooms , butter , and chicken broth in crock pot
2. cook on high 5-6 hours
3. about 1 hour prior to serving , mix mushroom soup , cream cheese , and garlic
4. add to crock pot
5. cook on high for 1 more hour
6. season with salt and pepper to taste , and serve over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: This was extremely easy and very tastey. DH, my 4 year old and my 1 year old loved it. I used a whole pound of mushrooms and light cream cheese. Cooked a total time of 5 hours. I served it over rotini noodles to which I added a little olive oil and 5 oz of cooked chopped spinach to hide a few veggies with the wonderful flavors. It was a great combination.

target.recipe_text:
low carb pizza

i got this delicious recipe from www.atkinsdietbulletboard.com the orginal chef is bikergoddess. we all thank her for creating this great recipe. it's not exactly like pizza, but it's pretty close. i like it alot. i've made it twice now, and will be making it over and over again.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. beat together cream cheese and eggs until smooth
3. add cream , parmesan , chives , italian seasoning and garlic
4. spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray or oil
5. place 2 cups mozzarella cheese in bottom of pan
6. pour egg mixture over cheese
7. bake for 30 minutes
8. remove from oven and spread sauce over baked mixture
9. add toppings of choice
10. cover with remaining mozzerella cheese
11. bake until bubbly and brown
12. let stand for 5 minutes
target.review: This was quite the hit at our house!  I put the mozzarella cheese on a small baking sheet and baked it in the oven for about 5 minutes. I used 3 eggs and mixed it with the cream cheese but forgot to add the heavy cream. It really came out just fine without it.  For the toppings, I used Italian sausage, chopped onion, pepperoni and jalapeno peppers along with the 2% mozzarella cheese.  It was a great dinner to have for a cool Halloween night.  We didn't miss the crust  at all because there were so many other flavors that came through this low carb pizza that we felt we were cheating on our diets!  Thank you for posting this keeper of a recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked penne and cheese with spinach

a wonderfully tasty comfort food that has its "company's coming" clothes on. the spinach also boosts the nutrition, making it a complete meal.

1. cook the pasta in salted boiling water until it is very al dente
2. drain well and toss with a drizzle of oil to prevent it sticking
3. melt butter in a large saute pan over medium heat
4. add onion and mushrooms , and saute for about 5 minutes
5. sprinkle evenly with flour and stir until the flour is incorporated
6. slowly stir in milk and cook , stirring constantly , for five to seven minutes
7. add 1 1 / 2 cup of the cheese , salt to taste , cream , pepper , and nutmeg
8. cook and stir until the cheese melts
9. in a large bowl , mix together the pasta and uncooked spinach leaves
10. pour the hot sauce over and mix well
11. spoon into a buttered casserole large enough to hold or into a buttered 9x13 baking pan
12. sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 2 cup cheddar , cover with lid or foil
13. bake at 375 for 40 minutes , removing the lid / foil for the last 10 minutes
demonstrations.review:
Very good and easy to put together. My husband wasn't crazy about the mushrooms and I didn't feel that they contributed to the taste all that much so I probably won't add them the next time I make this.
Thanks Vina for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
salmon with sweet and spicy rub

this is from the show healthy appetite with ellie krieger.

1. coat your grill or a grill pan with cooking spray and preheat over medium heat
2. while the grill is heating , combine the brown sugar , chili powder , cumin , salt , and pepper
3. brush each salmon fillet with 1 / 2 teaspoon of the oil , then rub each fillet with about 1 / 2 tablespoon of the spice mixture
4. grill the salmon , flesh side down , until charred , 4 to 5 minutes
5. flip the salmon and cook another 5 to 6 minutes for medium doneness
6. for well done fish , cook an additional 1 to 2 minutes
7. remove to a platter and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: So darn good!!!  Love the sweet chili flavor on the salmon.  We grilled ours outdoors in a basket and the smell was wonderful.  Next time I will add some cayenne pepper to the rub to kick up the heat, but otherwise it was a success in our household.  Thank you for this fabulous recipe cookiedog!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the world s best bread machine pizza dough recipe

this is a delicious bread machine pizza dough recipe

1. add ingredients to machine in the order listed
2. set to dough mode and let the machine run through its cycle
3. once completed , place in greased pan to rise about 20-30 min , and split in half
4. if you aren't going to use the dough right away , fear not
5. simply divide the dough and place in ziplock bags , then stack flat to be used as needed
6. when the special day arrives , slap it on a cornmeal / floured surface , and roll flat , if you're fortunate enough to have a wife who doesn't mind you twirling it in her kitchen -- have fun with it before going for the big-bake !
7. add light layer of sauce and pre-bake your crust at 400 degrees for 5-7 minutes
8. believe me--you'll want to follow this step
9. remove from oven and add toppings of your choice
10. bake in oven at 400 degrees until done
11. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This is a great recipe for a nice thin crispy crust. We made a pepperoni, hot Italian sausage, red onion and jalapeno 14" pizza and took your suggestion about prebaking the dough with the pizza sauce. It really came out fantastic! I wouldn't change a thing with this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
goi cuon  vietnamese cold spring rolls

my friend, lan, who is vietnamese, showed me how to make these delicious and healthy spring rolls. these are served cold and are not fried. they do require some skill to roll - unless you've made these before, you may want to have extra rice papers on hand in case you tear some! it is crucial to use only fresh herbs etc. in this dish, however you can use any cooked meat or fish combo that you prefer. vegetarians may omit meat altogether. the prep time given is how long it should take - but first timers may find it takes longer to roll.

1. have all meats precooked and cold and the rice noodles prepared already
2. make sure all veggies and herbs are cleaned , dried , and set out before you start
3. dip a sheet of rice paper wrapper into water very quickly , no longer than a second or two and lay flat on a work surface
4. on one edge , lay a small handful of noodles , a few strips of meat , some shrimp , some cilantro and mint leaves , a lettuce leaf , some cucumber strips and bean sprouts , all to taste but don't overstuff
5. carefully start to roll up eggroll style , tucking in the sides , then continue to roll up-but not too tightly or the spring roll will split
6. these rolls will be thicker than the typical chinese-style fried eggrolls
7. combine a few spoonfulls of hoisin sauce with some chopped peanuts to use as a dipping sauce
8. serve immediately- these do not keep and will harden up in the fridge , so it is best to make just as many as you plan to serve
9. look for edible rice paper wrappers , rice noodle vermicelli , and hoisin sauce in asian markets
demonstrations.review: This was my first time ever making spring rolls.  I made mine vegetarian and added a few more ingredients, shredded cabbage instead of lettuce, chopped peanuts, and scallions.  The rice paper was larger than I thought and were the same size as a small tortilla.  After wrapping, I cut them in half and they were just the right size for our guests.  I used recipe #33113 for the dipping sauce and got great compliments for each!  I definitely will make these again and thanks for the great instructions you provided!  Great job HeatherFeather!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
orange spiced oatmeal raisin cookies

i got this recipe from a friend of mine. we think these cookies are delicious! a nice hint of orange to an oatmeal cookie! i usually double this recipe, and (if i'm feeling nutty! i'll add some chopped pecans! (prep time does not include soaking the raisins overnight in the liqueur.)

1. combine raisins and liqueur
2. let stand overnight or for several hours
3. beat butter and sugar until fluffy
4. beat in egg and orange peel
5. combine flour and baking soda
6. stir into butter mixture
7. add raisins and oats
8. mix well
9. drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets
10. spacing about 2-inches apart--flatten slightly
11. bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes
12. cool completely
13. melt white chocolate according to directions on package
14. use crisco to thin until consistency is appropriate to drizzle on top of each cookie
15. let harden completely before storing
demonstrations.review: These were just okay with our family.  I'm not sure why the raisins needed to be soaked in any liquid because it didn't really add anything to the flavor. Maybe I should've used cranberries like the other reviewer's suggestions, but these just didn't do it for me.  Sorry MustangMom, I really wanted to like these.

target.recipe_text:
smooch s light tilapia

ahhhh, i just had to put my zaar name on this one.  i finally came up wtih one heck of a recipe, in my opinion and wanted to share it.  one night, i was tired of measuring stuff out and trying to find a new way to cook my fish, so i combined some of my favorite flavors and came up with this.  i'm thinking i may add a bit of ground red pepper to it too for a bit of a bite.

added: thanks for the great reviews!!!  a note, i haven't used the dry garlic lately, as i'm really enjoying the freshly minced.  i did try elephant garlic, because i got a ton of it free from a local farmer and it turned out much milder, but i liked it better with regular ol' garlic!

1. preheat oven to 400
2. rinse tilapia and pat dry
3. spray a casserole dish with pam spray and set fish in it
4. sprinkle seasonings over fish in the order they are listed
5. place in oven
6. cook for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
7. i put it on broil the last tiny bit to get the cheese a little browned , but it's good without doing this too
target.review: I would rate this more stars if I could - wow!  My 8 year old son asked for 3rds - but we were out, because everyone was gobbling it up!  My whole family ate this and loved it - even the ones that don't like fish! I made it exactly as posted.  Thanks so much!  We will make this often!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic feta chicken

faboulous flavor in less than fifty minutes! compliments of athenos.

1. arrange chicken in 13x9-inch baking dish
2. drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the juice
3. sprinkle with oregano and pepper
4. top with cheese
5. drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon juice
6. bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes or until cooked through
demonstrations.review: YUM!  Loved the flavor of this!  I followed the recipe exactly except used only two breasts and added sundried tomatoes before the cheese - baked it for about 35 minutes and it was fabulous!  Will definitely make this one again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super easy roasted red potatoes

these are a family pleasing easy work night side dish anyone can make!  i approximate my measurements as i tend to be heavy handed and don't measure but did my best to estimate everything. ;)  we also like potatoes a lot and leftovers. ;) ***it came to my attention that i failed to mention a step - basting is always a good idea as you have time. ;)

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. place cleaned potatoes and all liquids and spices in covered baking dish
3. bake for 40 minutes , basting periodically as you have time , or until potatoes are tender when poked with a fork
4. cool 5 minutes and serve - great with any grilled or bakes meat dish - especially pork , beef and salmon !
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: These were fantastic!  I used olive oil cooking spray in my pan first.  I only had the bigger red potatoes so I cut them into chunks.  I had to cook them for about an hour, raise the temp slightly and take the cover off 1/2 way through, but what results!  Everyone loved them!  I will make these ultra yummy spuds again soon!  Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked chicken breasts

mmmmmm--this is so good and so creamy.  you will enjoy this dish.

1. butter a 13x9-inch baking dish and arrange breasts in dish
2. top with cheese slices
3. mix soup and apple juice together till well combined
4. spoon evenly over chicken breasts
5. sprinkle stuffing mix over soup
6. drizzle butter over crumbs
7. bake at 350 for 50 minutes to an hour , or till chicken is tender
demonstrations.review: We are in love with this recipe!  I've made this other ways, but I think Darlene nailed it with the apple juice.  My kids are picky eaters and they said it was the best chicken they ever ate!  Other recipes call for milk or wine - stick with apple juice!  Thanks Darlene!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple   delicious cranberry cream cheese pinwheels

these are super easy to make for a dinner party or as a dinner appetizer.  i always make them for the christmas holiday season and use spinach tortilla rollups.

1. mix cream cheese and garlic salt together until well blended
2. spread evenly on tops of tortillas
3. in small bowl , stir together cranberries and onions
4. sprinkle evenly over cream cheese spread
5. lightly press cranberry / onion mix into cream cheese
6. roll up tortilla
7. trim off ends
8. and cut each tortilla into 10 even pieces using a serated knife , like you would slice bread
demonstrations.review: I too live in MN!  Waiting for a big snow storm to hit this week - love it!  Made these as the recipe stated and took them to a holiday gift exchange party!  They were THE hit!  Everyone asked for the recipe and I took no left overs home!  Everyone said how 'festive' they were with the red (cranberries) and green (onion) in them.  Thanks so much for the awesome recipe!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic taco casserole

i originally found this taco casserole recipe in a taste of home magazine.  since then, i have made this recipe at least 50 times.  i love it because the ingredients list isn't complicated and, based on the layers, i can readily remember all ingredients when i am at the store without my recipe card.  i have served this for myself and had wonderful leftovers or many times i have made it for company with a nice green salad to accompany it.  i hope you enjoy it as much as i do.

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add taco seasoning and cook according to package directions , adding proper amount of water
3. put corn chips on bottom of 8x8" dish
4. cook refried beans on stove until hot
5. add 1 cup cheese and 1 cup salsa
6. stir until combined
7. pour beans over corn chips in dish
8. add beef to top of beans
9. sprinkle remaining cheese over top
10. sprinkle green onions and black olives over cheese
11. bake in a 375 degree oven until the cheese is sufficiently melted
12. take out of oven and sprinkle chopped tomatoes on top
13. wait 1-2 minutes and then serve
demonstrations.review: Yummy!  I will definitely make this again!  I had to sub sweet onion for the green onion because I didn't have any...I also had to use some doritos because I didn't have enough regular corn chips.  Everyone loved it!  Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
banana walnut and date loaf

great for the lunch box! this loaf can be topped with extra walnuts before baking.

1. preheat the oven to a moderate heat
2. grease and line a 20cm x 12cm loaf pan , with baking paper
3. beat butter and sugar together until creamy
4. add orange zest with one of the eggs and beat until smooth
5. add remaining egg and beat to a smooth batter
6. fold in the dates , bananas , flour , orange juice and walnuts and fold in well
7. spoon the batter into prepared loaf pan and bake for about 45 minutes or until cooked when tested with a scewer
8. cool loaf in pan for about 5 minutes , then turn out to a rack to cool completely
target.review:
Delicious!!!  I made this because it said it improves with age and I wanted something I could make ahead. I only made them today in little mini loaf pans and already they taste really good! :) so Im looking forward to them improving. I unfortunately didnt have dates so used raisins instead but will try with dates next time.
A love loaf recipe I can highly recommend.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
curry beef stew served over steamed rice

i was feeling nostalgic the other day and was remembering a curry dish that my japanese mother would occasionally make.  my mother passed away in 2002, and i never got the recipe from her.  the other day i started experimenting, and i finally came up with a dish that is close to the one she would make.  this dish is similar to a thick beef stew, but has a wonderful curry flavor.  my mother's dish had a greener curry.  i think she used to get her curry at the oriental store.  i used a curry that i had gotten at my local supermarket.  i do want to try this again with a curry from the oriental store.  you can use more or less curry to suit your taste.  this is cooked slowly to make the meat nice and tender.

1. mix together flour , salt and pepper
2. coat beef in flour mixture
3. in a large saucepan or pot , brown the beef cubes and onions in butter
4. add the beef stock , curry and bay leaves
5. cook on low heat for 30 minutes
6. add the potatoes , carrots , and vinegar
7. simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour until all is tender and sauce has thicken to a thick stew consistency
8. mix in soy sauce to taste
9. serve over steamed rice
demonstrations.review:
This was a lovely easy wintery curry that was easy to put together and had a nice flavour too! I am looking forward to having leftovers for dinner again tonight! Will make again for sure.
thankyou Crafty Lady 13! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
awesome blueberry muffins

this is a awesome blueberry muffin recipe. double it to make large muffins. i sometimes add cinnamon to the batter.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. grease muffin cups or line with muffin liners
3. combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , 3 / 4 cup sugar , salt and baking powder
4. place vegetable oil into a 1 cup measuring cup
5. add the egg and enough milk to fill the cup
6. mix this with flour mixture
7. fold in blueberries
8. fill muffin cups right to the top , and sprinkle with crumb topping mixture
9. to make crumb topping: mix together 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 3 cup flour , 1 / 4 cup butter , and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon
10. mix with fork , and sprinkle over muffins before baking
11. bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven , or until done
demonstrations.review:
OOH these were so delicious! and so easy and quick to make too, what a bonus!!  I just love them and will make again soon Im sure, I did use brown sugar in the crumb topping instead of white though but still tasted very nice indeed.
A great recipe DebM, thanks so much!!!

Di

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chewy granola bars

i "borrowed" this recipe from the kitchen at my college because i fell in love with these bars. they are so much better than store-bought, and you can add or subtract ingredients as you wish. they make a perfect on-the-go snack; a much healthier alternative to chips or cookies, especially for kids (great for lunch boxes!)

1. preheat oven to 350 and lightly grease or spray 9 x 13 pan
2. in large bowl , beat brown sugar , sugar , and butter until light and fluffy
3. blend in honey , vanilla and egg
4. in separate bowl , combine flour , cinnamon , baking soda , and salt
5. add flour mixture gradually to sugar mixture and beat until combined
6. by hand , stir in almonds , chocolate chips and oats until well mixed
7. press mixture firmly in bottom of greased pan , and bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes , or until light golden brown
8. cool and cut into squares
demonstrations.review:
A really great Granola bar! I whipped this up in now time! and it tastes so very very good and morish!.
I only used 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup butter and no white sugar. I added sultanas, cranberries, dried apricots, walnuts & sunflower seeds and Im sitting here trying not to be tempted to go and grab another piece! I just had a very generous slice and it was amazing yum!.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crunchy granola

this granola makes a great, filling snack. good dry or with milk. it is very addictive, but it's good for you, so enjoy!

1. heat oven to 275 degrees f
2. line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
3. combine brown sugar and water in a 4 cup microwave proof cup
4. microwave on high 5 minutes until sugar is completely dissolved
5. remove from microwave and stir in vanilla and salt
6. in large mixing bowl , mix oats , nuts , and brown sugar mixture
7. mix thoroughly
8. spread onto cookie sheets and bake 45 minutes-1 hour until golden brown
9. when granola has cooled completely , add fruits if you wish and store in airtight container
demonstrations.review:
This was really good! Easy to make and no fat added...perfect!! I will make this again for sure.

I added cranberries & dried apricots and is a definate favourite breakfast for me at the moment.

Love it!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet toffee pretzel mix

a yummy sweet and salty snack!

1. in a 9x13-inch glass dish , combine the pretzels and the nuts
2. in a large saucepan combine the butter , sugar , corn syrup and salt
3. stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves
4. bring to a boil and cook until thickened
5. remove from heat and pour over your pretzel mixture and mix until everything is coated
6. bake in a preheated 250 oven for about 20 minutes
7. remove from oven and spread out to cool on a sheet of wax paper
demonstrations.review:
I made this wanting something festive and it turned out great! lots of toffee covering the pretzels and nuts! a delicious festive brittle, I will give this as gifts and Im sure it will be warmly recieved, what a great easy recipe, thanks PrincessMommy!
DizzyDi :)

target.recipe_text:
quick home made rice better than rice a roni

make your own delicious rice (not from a box) with only 3 ingredients! this quick and easy recipe delivers great tasting rice that goes well with any dish.

1. place rice in a rice cooker
2. no need to water and rinse the rice first
3. pour 1 1 / 2 cup of cold water right on top of the rice
4. in a separate container dissolve the bouillon in the 1 / 2 cup warm water
5. once the bouillon is completely dissolved mix it in the rice cooker with the rest of the water and the rice
6. put rice cooker on "cook" and you are done !
7. mix well before serving
target.review: I was pleasantly surprised at the amount of flavor with so few ingredients. I love my rice cooker and I really like this recipe. I cook a lot of rice and this recipe goes into the keeper file for sure. And it couldn't be any easier!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave poached eggs

i have been poaching eggs in the microwave for many years.  for me this is the best way to prepare poached eggs for 2.  it is quick, easy and almost foolproof.  please make sure you use a toothpick to pierce the yolk before cooking or it will explode!

1. add the water and white vinegar to a 6 ounce custard cup
2. break egg into cup , pierce egg yolk with toothpick , and cover dish loosely with plastic wrap
3. place in microwave and cook for 1 minute or until desired doneness
4. you may need to experiment with cooking times based on the wattage of your microwave and taste preference
5. immediately remove egg from hot water with a slotted spoon as it will continue to cook
6. serve with salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: Simply amazing. I made this at work this morning without the vinegar and it was egg perfection. We have a small microwave here and it took a little longer than a minute. Now I can make my own "Mc" Breakfast sandwich and save myself some time and money.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet and savory baked beans

this is a delicious baked bean recipe!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. mix all ingredients in 9 x 13 glass baking dish
3. bake in oven for 50 minutes
demonstrations.review: These are THE best baked beans I have ever eaten. DH's comment: "These may just be the best baked beans ever." I can't wait to take them to a potluck at work. We grill hot dogs for the gang quite often in the spring and summer and the gals in the office make and bring side dishes. I will certainly be the star with this dish. Made for New Kids on the Block tag game.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork chop  onion  and rice casserole

an easy one-dish meal.

1. brown chops in oil
2. spread rice in rectangular baking dish
3. add frozen vegetables
4. reserve one tablespoon of dry soup mix
5. sprinkle remaining soup mix over rice
6. pour heated beef broth over rice and mix ingredients together
7. arrange pork chops on top of rice mixture and sprinkle with reserved onion soup mix
8. cover tightly with foil and bake in moderate oven until tender , depending on thickness of chops
9. remove foil and continue cooking for 10 minutes or until any excess liquid has evaporated
demonstrations.review: Excellent week night casserole. I did leave out the frozen mixed vegetables. I can see using this recipe without the pork chops for a side dish. I love rice and this was very flavorful. And super easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
angel hair pasta with lemon and chicken

the fresh flavor burst of lemon perfectly accents the chicken and angel hair pasta in this quick and easy dish.  serve with a generous topping of parmesan cheese and a tossed green salad.

1. prepare pasta according to package directions
2. toss pasta with butter , lemon juice , parsley , marjoram and garlic powder
3. add chicken
4. season with salt and ground black pepper
demonstrations.review: Quick, easy and very tasty. I used a 12 1/2oz can of chunk chicken breast, drained . I believe that this will be one of those dishes that are even better the next day. I agree with another reviewer about the trying it with shrimp.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rice cooker chicken bog

chicken bog is not only a staple in the south but also a tradition. cooking it is a bit of an art - otherwise - you end up with sticky goey rice or a brown crust on the bottom of the pan. in my quest for perfect every time bog - i turned to my trusty rice cooker. this recipe yields never fail bog with perfect fluffy rice time after time!

1. in a large pot over medium heat cook the bacon until it is crisp
2. remove and set aside to cool
3. crumble once cooled
4. add the butter to the bacon grease and brown the sasuage
5. add the onions and cook unitl they begin to brown
6. place the chicken thighs in the pot and add the chicken stock
7. add the crumbled bacon , season salt , garlic powder , onion powder , black pepper and cayenne if you are using it
8. bring the pot to a boil and then put on low heat to cook the chicken , about 30-40 minutes
9. cut off the heat and remove the chicken thighs
10. let them cool , discard the skins and pick the meat off the bones
11. return the chicken meat to the pot
12. place the 3 cups of rice in your rice cooker and dump in the entire contents of the pot
13. push the "cook" button on your rice cooker - at the end of the cycle you will have perfect chicken bog !
demonstrations.review: I grew up in the Low Country area of SC and have loved chicken bog all of my life. It is a great honor to be 'known' for your chicken bog. My Grandmother's was always the first to go at family reunions and church potlucks.  And my mother's was also pretty awesome. Mine has always been good but not great. Until I found this recipe and method of cooking it. This is the best chicken bog I've ever made and one of the best I've ever eaten. I can't wait to make this for them. I may even let them take some of the credit for teaching me so well but I'll know where the credit is due.  I followed the recipe closely except I only had 1 pound of sausage and my Lawry's Seasoning Salt had black pepper in it so I didn't add any additional. I also did not use the cayenne.  VTodd this bog rocks and if you have any more recipes using a rice cooker, please post them.  I wish I could give it 10 stars.

target.recipe_text:
african dessert

posted for the zaar world tour 06.

1. cut each bananas into fourths
2. arrange bananas in greased 9 inch pie plate
3. dot with butter
4. drizzle with orange and lemon juice
5. sprinkle with brown sugar and coconut
6. bake at 370f until coconut is golden brown about 8-10 minutes
target.review: Great dessert!  So easy, my 4 year old helped me prepare it!  Not too sweet.  The orange juice gives just the right amount of tang and balances the sweetness of the bananas nicely!  The family loved it!  I recommend using bananas that are a little on the green side.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet steak kabobs

we grill a lot-this is our best venison or beef marinade. prep time includes 8 hours of marinating.

1. combine all marinade ingredients and pour over steak cubes
2. marinate in the refrigerator at least 8 hours
3. on skewers , alternate steak with vegetables and pineapple
4. grill on high for 10-15 minutes , basting frequently with reserved marinade
demonstrations.review:
This marinade is just terrific!  We used beef rib-eye, like the other reviewer did.  
The pineapple and veggie combination were very complemetary! Definitely making this again!!  Thank you, Kaarin!  You made me look like a grilling pro (which I'm not) to my husband (who is)!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
starbucks gingerbread

for those of you who may not like the very spicy, dark version so often served during the holidays, this loaf is lighter and very moist. a hint of orange is a wonderful addition, and the cream cheese icing is a perfect compliment. (originally published by veronica hill.)

1. preheat oven to 350f grease and flour a 9-inch loaf pan , or even a square baking pan
2. in a medium bowl , stir together the flour , ginger , cinnamon , cloves and salt
3. set aside
4. in a large bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
5. dissolve baking soda into applesauce and mix into creamed butter
6. add flour mixture
7. mix until smooth
8. pour the batter into a loaf pan
9. bake for 40-50 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out just slightly sticky
10. for the frosting , beat the cream cheese until light and fluffy
11. beat in the vanilla
12. gradually beat in the powdered sugar
13. frost the cake when it is completely cooled
14. decorate with chopped candied orange peel or candied ginger
demonstrations.review: I made this for my Starbucks-loving friends and everyone thought it was GREAT!!  Even my hubby!!  And the icing went with it so well!! In fact, there was some icing left over, and we ate it with spoons, right out of the bowl!  My oven runs a bit hot, so I did check the cake a little before the time specified.  Thanks for a lovely recipe that the whole family (and my friends) really enjoyed!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red lentil  zucchini   couscous soup

don't let the name turn you off!  this soup has a nice thick consistency that is nice and flavorful.  a perfect blend of vegetables, legumes and grains.  i personally do not like the texture of couscous when eaten like rice or pasta yet i love this soup!  leftovers freeze well.  recipe from "meal lean i yum!"

1. grate carrots and zucchini , set aside
2. heat oil in a 5 quart soup pot
3. add onions and celery
4. saute on medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until golden
5. if vegetables begin to stick , add a tbsp or two of water
6. add all ingredients except couscous to the pot , increase to high heat to bring to a boil
7. reduce heat and simmer partially covered for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. add couscous and simmer an additional 10 minutes
9. if soup is too thick , thin it with a little bit of water
10. adjust seasonings to taste
11. yield 8 servings - per serving: 134cal , 1g fat , 8g protein , 24g carb , 3mg iron , 8g fibre
demonstrations.review: This was terrific soup!  Very delicious!!  Used the vegetable broth option instead of the water and fresh fennel instead of celery (only because I don't care much for celery).  Made for the ZWT4 CAFE ZMAAK Gypsies team!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cherry streusel  coffee cake

a great coffee cake that tastes as good as it looks. this cake has been a real crowd pleaser at our sunday morning coffee hour. there are no leftovers when serving this one. i got this recipe from a friend who not only has great recipes but shares them!

1. in a large bowl make crumb mix: 2 1 / 4 cups flour 3 / 4 cup white sugar
2. whisk together to mix
3. cut in: 3 / 4 cup butter or margarine
4. mix until crumbly
5. remove 1 / 2 cup of crumb mix and set aside to sprinkle on top
6. to remainder of crumb mix add: 1 / 2 teaspoon baking powder 1 / 2 teaspoon baking soda combine: 1 beaten egg and 3 / 4 cup buttermilk or sour milk
7. add to dry crumb mix and stir until just moistened
8. spread 2 / 3 of batter over bottom and part way up the side of a greased 9 inch spring form pan or a well greased bundt pan
9. i favor the spring form pan when serving this as dessert
10. spoon cherry pie filler over batter
11. drop spoonfuls of remaining batter over filling
12. sprinkle with the 1 / 2 cup of reserved crumb mix
13. bake 350 for 50-55 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a very nice, light cake, with great texture!  I love cherries, so I made the recipe as is.  I think I might add a wee bit of almond flavoring to the cherries and/or to the batter next time to help bring out the flavor of the cherries.  Yum!!  This was excellent and so versatile!  Made for ZWT4 for the CAFE ZMAAK Gypsies!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oriental vegetables with noodles

fresh shitake mushrooms and sesame oil are true oriental iingredients in this yummy stir fry, but it is the italian balsamic vinegar that gives it the edge. from the cookbook pasta!

1. bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil
2. add the egg noodles and cook briefly until just tender , about 5 minutes
3. drain thoroughly
4. thinly slice the red onion and the shitake mushrooms
5. preheat a wok , or heavy skillet , and add the vegetable oil and swirl it around
6. when the oil is hot , add the onion and mushrooms , and stir fry for 3 minutes
7. add the noodles to the wok with the soy sauce , balsamic vinegar , brown sugar and salt
8. toss them over the heat for 3 minutes
9. add the sesame oil
10. transfer to a warmed bowl , and serve at once , garnished with the parsley leaves , if desired
demonstrations.review: This was wonderful!  I made this for ZWT 4 Add More Veggies Challenge, and added a few more veggies to meet the challenge's requirement.  I added broccoli, green onions, sliced carrots, chopped carrots, and water chestnuts.

target.recipe_text:
eggplant  aubergine  meatballs

my fiancee loves having meatballs with pasta, but i sometimes tire of having so much meat! i've found these to be a great compromise.

1. slice eggplant and sprinkle with salt
2. let sit 10 minutes to draw out water
3. rinse and pat dry
4. saute on stovetop with a splash of olive oil and about 1 / 4 cup water until eggplant is soft
5. remove and chop finely
6. mix everything but the breadcrumbs when eggplant is cool
7. then add breadcrumbs and mix until you get the consistency you want to form the balls
8. place in a generously olive oiled pan about l inch apart and bake at 400 degrees until golden brown , about 40 60 minutes
9. turn halfway through baking to ensure even browning
target.review: Thanks for sharing - my husband swore you couldnt tell they were not meat and my toddler who is sooo picky about food ate 9 of them!!  They reminded me of falaffels - but an Italian version...  thanks again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ww 0 point weight watchers cabbage soup

you can eat as much of this 0-point weight watchers cabbage soup as you like. it's so good for you.

1. spray pot with non stick cooking spray saute onions carrots and garlic for 5 minutes
2. add broth , tomato paste , cabbage , green beans , basil , oregano and salt & pepper to taste
3. simmer for a about 5-10 minutes until all vegetables are tender then add the zucchini and simmer for another 5 or so minutes
4. i have tried different variations
5. leaving out green beans
6. adding chopped green onions in addition to the yellow onion
7. all very good
8. you can customize it a bit
demonstrations.review: Perfect- I doubled the recipe and stored in individual portion containers.  I actually finely shredded some of the carrot to thicken up the broth.  It worked out great! Nice low calorie filler! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best browned beef stew ever

i originally found this recipe at recipe goldmine but have added and subtracted after trial and error. the original recipe called for a 10 oz pkg of frozen peas to be added during the last 15 minutes of cooking. i usually add a little rosemary and cayenne. can add the spices you wish. this is very good!

1. put flour , salt and pepper in a large ziploc bag
2. heat oil over medium heat in a large dutch oven
3. place meat in bag with the flour and shake until well coated
4. shake off meat pieces and add them to the oil and stir until slightly browned , add remaining flour from the bag and the finely chopped onion
5. stir until well browned
6. add finely chopped carrot and next 4 ingredients
7. cover and cook over low heat for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. add diced potatoes , carrots , and onions , cook for another 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender
demonstrations.review: My family loved this recipe! I didn't have 3 1/2 cup beef broth - I only had one can so I substituted the difference with warm water and Lipton Onion Mushroom Soup mix.   I love that there were no tomatoes in it! The meat was so tender!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: My family loved this! I served it with Arroz a la Mexicana-Traditional Mexican Rice Recipe #10833  and refried beans(out of a can - shame on me!)  There were no leftovers except some left over sauce which I will serve my husband as dip with tortillas during the week.  Thanks for the great recipe - it's a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blueberry sour cream coffeecake

this is so moist and full of flavor.  the sour cream gives it a rich depth of taste.  i found this in a church cookbook that i picked up somewhere a number of years ago.  the recipe didn't call for powdered sugar, but i like to sprinkle that on coffeecake.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. spray an 8x8-inch cake pan with butter-flavored cooking spray
3. in a large bowl , combine baking mix , sugar , and nutmeg
4. stir well to combine
5. in a smaller bowl , beat the egg slightly , stir in the sour cream , milk & vanilla
6. make a well in the center of the dry ingredients
7. pour in the liquid
8. stir well to combine
9. fold in the blueberries
10. spread batter evenly into prepared cake pan
11. bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. place pan on a wire rack to cool
13. serve warm or room temperature
demonstrations.review: if i could give this 10 stars I would!   I had fresh blueberries to use and everything else this recipe called for on hand and it is delicious.  My men (hubby and 2 year) loved it, definetly a keeper!  I also baked for an additional 10 minutes.  Thanks for the great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave poached eggs

i have been poaching eggs in the microwave for many years.  for me this is the best way to prepare poached eggs for 2.  it is quick, easy and almost foolproof.  please make sure you use a toothpick to pierce the yolk before cooking or it will explode!

1. add the water and white vinegar to a 6 ounce custard cup
2. break egg into cup , pierce egg yolk with toothpick , and cover dish loosely with plastic wrap
3. place in microwave and cook for 1 minute or until desired doneness
4. you may need to experiment with cooking times based on the wattage of your microwave and taste preference
5. immediately remove egg from hot water with a slotted spoon as it will continue to cook
6. serve with salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: awesomely easy !!  thank you for sharing - i didnt have a small cup/ bowl so i used a drinking glass and it worked out fine and i didnt have plastic wrap so i used a sandwich bag(the kind that you fold not with the zip top) and everything was perfect!  I serve breakfast for dinner often(working mom) and this is a nice way to switch it up...thanks again!

target.recipe_text:
cooked chicken for recipes   barefoot contessa style

i always poached chicken when i needed cooked for a recipe -- and i never liked the way it came out.  i was watching ina's show on the food network last weekend and this is how she cooks her chicken for recipes.  i tried it and it was the most moist chicken i have ever had.  i used it in chicken noodle soup -- yum!!!  the recipe can be increased or decreased depending on how much cooked chicken you need.   update 7/31/07 -- i tried this method on boneless, skinless chicken breasts and it worked great -- i baked for about 35 minutes and it was cooked perfectly!

1. place chicken breasts on baking sheet with sides , skin side up
2. rub olive oil on breasts , sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. bake at 350 for 45 minutes
4. cool , then chop or slice to use in your recipes
target.review: I don't really have to "try" this recipe since it has been the way I grew up making chicken. When I was younger we sprinkled a little paprika on them. Now that I live in Florida I use Everglades seasoning only!!! I also bake half my chicken and boil half for when I am making homemade chicken soup!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asparagus chicken with hollandaise sauce

this recipe came from another recipe site. it is mouthwatering delicious. beautiful presentation. simple, simple, simple to make. originally found the recipe in february and just got around to making it. i'm sorry i lost all of that time eating it! i'll make up for it now. cook time does not include 2 hours for marinating.

1. to marinate: place chicken in a nonporous glass dish or bowl
2. pour wine over chicken , then sprinkle with tarragon
3. cover dish and refrigerate to marinate for 2 hours
4. preheat oven to broil
5. remove chicken from dish or bowl discarding remaining marinade and broil for 25 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear
6. meanwhile , steam asparagus to desired degree of doneness
7. prepare hollandaise sauce according to package directions
8. when chicken is cooked , arrange the breasts on a platter , place 4 spears of asparagus on each chicken breast and dribble with prepared hollandaise sauce to taste
9. sprinkle with cheese and serve
demonstrations.review: This is a nice change from eating with the kids. As a single mom I tend to wind up eating kiddie food like chicken nuggets, mac and cheese, pizza, etc.... Tonight I decided to treat myself and I am glad I did. No more kids meals for me...lol

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot pumpkin pie pudding

just in time for the holidays. a family favorite.

1. in a large bowl mix together the first eight ingredients
2. transfer to crock pot coated with pam
3. cover and cook on low 6-7 hours
4. serve in bowls with whip cream , if desired
demonstrations.review: This is a recipe I used for my Test it Taste it Rate it recipes for magicalholidayhome.com and everyone there has rated it 5 stars or in our case "Magical...in the notebook it goes" The recipe seemed to cook in like 3 1/2 hours not 6-7 and yes I cooked it on low!!! For Easter (tomorrow) I plan to make this again and double the recipe in one of my crockpots!!
