demonstrations.review: I will never make a traditional pumpkin pie again after tasting this.  I am one who eats the filling first and this will certainly satisfy that craving...simply delicious.  Followed the recipe to the letter and it passed with FLYING colors!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
great turkey meatloaf

i searched all over for a good meatloaf recipe that did not use ketchup! finally i came up with this one. it's great with ground beef or ground venison also.

1. mix turkey , oatmeal , parmesan cheese , garlic powder , pepper , onion soup mix , and egg together
2. mix in 1 / 2 can of mushroom soup
3. press into loaf pan
4. pour remaining 1 / 2 can of mushroom soup over top
5. bake 1 hour at 350
demonstrations.review: What an exceptional meatloaf!!  Made for the family and even my youngest picky eater loved it and asked for seconds!  Didn't have the 2 lb. of ground turkey so I used mostly turkey and a little bit of ground beef.  Delicious!!  Will definitely be making this again and from now on.  VERY simple to prepare and had all the ingredients on hand.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot hot fudge sundae cake

this is a nice fudgie cake for dessert. the cake can stand while you are whipping up a quick main course eg a grill and salad.

1. spray inside of 2- 3 1 / 2 quart crock with cooking spray
2. mix flour , sugar , 2 tbs cocoa , baking powder and salt in medium bowl
3. stir in milk , oil and vanilla until smooth
4. stir in nuts
5. spread batter evenly in slow cooker
6. mix brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup cocoa in small bowl
7. stir in hot water until smooth
8. pour evenly over batter in crock
9. cover and cook on high 2- 2 1 / 2 hours or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. turn off crock
11. let cake stand uncovered 30- 40 minutes to cool slightly before serving
12. spoon warm cake into dessert dishes
13. spoon sauce over top
14. 6 servings
demonstrations.review: Delicious!!  I was not sure how chocolaty this would be and had 1 cup left in a bag of semi-sweet chocolate chips, so I threw them in the cake batter before putting it in the crockpot.  OH WOW was this decadent tasting!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
twice  baked potato casserole

the flavour of twice-baked potatoes in an easy casserole dish (no cream soups!) for everyone to share.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. lightly grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish
3. cook potatoes in a large pot with salted water to cover for 20 to 25 minutes , until tender when pierced
4. drain well and return to pot
5. while potatoes are still hot , add butter and mash with a potato masher until smooth
6. stir in 1 cup of cheese , milk , sour cream and eggs until blended
7. then add 1 / 2 cup of scallions , 3 slices of bacon , crumbled
8. salt and pepper to taste
9. spoon into the prepared baking dish
10. sprinkle with remaining cheese and 2 slices of bacon , crumbled
11. bake uncovered for 35-40 minutes or until the top is lightly golden brown
12. sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup of scallions and serve
demonstrations.review: What a simple and delicious alternative to basic, boring old baked potatoes!  And the kids loved it.  Simple to make and tasty.  Didn't have bacon so did without it and added some fresh chives.  YUM!!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot peppercorn and onion pot roast

similar to some of the other pot roast recipes here, but i couldn't find one quite like this. very few ingredients makes this one easy pot roast to make and the gravy is delicious.  great to come home from work to.

1. mix all dry ingredients together and rub all over roast
2. place beef in slow cooker and add beef stock
3. mix any left over of the dry ingredients into the stock
4. cook on low for 6 - 8 hours
5. remove pot roast and either serve with gravy as is , or mix corn flour with cold water to thicken
target.review:
I used only water in place of the beef stock on this one as I find the French onion soup mix to be a bit salty sometimes. I cooked mine for a lot longer than stated because I wanted to shred the meat and use in a toasted roll along with the gravy. 
After cooking I removed the meat and let the gravy cool so I could skim the the small about of fat from the top before heating and thickening slightly. The gravy was fab and the recipe a nice introduction to the crock pot.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tasty roast pumpkin

pumpkin with a tasty sauce

1. preheat oven to 200c
2. in a roasting pan toss together onion , pumpkin , chilli flakes , oil and sea salt
3. bake 40-50 min or until cooked through
4. meanwhile bring honey and vinegar to the boil in a small pan , then simmer for 5 minutes
5. place roasted pumpkin and onion in a serving dish , drizzle with honey mixture and scatter with mint
demonstrations.review: Yummo!! This is a great way to serve pumpkin, I've had it twice now...first off with Leslies Topside Roast Leslies Topside Roast and the next time it was made up in the Webber BBQ and served with Roast Pork. It's visually appealing too when served up direct from the baking dish. Thanks for sharing!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apples on the bottom cobbler

just as the name implies, this cobbler starts with apples, then adds the flaky, tender "crust" on the top.  tastes just like apple pie.  in fact, that's what it is - a single-crust, upside down apple pie.  try it and see what you think.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. pour filling into 9" square baking dish
3. dot the top with 1 tbsp margarine
4. in a medium bowl , mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
5. cut in the margarine
6. work until dough is lumpy
7. add the milk
8. mix into pasty dough
9. dab dough on top of apples
10. bake for 25-30 minutes , until golden brown and delicious
demonstrations.review: Yum... I made as directed but sprinkled my apples with a little nutmeg, cinnamon and extra sugar before the topping was added. Served with lashings of cream it made for a lovely dessert. Reviewed for ZWT3

demonstrations.recipe_text:
south beach salmon with creamy lemon sauce low carb

i found this in the "south beach diet book".. even if you're not dieting... it's great. just substitute real sour cream for the fat-free for a to die for experience. it's quick, simple and uses on hand ingredients.

1. preheat the oven to 350f
2. coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat
4. add the garlic and cook for one minute
5. reduce heat to low
6. stir in the lemon juice , capers and lemon-pepper seasoning and cook for 5 minutes
7. add the sour cream and cook for 5 minutes or until heated though
8. meanwhile , place the salmon on the prepared baking sheet
9. bake for 20 minutes or until the fish is just opaque
10. serve with the sauce
demonstrations.review: This sauce was divine!! I grilled my salmon as my oven is on the blink and used a low fat sour cream. Served the salmon atop of a bed of creamy mash and a side of steamed green beans. The lemon sauce was poured over the salmon and mash..Mmm!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
japanese mum s chicken

we have a japanese girl, tomoko, living with us, and tonight she and i cooked a japanese dinner for us and her friends. she phoned her mum,toshiko, in japan for this, as it's her favourite recipe, and i wanted to share it here. it's simple and so good, and tomoko, who is only 16, did such a good job of cooking this, then translating the recipe to english for me.

*the liquid will thicken to a glaze if you are patient. it just takes a bit of time. if you feel your chicken is cooked (and going to overcook) remove it before going on to reduce the liquid. same thing, if you must use breast meat, remove it (so it doesn't dry out) and continue reducing the liquid . if you do it this way rather than thickening with cornstarch you will get a richer glaze and not need to add stock or broth instead of the water. it just takes patience. and note: a glaze is sticky and coats the meat, this is not a sauce.

1. place all the ingredients in a saucepan over a high heat
2. bring to the boil , then reduce to a simmer for about 20 minutes
3. remove any scum that rises to the surface
4. increase the heat , turning the drumsticks frequently in the liquid , and cook until the liquid has reduced to a sticky glaze
5. arrange the chicken on a serving platter , remove the garlic clove and chili from the liquid , and spoon the glaze over
demonstrations.review:
This was a delightful chicken dish....very easy to prepare and tasty to boot!!
I used dark soy sauce as it was all I had on had but will use light soy next time as the sauce ended up a little too dark.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tawa chicken

dhana jeera powder, is a blend of two basic spices: coriander and cumin powder.

1. put oil in a large , wide pan , and set over medium heat
2. put in cloves , cinnamon stick and cardamom pots
3. saut until spices start to sizzle then add onions
4. saut onions until they are golden brown in color
5. add dhana jeeru , salt , chilies , garlic , ginger , cayenne , turmeric , lemon juice and methi leaves
6. cook for a minute
7. put chicken pieces and stir
8. cover lid and lower heat to medium low
9. cook , turning pieces occasionally until all the juices released by the chicken disappear and chicken is golden brown in color
10. add tomatoes and cook for 3 - 5 minutes
11. take pan off heat
12. sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro
demonstrations.review: Mmm...delightful! I used chicken breast in place of the thigh and added about 1/2 cup water along with the tomatoes so it had a little gravy. Wonderful flavours...I served over steam Jasmine rice and topped with a small blob of greek yogurt. Reviewed for Fall 2008 PAC

target.recipe_text:
rudolph the red nosed reindeer cookies

very cute little cookies that will bring a smile to the little ones faces! great little cookies to send to school on "christmas party" day! you will be the hit of the classroom! (hint: you can use icing bag with piping tip, and a frosting that dries hard to stick on the eyes and nose, i use a stiff buttercream frosting colored the color of the eyes and nose, it works faster for me than the melted chocolate). i just love all the cute photos and different ideas for this recipe!

1. microwave the chocolate in a small glass dish on high for 3 minutes , stirring once
2. for each rudolph dip 2 pretzel sticks in chocolate and stick to top of each sandwich cookie , forming large antlers
3. break one pretzel in half , dip in chocolate and place pretzel half next to longer pretzel sticks , forming antlers
4. dip one side of blue , green , or brown mini m&m's in melted candy coating and place , coated side down , on cookies for the eyes
5. dip one side of the cinnamon red hot , or red m&m in candy coating , and place on cookies , coated side down , for the nose
target.review: I dipped my in chocolate candy coating. That makes it a 2 person job, though, because it is VERY messy.  I dipped the top, dipped the bottom and then did a quick scrape off the back of the cookie (rubber spatula) and a quick scrape around the edges and laid it out on wax paper.  My daughter quickly laid on the eyes, nose and pretzel antlers!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious acorn squash soup

this is a delicious thick creamy rich soup with a lovely yellow colour, perfect for those cool fall and cold winter nights. you can adjust the dill, cayenne and curry to taste and this recipe can easily be doubled.

1. in a large saucepan , saute the onion with garlic and celery in butter
2. stir in flour , bouillon powder , dill , curry and cayenne until blended
3. gradually add broth and cream , bring to a light boil
4. cook and stir for 2 minutes
5. add the squash , then season with salt and lots black pepper
6. cook , stirring until heated through
7. in a blender carefully process the soup in batches until smooth
8. pour into bowls
9. garnish with bacon and croutons
10. delicious !
demonstrations.review:
This was SO good. A neighbor gave me 5 acorn squash. I used them all and I think I had 6 cups of squash. I doubled everything except for the dill weed (wasn't sure I was going to like that), bouillon (thought I would have enough salt), I doubled the celery, and I used lowfat yogurt. Fantastic. Also I calculated the calories on spark people's recipe calculator site. As I made it, I think it was 78 calories with 2.5 g fat for 1/2 cup serving. (no bacon and croutons) Hope that helps someone.
1/2012 I make this recipe a lot--I love it. Today I made it with butternut squash and evaporated milk--YUM!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
most incredible no fail pie crust

this is absolutely the best pie crust i have ever used. it never fails me and always comes out flaky and perfect. this recipe is enough for 2 - 9" crusts.

1. cut together flour , shortening and salt until it resembles small peas
2. combine the egg , water and vinegar and gradually add to flour mixture
3. stir just until moistened and a soft dough forms
4. divide into 2 disks
5. wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
6. roll out and use with your favorite pie recipe !
demonstrations.review: I used this for quiches that I took to a ladies breakfast.  Really wonderful.  Tonight I made Turkey Pot Pie #45070--unbelievable.  This pie crust was just perfect.  It was light, flakey and held together very well.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
all purpose stir fry sauce  brown garlic sauce

adapted from martin yan's chinese cooking for dummies. this is my favorite stir-fry sauce. it makes enough for two meals. having extra on hand makes for a quick meal. my son will actually eat vegetables he can dip in the sauce! warning about the amount of soy sauce. when i used kikkoman soy sauce, i found this sauce far too salty. i now use angostura, which is much lower in salt. when adding soy sauce, start with less than half the amount and slowly add more to taste. using vegetable broth makes this vegetarian. yield: 1 3/4 cups (couldn't get that amount entered)

1. in a bowl , combine soy sauce , broth , rice wine , sugar , sesame oil and white pepper
2. dissolve the cornstarch in 1 / 4 cup water
3. heat a pan over high heat
4. add the cooking oil , swirling to coat
5. add the garlic and ginger
6. cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 15 seconds
7. add the soy sauce mixture
8. bring to a boil
9. reduce heat to medium and cook for 1 minute
10. add the cornstarch solution and cook , stirring , until the sauce boils and thickens
demonstrations.review: This was perfect!  Just what I was looking for!  I cut 1 Tbl of cooking oil out...no problems.  I did add 1 tsp red pepper flakes (we like spicy!).  I wasn't sure about the Rice Wine...I had something called Aji-Mirin, I tried to research it on the internet...anyway that's what I used.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet acorn squash and apple soup

served hot or delicious served cold with a dollop of yogurt. garnish with a nip of cream sherry swirled into the soup just before serving and then top with garnish.

1. saute the onion , carrot , and squash in the butter and oil for 2 minutes
2. add the apple juice , chicken stock , apple and seasoning
3. cook until vegetable are tender , add heavy cream , warm , then puree in blender
4. serve warm or cold with yogurt on side
5. garnish with grated nutmeg
demonstrations.review: Excellent soup.  Delicious.  I cooked my acorn squash (whole) in the oven on a previous day.  I used half n half instead of heavy cream.  I served this with turkey kielbasa sandwiches.  It was a perfect complement.  Thank you very much!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
szechuan noodles with spicy beef sauce

tired of using ground beef the same old way? try this spicy dish! feel free to double the sauce if you like it really saucy! update: the hoisin sauce is quite sweet, so you might start off with just a little and work your way up!

1. brown ground beef in a large skillet , stirring until it crumbles
2. drain and keep warm
3. pour sesame oil in pan and heat till hot
4. saute onion and next 4 ingredients hot sesame oil until tender
5. combine cornstarch and beef broth , whisking until smooth
6. stir broth mixture , hoisin sauce , and soy sauce into onion mixture
7. bring to a boil , stirring constantly
8. boil , stirring constantly , 1 minute
9. stir in ground beef
10. toss with hot cooked pasta , and sprinkle with sliced green onions
11. yield: 4 servings
demonstrations.review: Wow.  This was delicious.  I did sub the 2 Tbl oyster, 2 Tbl Hoisin and 3 Tbl Soy as some suggested (I had the oyster sauce, so wanted to use it).  My husband and I really loved this.  I used 1 1/2 tsp of the red peppers--it was perfect for us, but we like spicy!!  Great recipe, thanks for sharing!

target.recipe_text:
chocolate no bakes

used to make as a kid.

1. mix sugar , butter , milk and chocolate powder in a pot and bring to a boil
2. let boil for 2 minutes
3. add remaining ingredients
4. place on wax paper in spoonfuls and let cool
target.review: Excellent! I had this recipe yearsss ago but lost it. I was looking for something for my neighbors kids, found your recipe, made them but they never got there. My family couldn't keep their paws off these, and I have to admit, I couldn't either. They're so good! I'll make another batch for the neighbors again lol Thanks bunches for the recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy cheesecake cupcakes

these are a favourite at our house. they freeze well, but there is hardly a time, when i get the chance to freeze them, before they are eaten!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. beat sugar , cheese , eggs , and lemon juice until smooth
3. line cupcake pans with papers
4. place one vanilla wafer in the bottom of each
5. spoon cheese mixture over wafers , to fill cups 3 / 4 full
6. bake 20 minutes and cool
7. cupcakes will sink in the middle while cooling
8. spoon pie filling on each cupcake and refrigerate at least one hour
demonstrations.review:
I made these today and they were DEEliciousI Sorry, I substituted a tablespoon of Amaretto for the lemon juice but followed the rest of the recipe. It's nice to have an individual small piece instead of getting carried away eating a big piece of cheesecake lol
Thanks so much!! I'll be making them again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caponata   canned

posted in response to a request. i have not tried this recipe but it sounds really good!

1. heat 5 tbs olive oil in stockpot
2. add eggplant that has been cut into 1" cubes
3. stir fry 10-12 minutes until golden and touched with brown
4. add remaining oil , onions , garlic , and celery and stir fry 10 minutes longer until golden
5. mix in all remaining ingredients , cover , reduce heat to moderately low and simmer 1 hour , stirring about every 10 minutes
6. uncover and cook until very thick , about the consistency of chutney
7. prepare 3 pint sized jars
8. ladle caponata into jars leaving 1 inch headspace
9. wipe rims with a damp cloth
10. seal with lids
11. pressure cooker can pints at 10 pounds pressure for 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: We shop at a quaint Italian store and bakery but we don't go often since it's such a long drive. I buy canned caponata there but now that I have this recipe, I make it myself and we can have it more often. This recipe is spot on! Thanks so much!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pastrami reuben casserole

if you love reubens then this is for you! thinly sliced leftover roast beef or steak may use in place of pastrami.  you may double all amounts and make two layers if desired.  don't be shy with the dressing, sauerkraut and cheese--use as much as you want--the amounts stated are only a guideline, just make certain to use as much bread cubes as needed to cover the bottom of the baking dish.  place the cubes in the dish before baking just to be sure.  toasting the bread cubes prevents the bread from becoming soggy.  you may skip this step if you wish, but the sauerkraut will need to to hand-squeezed to remove as much liquid as possible :)

1. set oven to 400f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. lightly butter both sides of the bread slices
4. slice in to about 1-1 / 2-inch cubes then place on a baking sheet
5. bake until semi-crisp , but not hard and brown
6. spread the bread cubes in the prepared baking dish
7. sprinkle the sauerkraut over the bread cubes
8. layer the beef strips evenly over the sauerkraut
9. pour the salad dressing completely over the top
10. cover with foil and bake 400f for 20-25 minutes
11. remove from oven and sprinkle with shredded cheese and continue to bake uncovered for another 6-8 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly
demonstrations.review:
Great recipe! I thought I'd try it this way and it's fantastic! I've made this with the same ingredients but put together differently: 
drained sauerkraut on the bottom of the casserole dish, layered pastrami slices, 2 cups of thousand island dressing spread over the top, sliced/shredded mozerrella (or swiss depending on what I have on hand). Then top it with 1/2 loaf of cubed rye bread that is tossed with 1/4 cup of melted butter, then bake it all at once. When I pull this out of the oven, the bread cubes on top are nicely toasted.
Either way you make it, it's so unbelievably good! Thanks so much for posting it! And thanks for the Thousand Island Dressing recipe too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tater tot  beef   cheese casserole

i found lots of recipes that were similar on here, but none had these exact ingredients. our family has been making it this way for 30 years or more.

1. brown beef and onion
2. drain
3. mix mushroom soup into beef
4. press mixture in bottom of 9" square pan
5. top with frozen tater tots
6. sprinkle with cheese
7. bake 375 for 25 minutes
demonstrations.review: I was watching my friends kids and wanted to fix them something fun to eat. Personally, I thought this was very good and it was a huge hit with the kids! Very easy to fix. I also added a bit of garlic powder while browning the beef. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fake  n bake oven ranch chicken

i don't remember where i got this recipe, but i've tweaked it a bit to my own liking.  it's so simple, yet so flavorful, that it's become one of our absolute favorites in our list of "easy after-work recipes!"  my kids think i'm a real down-home cook whenever i make this!  lol!  note:  prep time does not include marinating time.

1. place cleaned and dried chicken pieces in a large flat glass dish , dredge each piece in the ranch dressing , cover dish with plastic wrap and marinate in the fridge for 30-45 minutes
2. meanwhile , preheat oven to 450
3. coat 9 x 13 inch baking sheet with pam
4. mix potato flakes , paprika , parsley flakes and garlic powder in a flat dish
5. remove marinated chicken pieces from ranch marinade , then roll in potato flake mixture , coating thoroughly
6. arrange on baking sheet , then salt and pepper to taste
7. important: turn down oven to 350
8. bake approximately 35-45 minutes , or until the juices run clear when chicken pieces are pierced with a fork and the crust looks golden brown
demonstrations.review:
I made this recipe using chicken breast fillets and used fat free ranch dressing. Crisp and moist! I love ranch dressing so I tried dipping the chicken in it as I ate, it was absolutely wonderful. 
Thanks for posting this recipe!

target.recipe_text:
chicken lime taquitos

these are absolutely to die for!!! they are not your ordinary taquitos. they're so good, i don't even use guacamole with them, although some still prefer them that way. remember to get all your veggies in long thin strips. time includes marinating.

1. combine first 5 ingredients for marinade
2. marinate chicken in mixture for at least 2 hours
3. drain chicken well and grill until done
4. allow to cool and shred into 1 / 8 inch by 3 inch pieces
5. place chicken in bowl and sprinkle with salt and minced garlic
6. mix well
7. add red pepper , pasilla , onion , cheese and 1 / 2 ounce lime juice
8. mix thoroughly
9. to assemble , warm tortilla on griddle until soft and pliable
10. if necessary , add a little oil to the pan to help soften the tortillas
11. spoon 2 ounces of chicken filling over tortilla and roll tightly , securing with toothpick
12. deep-fry in oil at 350f for 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
13. drain well
14. serve with guacamole , sour cream , and or salsa
target.review:
Oh, yum!

I did make a few changes.  I used roasted red peppers and canned roasted tomatoes.  I think roasted or grilled summer squash would be good in the meat mixture as well.

The grilled chicken is wonderful.  I will use that marinade often.  I used what I call the "hubcap grill."  It's one of those stovetop grills that looks like a hubcab.  The chicken came out just delicious.

I did not deep fry these.  I used flour tortillas and baked them at 350 till crisp.  I did spray them with a bit of cooking spray before putting them into the oven.

Outstanding!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yellow squash muffins

i found this recipe in a newspaper article many years ago. it's really delicious.the original recipe called for 1 cup melted butter. i use 1/2 cup butter & 1/2 cup applesauce.

1. wash squash , trim ends , and cut into 1-inch slices
2. cook in a small amount of water for 15 to 20 minutes
3. drain well and mash
4. measure 2 cups of the cooked squash , combine with eggs , butter , and applesauce , and set aside
5. combine dry ingredients in a large bowl
6. make a well in center of mixture
7. add squash to dry ingredients , stirring only until moist
8. spoon into greased muffin tins , filling 3 / 4 full
9. bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of muffin comes out clean
demonstrations.review: I added some cinnamon and cooked it up in a bundt pan (350 for 40 minutes).  It's very good.  We will be making this again.  I harvested a gigantic squash this morning, which was enough for the entire two cups of cooked, mashed squash the recipe called for.  It worked out beautifully.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sugar free peanut butter cookies

a wonderful cookie for those who are watching their sugar intake.

1. set oven to 375 degrees
2. grease a cookie sheet
3. in a bowl combine flour , splenda or sugar twin and baking powder
4. add in peanut butter , oil , egg , water and vanilla
5. mix well to combine
6. shape into 1-inch balls and place on the cookie sheet
7. flatten each cookie with a fork
8. bake for about 10-12 minutes , or until lightly browned
demonstrations.review: I used coconut oil instead of canola or vegetable oil.  Next time I will use a bit more Splenda because they could have been sweeter.  They were easy to make.  I got exactly 24 cookies, which never happens for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
club wraps

another great recipe from southern living. we have these for a quick, easy lunch when we are on the go. omit any ingredient that is not to your liking. add what you like. very flexible.

1. spread mustard-mayo blend evenly over 1 side of each tortilla , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border
2. layer turkey and next 6 ingredients evenly over tortillas
3. sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. roll up tortilla
5. cut in half diagonally , and secure with wooden picks
demonstrations.review: I'm avoiding smoked meats for health reasons, so I omitted the bacon and ham, and I used oven baked turkey cold cuts.  Even so, this was a tasty, satisfying and simple summer lunch. I used tomato basil flour tortillas as well.  The red onions gave it a nice kick. You could vary this by adding more fresh veggies (diced brocolli, squash, carrots, etc.)  I'll prepare this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
georgia cracker salad

this is new to me, thought you might like to try it! one package of saltines is about 40 crackers.

1. in a medium size bowl , coarsely crush the crackers with your hands- you should have big cracker pieces
2. add the remaining ingredients , mix well , and serve immediately
3. season , to taste , with salt and pepper
demonstrations.review:
I just had this for lunch.  Used my home-grown tomatoes.

This is simple and uses items which are likely to be already on hand.

This made a nice, light lunch for a summer afternoon.  Quite tasty, too.

I'll make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet plantains

recipe courtesy tyler florence. this is a lovely dessert or sweet accompaniment to arroz con pollo or another savory latin dish! i love to eat it with lechon asado and black beans and rice; i think it offsets the garlic well.

1. to peel the plantains , cut off ends and discard
2. with a paring knife , make 3 shallow slits lengthwise along the seams of the skin and peel away
3. split the plantains lengthwise
4. heat 4 tablespoons butter in a large skillet and place over medium low heat
5. fry the plantains in a single layer , until golden on the bottom then turn over with a spatula
6. add the cinnamon , vanilla , and sugar and let cook a few more seconds , just to begin caramelizing the sugar
7. just before serving , melt remaining tablespoon of butter to finish the sauce
8. serve immediately
demonstrations.review:
Love it!  I was in Progresso, Mexico last month and ordered fried plantains, took one bite and knew that I had to make this at home.

This recipe is very close.

Next time I'm going to add a couple of tablespoons of orange juice to the sauce.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot cajun pot roast

in the late 1960's i got this from a small restaurant outside of houma louisiana. i remember i "oiled" the cook's vocal cords with a lot of cold jax beer to finesse the recipe out of him. about the only thing i've changed is re figuring it for the crock pot.

1. add tomatoes , stock , thyme , basil , red pepper flakes and bay leaf to the crock pot set on high
2. mix well
3. mix cayenne , black pepper , and salt
4. rub well into the roast
5. heat a cast iron pan , add oil and brown meat on all sides
6. add to crock pot
7. saut the vegetables in the drippings until tender
8. add flour and cook for two minutes , stirring constantly
9. add vegetables to the crock pot
10. cover , reduce heat to low and cook 6-7 hours
11. cut into serving size portions
12. serve on a bed of rice
target.review: Purchased a new crockpot, this was the first meal I decided to make in it. I missed the step of preslicing the roast into steak, that of course would have made it really moist, I already had a tri-tip in the fridge. Next time I will slice the roast so the whole thing lays in the sauce while it cooks. This was tastey even with my blunder. I like my food really spicey so next time I'll probably use more crushed red pepper or cayenne. Good recipe. Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and onion couscous

colorful and a delicious side dish or main dish.

1. in a saucepan , cook and stir onion and garlic in hot oil until tender
2. add the broth and spinach
3. cook and stir frequently until the spinach thaws
4. bring mixture to a boil and stir occasionally
5. add in couscous
6. stir to combine
7. cover , remove pan from heat , and let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
8. add remaining ingredients
9. stir to combine
10. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This was really a nice blend of flavors, I didn't use the pecan, used 1-1/2 cups of broth with 1 cup of couscous. This is a nice way to try couscous,this recipe would go with most meals. Can probably use different veggies in this also. Thanks for recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ruzicka chicken

this is a great chicken recipe that i found on one of the bed&breakfast inns sites. we love it and so easy to make

1. mix cream cheese and onions
2. divide into 8 balls
3. salt and pepper chicken and place cheese-onion ball in center of each piece
4. wrap each piece of chicken in 2 strips of bacon , so that cheese is completely sealed inside
5. bake at 350 degrees for 30-50 minutes or until chicken is done
demonstrations.review: My DH really enjoyed this, he rated it 5 stars. I thought it has potential, I'll probably partially cook the bacon in the oven  next time,before wrapping or just drape it over the cheese. The bacon wasn't done enough for me on the bottom side. It does have a very elegant presentation.This actually was very simply to put together. My DH made the comment that these look and taste good enough to serve at a wedding. Thanks for recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sicilian green beans  low fat

puts a whole new twist on your green beans!

1. cover and microwave frozen green beans and 1 / 4 cup water in a quart microwave safe container for 11 minutes on high , stirring half way through
2. in another bowl combine mustard , vinegar , garlic , oregano , and pepper
3. when beans are done , drain liquid and then pour mustard mixture over beans , tossing to coat
demonstrations.review: These green beans were good but they were not great, the red wine vinegar over powered everything else, might try again with a basalmic vinegar or maybe a tough of sugar to balance out the flavor. Thanks for sharing thou.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb cheeseburger quiche

a low carb but not low fat version of a quiche using meat as a crust. it's actually pretty tasty and can definitely be used during an induction phase of a low carb diet.

1. preheat oven to 350 , brown ground beef in skillet with onion and garlic
2. drain off fat and mix in crisp crumbled bacon
3. mix well to break up any large clumps
4. press this mixture in the bottom of a deep dish pan or plate
5. combine eggs , mayo , half and half and mix well
6. sprinkle cheese over beef crust mixture
7. pour egg mixture over the beef mixture
8. bake 40-45 minutes at 350 , until browned and set
demonstrations.review: This was really good without having an eggy taste. I was apprehensive of adding the mayo but; went ahead, no worries the mayo didn't effect the taste in any negative way at all. There wasn't any leftovers at my house even my picky chihuahua love this recipe. Thanks for sharing your recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
disney s french toast

this stuff is killer good, and if you follow the whole recipe you'll probably have leftovers. not to worry, freezes well. this is not every day eating, but enjoy it when you can.

1. mix all ingredients in a large bowl
2. mix coating in a smaller bowl
3. dip bread into first mixture and fry in vegetable oil on the stove
4. cook 3 minutes on each side
5. when golden brown , remove , pat with paper towel to remove excess oil
6. sprinkle bread with coating
7. to freeze: cool and then store in ziplock freezer bags
8. to reheat: we just put one piece in the microwave at a time for about 30 seconds per side until heated through
demonstrations.review: Yum, I didn't know what to expect I halved the recipe. Crispy outside fluffy inside, and no excessive Eggy taste; unlike a lot of the soggy french toast I have ended up with. Next time I'm going to use a fine sugar, for a smoother blend of cinnamon and sugar. This recipe is definately a keeper. Finally something different when it comes to french toast. Thanks for posting.

target.recipe_text:
cinnamon flop

yummy and easy! kids and adults love it :) i don't remember where i got this recipe...i just have it written on an index card, but it has been requested of me many times. makes 2 - 9 inch cakes, so there is enough to go around!

1. preheat oven to 350 and grease well two 9" round pans
2. combine flour , sugar and baking powder
3. add melted butter and milk and stir until well blended
4. divide mixture evenly into two prepared pans
5. sprinkle tops evenly with flour , then brown sugar , then cinnamon
6. push chunks of butter evenly spaced into dough
7. bake for 30 minutes and cool slightly
8. cut and serve right out of pans
target.review: This was just a nice recipe for when a quick and easy breakfast treat is desired.Ingredients are all regularly on hand and very economical.This was what prompted me to try this one.The addition of nuts and vanilla is definately recommended.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple french toast casserole

here's another make-it-the-night-before breakfast casserole. you don't need syrup with this one. prep time does not include refrigerating overnight.

1. melt the butter in a large skillet and add apples
2. cook and stir for 5 minutes
3. add brown sugar , water , and cinnamon and continue to cook and stir for 10 minutes until apples are tender
4. spoon mixture into 13x9 baking dish
5. cover apples with bread slices , making sure to cover the entire surface
6. trim the bread to fit if you must
7. beat eggs until foamy , then beat in milk and vanilla
8. pour egg mixture over the bread slices
9. cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
10. in the morning , remove the dish from the refrigerator and let it stand while oven is preheated to 375 f
11. bake uncovered for 35 minutes , or until bread is golden and firm
12. let sit 10 minutes before serving
13. to serve on a platter , run a knife around the edges of the casserole , place platter on top of casserole , and carefully flip
14. to serve individually , use a spatula to remove serving , place serving plate on top of serving and carefully flip so apple side is up
demonstrations.review: Oh boy was this good! Normally I don't care for french toast at all, but this recipe is an exception. I made this for my DS & DD for a special breakfast one Sunday morning and the three of us devoured the entire pan. I used what ever apples I had on hand, two gala and a granny Smith. I think that a few nuts added would be very nice. I love that it can be made ahead and popped into the oven in the morning.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homestyle macaroni and cheese

it's not a lowfat casserole, but it's so delicious you won't care. add leftover ham for an even heartier meal.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. cook macaroni until just al dente
3. you can use elbows for a traditional look , but try scoobi-doo-- it works well in this recipe
4. drain pasta well
5. while the mac is boiling , melt the 1 / 4-cup butter in a large pot
6. whisk in the flour
7. over med heat , whisk until smooth and bubbly
8. stir in milk , cream cheese , salt , pepper& mustard
9. keep cooking and stirring until sauce is thickened-- about three or four minutes
10. cut the block of cheddar into half-inch cubes
11. add drained macaroni and cubed cheddar& combine well
12. pour into a casserole sprayed with pam
13. in a small bowl , combine the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top
14. dust with paprika if desired
15. bake for 15-20 minutes , or until top is golden brown and casserole is heated through
demonstrations.review: WOW!!! What great macaroni and cheese! I would give this 10 stars if I could. Very creamy and cheesy...PERFECT! I never would have thought to add mustard and cream cheese before. The addition of the cream cheese and Dijon mustard made it elegant mac and cheese.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
reeses squares   5 ingredients   no bake  reese s

these bars are extremely rich and not for people with a fear of chocolate and peanut butter (if those people actually exist)!!! very easy no bake 5 ingredient recipe!

1. combine graham crumbs , sugar and peanut butter and mix well
2. blend in melted butter until well combined
3. press mixture evenly into a 9 x 13 inch pan
4. melt chocolate chips in microwave or in double boiler
5. spread over peanut butter mixture
6. chill until just set and cut into bars (these are very hard to cut if the chocolate gets "rock hard"
demonstrations.review: This is the recipe that started my obsession with Zaar back in 2002. I realized that I have never rated it. I didn't get the nerve to rate anything until about 5 months later.  With that said I can't remember the process but everyone enjoyed eating these.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon icebox pie

easiest dessert with things you're likely to have on hand

1. mix milk , lemon juice , and cream cheese
2. put into pie crust
3. chill until firm
demonstrations.review: This pie was definately quick and very east to make with very few ingredients, so for that I would give it a 5. Unfortunately for the taste and consistancy I have to give it a 3. The pie did not firm up much after chilling and kind of oozed all over the plate. I know that the reduced fat and fat free cream cheeses are definately softer and can cause this, but that was not the case here. I used all full fat ingredients. I felt that the pie was too sweet and the condensed milk flavor was too dominant for me. I do have to admit that I love strong lemon flavors and fresh squeezed lemon juice may have been a better option than bottled.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese  cheese  macaroni and cheese and ham and cheese

nan

1. cook the macaroni in a large saucepan according to package directions
2. drain
3. add the butter
4. stir until melted
5. stir in the remaining ingredients , except paprika
6. pour into a lightly greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish
7. sprinkle paprika lightly over top
8. bake at 350f for 40 minutes
demonstrations.review: I am sorry to say that I was extremely disappointed in this recipe. I used sauteed onions in place of the dried onions, used only one cup of the breadcrumbs, and even added some milk and still found this to be extremely dry. I think that the breadcrumbs are definately the problem. Either the amount is way too much or they need to be breadcrumbs from FRESH bread, not the dried canned variety.

target.recipe_text:
black angus cheesy garlic bread

this is a great way to dress up bread. from copykat.com (http://www.copykat.com)

1. split french bread loaf into halves horizontally
2. mix butter , cheeses , mayonnaise , green onions and garlic in bowl , blending well
3. spread the cut side of bread halves with spread
4. bake at 350 degrees for 7 minutes , and place under broiler about 3 minutes longer
5. cut into slices& serve
target.review: The first time I made this, I used Italian bread by mistake. Everyone raved about it. It was so good. The second time I made It, I used the French bread and I didn't like it as much. There was more than enough spread for the Italian bread, which I will use from now on. Best garlic bread ever.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashion berry cobbler

very good served slightly warm with ice cream and recipe has been in family for over 100 years

1. cream butter and sugar together , then add milk on slow speed
2. sift dry ingredients together and add to wet a couple of tablespoon at a time , until smooth
3. batter should be very thick paste , turn out into greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan , put berries on top of batter , sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , and pour 2 1 / 2 cups boiling water over top , dot with remaining 3 tbsp butter
4. bake at 425f for 30 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: I used all blueberries. In retrospect, there are a lot more blueberries in 3 cups than say , raspberries. Even still, it was so good. This recipe is very forgiving because I unintentionally left out half a cup of water too . My husband couldn't stop eating it. I had to fight myself from taking a second helping. Great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
osso bucco   beef shanks

a variation on  the veal shank version of the traditional italian recipe. the light heat with the orange is great, this works very well with egg noodles/wild rice/and garlic mashed potato.

1. heat oven to 325 degrees
2. dredge the shanks in flour salt and pepper mixture
3. heat olive oil in stainless steel pan and brown beef shanks 2-3 minutes per side
4. remove shanks from oil and add carrots onion garlic celery and pancetta stir together 2-3 minutes and
5. add the herbs and fry 2-3 minutes and then add the chilli pepper and orange zest and fry for 2-3 minutes
6. add the wine and deglaze the pan and boil for 3-4 minutes and then add beef stock and tomato
7. place the beef shanks in the mixture or place all in a dutch oven and place in the oven for 120 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is my second time making this recipe. Evidently, I forgot to review it the first time I made it. It is so rich in flavor. I served it with mashed potatoes, which I plan to do again tonight. This was a huge hit with my husband and me. Beef shanks are running around $4.99 to $6.99 a pound around here, so I don't buy them often. I will definitely make it again though. Thank you for sharing your recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple sweet scones

this is a simple perfectly delicious recipe my mom used to make for our family. it origioually came from a biscuits and scones recipe book, this one was always my favorite of all the recipes.

1. heat oven to 425f
2. put flour , baking powder and salt into a large bowl
3. stir mix well add butter and cut in with a pastry blender or rub in with your fingers , until the mixture looks like fine crumbs
4. add sugar
5. toss to mix
6. add milk and stir with a wooden spoon until dough forms ,
7. place dough on floured counter and knead gently until the dough comes together in a ball
8. pat or roll into a circle about 1 1 / 2 inches thick
9. cut each circle into 6 or 8 wedges
10. place wedges on a greased cookie sheet- slightly apart for crisp sides , touching for soft
11. bake about 12 minutes , or until medium brown on top
demonstrations.review: The first time I made these I used my food processor. I misread the directions and only used 1 teaspoon of baking powder instead of 1 tablespoon. I added about 1/3 cup of craisins and orange zest and made one round cut into 8 pieces. When they were done, I made a mixture of a heaping tablespoon of powdered sugar and about 5 tablespoons of water into a sweetened liquid and brushed lt on the hot scones twice. The tops do not get soggy nor is it an icing. They came out a little heavy because of the baking powder mistake, but otherwise wonderful. I made them again today (with the proper amount of baking powder) but did not use the food processor. They were great. My advice: if you have a food processor, use it. Much easier.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s famous coleslaw

this is the most delicious coleslaw that you will ever have! i make this for weddings, large socials and in the summer for bbq's and parties, and there is never anything left it all goes and everyone wants the recipe --- plan ahead the coleslaw needs to be refrigerated for the stated time to blend the flavors, this coleslaw will intensify in flavor with chilling time --- this is not a thick heavy dressing like some other coleslaw recipes it's the perfect texture and flavor and what makes this coleslaw stand out from all others is the fresh lemon juice so please use only fresh i have used bottled in the past and it is just not the same --- the dressing amount will yield enough for two 16-ounce packages prepared coleslaw mix or 1 head of green cabbage --- for one 16-ounce package prepared coleslaw mix use the dressing amounts posted on bottom of recipe and add in 3 or more large of chopped green onions.   for more kittencal's recipes, visit my recipe site www.recipezazz.com

1. in a food processor chop the cabbage into small pieces or shred the cabbage
2. transfer to a large mixing bowl
3. with a fine shredder , shred the peeled carrots
4. add to the cabbage in the bowl
5. chop the green onion finely
6. add to the cabbage / carrot mixture along with the celery seed
7. mix the three veggies all together with a wooden spoon
8. to make the dressing: in a medium glass bowl whisk together all the dressing ingredients starting with the lower amounts then adding in and adjusting to suit taste but using 1 / 3 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar
9. pour over the veggies in the bowl , and mix well to combine
10. store covered in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours or overnight to blend flavors
11. for one 16-ounce package coleslaw mix use the following amounts
12. 1 / 2 cup mayonnaise / 2-1 / 2 tablespoons milk / 2-1 / 2 tablespoons buttermilk / 1-1 / 2 tablespoons vinegar / 1-1 / 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice / 3-1 / 2 tablespoons sugar / 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder / 1 / 2 teaspoon seasoned salt , or to taste
demonstrations.review: The first time I made this because my husband loves cole slaw. (I have never been a fan.) I made the small version recipe. I used light cream and made butter milk by adding a teaspoon of vinegar to the milk and letting it sit for 10 minutes. I put it in a plastic container and turned it every few hours, then let it sit overnight. The volume decreases, but the veggies stay crispy. It was so good even I loved it. The second time, I made a full recipe. Only thing I did differently was add the celery seed to the sauce instead of mixing it in to the cabbage. So good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
corn chowder with shrimp

from eat better america. this sounds really good.

1. let frozen corn stand at room temperature to thaw slightly
2. in 4-quart saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
3. cook onion , bell pepper , celery and garlic in oil , stirring frequently , until tender
4. add broth , potato , thyme and ground red pepper
5. heat to boiling
6. reduce heat
7. cover and simmer 10 minutes
8. remove frozen corn from pouch
9. add corn to mixture in saucepan
10. heat to boiling , stirring frequently to break up frozen corn
11. using wire whisk , stir flour into milk until smooth
12. stir into mixture in saucepan
13. heat to boiling
14. reduce heat
15. simmer uncovered about 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and soup is thickened
16. stir in shrimp
17. cook 1 to 2 minutes or until hot
demonstrations.review: This recipe is excellent and extremely forgiving. I was looking for a meatless meal to cook tonight. I am embarrassed to admit this but i had to substitute some ingredients. I had no green pepper so I used frozen pepper and onions. No frozen corn so I used canned + A tablespoon of butter. Since I wanted meatless, I substituted Better Than Bouillon lobster base in a cup of water instead of chicken broth. I cut the shrimp into 6 pieces because they were so big. Delicious! I am sure it would be even better as directed. Just goes to show you how forgiving a good recipe can be.

target.recipe_text:
secretly delicious spinach pie

the tortilla adds a delicious crunchy shell and it smells so good while it is cooking. i actually made up this recipe from items in my kitchen and couldn't believe how wonderful it tasted! it is now a hit in my family and so easy to make. please rate and give feedback.  


update: since i first made this five years ago, we still enjoy this at least once a month. i have found that i can alternate the ingredients to use up items i have in the fridge. i have used mushrooms, sauteed onions, cherry tomatoes and even feta cheese instead of cheddar cheese. and it always comes out fantastic. i have also found that there are times i need to use more or less eggs depending on the ingredients. also, a glass pie pan is so much better than a metal as it toasts the tortilla just right. such an easy recipe with gourmet taste!

1. mix the first six ingredients in a bowl
2. set aside
3. lay the flour tortilla in a glass pie dish , press gently - does not need to lay perfectly flat against dish
4. i don't spray it prior and have never had any issues with it sticking
5. especially when made using a glass pie pan
6. sprinkle only 1 / 2 cup cheese on tortilla
7. sprinkle remaining cheese and the spinach onto tortilla in layers , and press gently
8. i don't chop or tear the spinach but you might opt to do this
9. pour egg mixture evenly over spinach , be careful not to pour any outside of tortilla as this causes it to stick to pan
10. bake in oven at 365 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes
11. insert fork in center and it should come out clean
12. use sharp knife to cut into pie slices and serve hot
13. other options: instead of garlic , you can use 1 / 4 cup onions
14. for added flavor , serve with homemade salsa
target.review: I made this for dinner last night and it was quite good! Even my carnivore husband enjoyed it! I made slight changes: I used frozen spinach defrosted and throughly drained and used 3 eggs w/ 4 egg whites. Also, I didn't have lemon pepper so I used salt, pepper, onion powder and a little Tabasco. I used shredded Monterey Jack cheese and turkey bacon, as that is what I had on hand and it was great! This is a recipe you can play around with and tweak to use up stuff on hand. Not exactly a quick dinner, but was perfect for the weekend. Also very budget friendly!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ground beef with hoisin

i 

1. combine orange juice& cornstarch and set aside
2. saute meat over medium high heat until cooked
3. drain off excess fat , remove and set aside
4. add sesame oil to skillet , stir fry ginger , garlic and orange peel briefly
5. add green onion and stir fry 1 minute
6. return meat to skillet , add hoisin and stir until blended
7. add orange juice mixture and stir until thickened
8. can serve over rice or couscous or"fusion" it as i do
demonstrations.review: I give the recipe as written below 3 stars, it was good but I felt like something was missing the first time around. I made this again last night and tweaked it a bit. Now I give it 5 stars. In step 4 I added extra ginger and some crushed red pepper. Then in step 6 I added the hoisin, orange juice (no cornstarch), 2 tbls or so of tamari, 1 tbls or so of brown sugar, tsp or so of rice vinegar. I let it simmer for 5 mins or so and it thickened on it's own. I served it w/ orange scented jasime rice and topped it w/ a ton of fresh cilantro. First time around, DH thought it was ok. This time around, he's asking for left overs the night after! Great basic recipe that can easily be adjusted and tweaked to meet your taste.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
onion parmesan roasted red potatoes

very easy, very little prep. i use to buy a product made by lipton, which came in a bottle and you poured it over your diced potatoes and baked/grilled the dish. they have since discontinued the product, so i have found this to be the next best thing.

1. combine all ingredients in a large plastic bag , seal and shake until well coated
2. empty bag into a 13x9 dish , cover and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. uncover and bake 15 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
4. i think they even taste better more browned and crispy , so you may want to turn up the temp after uncovering and cook them longer
5. you could also make this on the grill , covered in foil in an aluminum pan
6. grill for 1 hour , turning potatoes occasionally
demonstrations.review: This recipe deserves 10 stars! This is now my favorite potato dish! I made this for Valentine's dinner along w/ Herb-crusted beef tenderloin. (recipe 278364). The potatoes were AMAZING. I could have made a meal out of that alone. This is a MUST TRY! I'll be making these again ASAP!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ground beef gyros

this is a great summer meal and quick and easy to put together and tastes wonderful. refreshing served with the cucumber sauce and is even low in fat. i think this came from quick cooking. it's a favorite in our house.

1. in a bowl , combine first 5 ingredients
2. cover and refrigerate
3. in separate bowl , combine ground beef and seasonings
4. mix well
5. shape into 4 patties
6. grill , covered , over medium to high heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until meat is no longer pink , turning once
7. cut patties into thin slices
8. stuff into pitas
9. add lettuce , cucumber , tomato , and onion
10. serve with yogurt sauce
demonstrations.review: This was great and done in around 30 mins. So easy and totally satisfied my gyro craving. I recommend using Greek style plain yogurt for better sauce consistency. Also, I added a splash of lemon juice to the sauce. Otherwise, followed the recipe exactly. This has made it way into the rotation!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai chicken breasts

this recipe actually calls for breasts, but i used thighs and they were moist and lucious! goes well with steamed basamati rice.

1. combine the gingerrot , garlic and red pepper flakes in a cup and set aside
2. mix flour with salt and pepper to taste and dredge chicken pieces in this
3. heat the olive oil in a large skillet
4. saute the chicken until browned on both sides and cooked through
5. remove the chicken and put in a warm dish , set aside in low oven to keep warm
6. add the ginger-garlic mixture to the skillet and saute until lightly browned
7. add the soy sauce , brown sugar , vinegar and fish sauce
8. bring the mixture to a boil
9. reduce the heat and simmer , stirring frequently , until the sauce reduces and thickens
10. pour the sauce over the chicken pieces in the warm serving dish and keep warm until ready to serve
11. trim and shred the sugar snap peas diagonally
12. just prior to serving sprinkle the top of the chicken with the shredded snap peas
demonstrations.review: As one other reviewer said, if you come across this recipe, MAKE IT! It was beyond easy and so tasty! I skipped the whole flouring step b/c DH and I were in a hurry and it was still outstanding! I also used low sodium soy sauce and I really can't say enough about how good this is. Don't let the fish sauce scare you away! I'm not a big seafood/fish person, but the fish sauce is a MUST. This would probably still be good w/o, but you wouldn't have that little something different that makes this unique and gives it that "Thai" flavor. I've already given this recipe to a friend and was super tempted to make this the night after we first tried it. This is SO in the rotation now! Thanks MarieAlice! GREAT recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
100  whole wheat blueberry muffins

nan

1. preheat oven to 350
2. coat 12 muffin cups with cooking spray
3. sift together the flour and baking soda
4. in a separate bowl , whisk together the buttermilk , egg whites , oil , and honey until creamy , then stir in the blueberries
5. pour the wet ingredients into the dry
6. fold together with a rubber spatula until the batter is moist yet remains slightly lumpy
7. pour into muffin cups and bake 30 to 35 minutes
demonstrations.review: These muffins are great! I did make some adjustments per the other reviews. I used one whole egg, used brown sugar and increased it to about 3/4 cup, added 1/4 tsp. sea salt, and added about a tsp. of vanilla. I also sprinkled sugar in the raw on the tops of the muffins. I baked the muffins at 400 for about 23 minutes and they came out beautifully! They were big and puffy and tasted as good as they looked! Not to sweet and they had a nice fluffy texture. Next time I will try with only egg whites since that makes the muffins practically cholesterol free. These are a keeper! They taste great and are healthier then the average blueberry muffin. Thanks, Carole!

target.recipe_text:
chicken stroganoff   crock pot

nan

1. put frozen chicken in bottom of crock pot
2. mix soup , sour cream , and onion soup mix
3. pour over chicken
4. cook on low for 7 hours
5. serve over rice or noodles
target.review:
Have been trying different crockpot recipes  these past few weekends at camp because I like to fish and I like to eat as well.
I used regular cream of mushroom soup and 8 oz of reg sour cream and used Mushroom Onion Soup mix.  Also added 1/2 can of water at the beginning because it appeared it would be too thick.   The last 30 minutes of cooking I added another 1/2 can of water and 1/2 lb of wide egg noodles and let it all cook together.   It really was quite wonderful..
Thank you very much. Margie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
winner s spaghetti casserole

this fast, easy recipe is a real family pleaser! i have used this recipe for many years as my good old stand-by for potlucks and tailgate parties. i have also baked this recipe in two smaller pans, keeping one for my family and bringing the other over to a new mother or neighbor as a welcome gift. this is my version of one i found in a  community cookbook called "enough to feed an army." (note: updated the amount of the spaghetti, i also now use a smaller box of pasta in this, even though the original called for a 1 pound box)

1. preheat oven to 350 f degrees
2. place cooked spaghetti in a deep 1
3. 5 quart oval baking dish or a glass 9x13" casserole
4. in a skillet , brown the ground beef until cooked through
5. drain fat and stir in spaghetti sauce
6. heat over low heat , covered , until warmed through , stirring occasionally
7. meanwhile , in a small saucepan , melt butter over low heat
8. add onions and peppers to the butter and saute until just lightly browned
9. cut up cream cheese into small chunks and add to the onion mixture
10. stir until melted and well combined
11. pour half of the meat sauce over the cooked spaghetti
12. pour all of the cream cheese sauce over the first layer of meat sauce , using a spatula to spread evenly
13. pour remaining meat sauce over the cream cheese layer , again using a spatula to spread evenly
14. sprinkle some parmesan cheese over the top to taste
15. cover with foil and bake for about 25 minutes or warm and bubbly
16. remove cover and bake 5 minutes more
17. this can be prepared ahead , refrigerated , and not baked until the following day , if desired
demonstrations.review:
Very much liked this.  The cream cheese was a nice change of flavor.  I had made this many times before from a recipe given to me by my Aunt and she used Longhorn Cheddar.  I like both.
Thanks.
Margie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon pinwheels

this is so easy to prepare. you can use flavored cream cheese if you like.

1. spread tortillas with cream cheese
2. sprinkle with bacon and lettuce
3. roll up tightly
4. wrap in plastic wrap and chill
5. cut each roll into 5 pieces
demonstrations.review:
Have been accused of trying to make my co workers fat with all of the testing I have been doing.  These were great as written and with tomatoes as suggested.  The third time I mised a little ranch dressing with the cream cheese.   Another dimension!
Thank you!
Margie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shrimp patties

these patties are sooo delicious and simple. very rich, too! they freeze well before baking. they will be a big hit! serve as a side or appetizer.

1. saute shrimp in butter with garlic powder
2. do not drain
3. add remaining ingredients and stir well until warm and blended
4. fill patties
5. bake in 350 degrees for 12 minutes
demonstrations.review:
Have been looking for something like this for a while.  We didn't have the athens shells so I added bread crumbs and flour and made patties the first time and then left over mashed potatoes the second time and fried all. 
Thank you!
margie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s tuna casserole circa 1949

i remember the first time mother made this casserole, back in 1949. she and i really loved it. so we made it often. even the leftovers are good. in this version, i have doubled her recipe to feed a larger family.

1. bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. cook pasta in boiling water for 8 minutes , or until al dente
3. drain
4. preheat oven to 425 degrees f
5. in a large bowl , thoroughly mix noodles , onion , 1 cup cheese , peas , tuna , soup and mushrooms
6. transfer to a 9" x 13" inch baking dish , and top with potato chip crumbs and remaining 1 cup cheese
7. bake , uncovered , for 15 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven , or until cheese is bubbly
demonstrations.review:
This recipe brought back many childhood memories and I really do like this dish.   I omitted the peas because I do not like them and added canned green beans.   A good substitute.
Good job, and thank you. Margie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
everlasting yeast

this will make a small amount of purchased yeast last indefinitely....hence the name! got this recipe from a church-produced cookbook. prep time is just a guess.

1. mix all ingredients together in a bowl
2. place mixture in a warm place to raise until ready to mix for baking
3. leave a small amount of mixture for a start for next time
4. between uses , keep in a covered jar in the fridge until a few hours before ready to use again
5. add same ingredients except yeast to the remaining start for the next baking
6. by keeping the everlasting yeast start and remaking some each time , yeast can be kept on hand indefinitely
demonstrations.review: Am in the process of using this-it reminds me of a potato sour dough receipe I have been using for years-in that recipe the taste gets better with age and am hoping this one does.   Will let you know. Thank you. Margie

target.recipe_text:
crock pot potato and smoked sausage soup

this is a hearty soup.  serve with cornbread and you have a wonderful cold weather meal.

1. pour chicken broth in crock pot
2. add can of mushroom soup and mix well with broth
3. peel and dice potatoes , add to crock pot
4. dice onion and saute in skillet with butter until soft
5. slice smoked sausage and then quarter
6. add to onion
7. cook until smoked sausage is hot
8. add to crock pot
9. cook on high for 4 hours
10. before serving , lower heat and add milk and cheese
11. stir in cheese until melted
12. mix cornstarch with a small amount of water
13. mix until smooth
14. add to soup to help thicken
target.review: This turned out really good...I was worried that it might be bland because the recipe doesn't call for any spices, but I just added some salt and pepper and it was really tasty! Very quick, easy, and inexpensive recipe...will definitely make this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy tuna or chicken noodle casserole

this is a delicious casserole that can be made using either tuna or 1-1/2 cups or more of cooked cubed chicken or even cooked turkey
 --- for a thinner sauce use 1 cup of milk or half and half instead of 3/4 cup, prep time includes boiling the egg noodles, if you are not a garlic-lover then you may omit the garlic powder and to zing the flavor up even more add in 1-1/2 tablespoons of lemon juice

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. grease a 2-quart casserole dish
3. cook the egg noodles in boiling salted water
4. drain then toss with 2 tablespoons butter
5. in a large saucepan , mix the undiluted mushroom soup , garlic powder , parmesan cheese milk or half and half , sour cream , salt , pepper , chopped onion , pimiento , bell pepper and celery
6. cook over low heat , stirring frequently for 15 minutes
7. add in the tuna or chicken
8. mix to combine
9. combine the mixture with the cooked egg noodles
10. transfer to prepared greased baking dish
11. sprinkle top with the broken ritz crackers
12. bake for about 25 minutes
demonstrations.review: I made this last night and it was terrible. It is NOT a good idea to put onions in tuna casserole. I doubled the recipe to make a 9x13 casserole, so because the original recipe calls for one small onion, I chopped a whole medium onion...BAD IDEA!! The onion flavor was so strong that it made the dish completely inedible and I had to throw the whole thing out. I couldn't even taste the tuna at all! I probably will make this again, but I will definitely be leaving out the onions. One good note, the sauce was really creamy and had a good texture...it probably would have been really good if I could have tasted it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy snickers bar pie

this recipe is so easy. make it to take to a potluck and keep one at home for yourself! the cook time mentioned is the chill time in the fridge

1. in a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar and peanut butter until creamy
2. stir in chopped candy bars
3. gently fold in the cool whip just until mixed
4. pour into crusts and refrigerate overnight
demonstrations.review: This pie is very good, but very rich. I also cut up another snickers bar and put on top, as well as some toffee chips and drizzled caramel. It looked so pretty, you almost didn't want to eat it! The only thing I didn't care for was the overwhelming peanut butter taste...would've preferred more of a chocolate flavor but that's just me. I will probably be making this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sex on the beach

a nice refreshing summer cocktail, its sweet and hits the spot very quickly...great for parties instead of punch.

1. in a cocktail shaker place ice , vodka , schnapps and juice
2. shake well
3. take a chilled glass and wet the lip of the glass in grenadine , dip in sugar to make a "frosted" glass
4. pour the grenadine into the chilled glass
5. pour juice mix through the strainer into glass being careful not to"upset" the grenadine
6. serve immediately
7. can be served with crushed ice , add grenadine and then the juice mix
demonstrations.review: This is not the traditional way to make sex on the beach, but this is how I always make them and request them be made when I go out...MUCH better than the recipe that uses cranberry juice. I like my drinks sweet, so I also add some pineapple juice to it. Delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven ranch chicken  low fat

this is a wonderful recipe that my children love. i love it too because it's only 4 points per breast if you're living a lifestyle that requires you to assign points to your food.  pair this up with cole slaw and baked beans... yummy!!!

1. heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. spray cookie sheet with non-stick spray
3. in shallow dish combine bread crumbe & dressing mix
4. dip chicken in sounr cream , then crumb mixture
5. place on cookie sheet , spray chicken with cooking spray
6. discard any remaining bread crumbs & sour cream
7. bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until chicken is fork tender and juices run clear
demonstrations.review: This was very good...I couldn't taste the ranch flavor as much as I would have liked though. I may dip the chicken in some ranch dressing next time instead of sour cream. Overall, a really good recipe that I will make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
iced caramel cappuccinos

a delicious summertime treat!  these are almost as good as starbuck's caramel frappuccinos.  try substituting chocolate syrup for a mocha version or adding other flavored syrups like vanilla, almond, etc.  top with whipped cream and drizzle with caramel.  this recipe was taken from top secret recipes.

1. make double strength coffee by using 2 tablespoons coffee per each cup of water
2. you can discard the remainder or use it to make more iced cappuccinos
3. chill
4. combine chilled coffee , milk , sugar , caramel and ice in blender
5. blend on high speed until all of the ice has been crushed
6. pour into glasses
7. top with whipped cream and drizzle with more caramel if desired
demonstrations.review: OH MY GOSH!! These are hands down the best coffee drinks that I have ever had! My sister and I made these the other night and they were amazing...puts Starbucks to shame! I made them just like the recipe, but I also used chocolate syrup. I've made them on the stove too, and they are just as good hot!

target.recipe_text:
insalata della nonna  grandmother s special salad

i saw this recipe in the observer food monthly supplement and thought it looked so good that i had to post it here for safekeeping and to share.

1. steam the beans for 6-8 minutes until tender
2. add the olive oil , lemon juice , garlic , oregano salt and pepper together in a salad bowl and mix well
3. now add the tomatoes and also the still warm beans and potatoes
4. carefully mix to coat everything with the dressing
5. can be served warm or cold
target.review: This was sooo good.  DH liked the green beans slightly crisp.  I had to use plain green beans since our stores don't have French beans and I didn't grow Harcort Vert (sp?) this year. Next year...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
winter vegetable curry

this is really satisfying on a cold day. it's creamy but low fat.

1. heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat
2. add onion , cook until tender , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes
3. add curry powder , cumin and crushed red pepper
4. stir until fragrant , about 1 minute
5. add milk
6. bring to boil
7. add potatoes and 1 cup tomatoes
8. cover
9. simmer until potatoes are almost tender , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
10. add broccoli , carrots and cauliflower
11. cover
12. simmer until all vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally , about 7 minutes
13. season with salt and pepper
14. divide rice among 4 plates
15. top with curry
16. sprinkle with remaining 1 cup tomatoes and garnish with cilantro leaves , if desired
demonstrations.review: This was fabulous!  I made it exactly as written.  It made a marvelous dinner for me, and heated up beautifully for DH when he got home from working late.  I'm looking forward to the leftovers tomorrow for lunch.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb spaghetti squash alfredo

this is a very good and comes from george stella's low carb and loving it. i did change the way to cook the squash as it is much faster and less clean up.

1. slice spaghetti squash in half lengthwise , scoop out seeds with a spoon
2. place squash cut side down in microwave safe dish with 1 / 3 cup water
3. cook about 15 minutes or until tender when tested with a fork
4. scoop out the cooked squash from its skin , discard skin
5. use a fork to fluff and separate the squash into"spaghetti"- like strands
6. you can use your hands
7. reserve the cooked squash and heat in microwave just before serving
8. melt half the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
9. add cream and reduce for about 2 minutes , then add garlic and cheese , whisk quickly , heating through
10. stir in the rest of the butter and parsley
11. place spaghetti squash in a large serving bowl , and , pour alfredo sauce over squash , garnish with basil and tomatoes , serve and enjoy
demonstrations.review: This was terrific! I added one of those little cans of B in B musnroms and about half a pound of meatballd from the freezer.With a green salad and some crusty French bread (we aren't doing the low carb thing), this was a wonderful meal.  Good stuff.  Thank you Barb.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
clock watchers chicken skillet

this is a quick and tasty one-skillet meal. just add a salad and garlic bread, and dinner is ready in no time. perfect for those busy nights when we had to run to hockey practice. those were the days!

1. in a large skillet , cook chicken and onion until onion is tender
2. remove chicken from skillet and keep warm
3. add tomatoes , broth , basil , garlic and pepper to skillet
4. bring to a boil
5. stir in spaghetti
6. reduce heat
7. cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
8. return chicken to pan
9. cook until juices run clear and spaghetti is tender
10. sprinkle with parmesan and serve
demonstrations.review: Oh, wow!  This is amazing!  I was a bit under the weather today and wanted something dead easy and contained everthing.  This was just the ticket.  I used lnguini and put in a can of drained green beans and a cup or so of mushrooms with the onions.  Meat, noodles, lots of veggies.  Everything!  I didn't have any dried basil, so I used a spoonful of mixed Italian spice.  Thank you, Girl, for keeping body and soul together!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon rice fluff

elegant, delicious, yet simple. can be served in elegant crystal parfait glasses; making it perfect for that special dinner party

1. combine pudding mix , sugar , water , apricot nectar and egg
2. cook and stir over med heat until thickened
3. cool
4. fold into cool whip and then fold in rice
demonstrations.review: Oh!  This is wonderful!  I was looking for a different sort of rice pudding, and this is it!  I made this to take to a friend's house for dessert.  It was a big hit!  There were no leftovers, and I only got a small scoop. This one's a real keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tattie scones

serve these scone/griddlecake hybrids with bacon, eggs, and large bibs to catch the drool! (prep time includes cooking and mashing the potatoes)

1. preheat a dry frying pan or griddle over moderate heat
2. mix together all the ingredients until thoroughly blended
3. turn the dough onto a floured board and divide into three
4. roll into a circle about -inch thick
5. cut each circle into 6 wedges
6. at this point , you may freeze some of the scones they will last for weeks and weeks and weeks in the freezer
7. sprinkle the hot griddle with flour and bake each circle for about 5 minutes , until the edges begin to brown , turning once to cook both sides
8. for a really tasty variation , use a 50 / 50 mix of mashed potatoes and mashed rutabagas and / or mashed carrots
demonstrations.review:
These are great!  Yender and delicate, yet hearty and satisfying.  I've got half the batch tucked away in the freezer, so we'll see how they do...

I used red potatoes.  Next time I'll add some rutabaga or parsnip.  I was a bit skeptical with no soda, but ot makrs a nice biscut(?) vegetable patty(?)  Not quite either, but really good.  :ove the flavor amd texture...  Slather with lots of butter, or herb butter, or herb cream cheese...

target.recipe_text:
banana nut bread made by mom

my mom has been making banana nut bread as far back as i can remember.  she told me she worked with a woman that gave her the recipe.  she followed the recipe to a "t" but it never came out the same.  it was either too soggy, or too sticky.  finally she tweaked the recipe until it came out just right.  the original recipe called for 8 very ripe bananas, and too much shortening.  i've been making this recipe since i was 18, and have never had a bad loaf.  the order in how the ingredients are put together is very important for some reason.  i have tried mixing everything in one bowl and it does change it quite drastically.  i guessed on the servings as it depends on how thick or thin you cut the slices.

1. in a large bowl mix together all dry ingredients well
2. in a seperate bowl mix eggs , shortening and banana until well combined
3. add the wet mixture to the dry mixture until well combined with a hand mixer
4. add the nuts and mix on low to medium speed for about a minute or until the nuts are evenly mixed into the batter
5. spray or grease a 9x5x3 loaf pan and bake in a pre-heated oven at 350 for about an hour --
6. we have always set the kitchen timer to 45 minutes and have checked the loaf with a clean butter knife in the center of the loaf
7. if it comes out clean it's done
8. you do not want the loaf to burn , at this point you will check the loaf every 5 minutes after that
9. it should have a nice golden brown color on the top and the house should smell wonderful
10. when it comes out of the oven give it about 20 minutes or so to cool and very carefully slide a butter knife or spatula down all of the sides of the loaf pan , turn upside down and it should fall out smoothly
11. slice immediately -- we like to spread softened butter and enjoy with a cold glass of milk
target.review: My husband gives this a 10 on a scale of 1-10.  Love it!  ChrissyVas 80 did a great job of perfecting her Mom's recipe.  I tripled it because I had 3 bananas about to get tossed.  Made per instructions but the batter was so thin,  I added another two cups of flour to reach what I felt was the right consistancy.  I used two 11"x 5" X 4" foil pans and baked for 1 hour and 5 minutes.  Loaves got a little dark on the top but the slicing was perfect and the crust has just a bit of crunch to it.   Happy to give this 5 stars.  Good going, ChrissyVas80!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best oatmeal cookies

this is a family favorite that i have been making for years. it's the most requested oatmeal cookie recipe i've ever made. i found it somewhere years ago, but have lost the source. the secret is soaking the raisins which makes all the difference.

1. this is a very important first step that makes the cookie: combine eggs , raisins and vanilla and let stand for one hour
2. cream together butter and sugars
